51/// @file
52/// @brief The UI document interpreter: `Interpreter::mount` turns a loaded `Document` into reactive state and a view
53/// tree, mounts it through `Mounted` on any `IViewBackend`, and runs its queries, mutations, relations and
54/// commands. Model calls go through a `Dispatcher` (the bridge's model-free seams in an application, a
55/// scripted fake in a test); what only the application can do goes through an `InterpreterHost`; what
56/// screens share — the query cache, the principal's permissions, the formatting facts — is a `Session`.
57
58namespace morph::ui {

64/// @brief How one model call is sent.
65struct CallOptions {
66 /// @brief Ask the server to evaluate the action's body instead of executing it (spec 5 §7, `ui-evaluate`).
67 bool evaluate = false;
68 /// @brief The mutation declares `"offline": "queue"`: a dispatcher with an offline queue holds a call that cannot
69 /// reach the server and settles the completion when the replay settles.
70 bool queueOffline = false;
71};

92/// @brief The interpreter's view of the bridge: binds a model by its type id, privately or to a shared instance.
93class Dispatcher {

96 Dispatcher(Dispatcher const&) = delete;
97 Dispatcher& operator=(Dispatcher const&) = delete;
98 Dispatcher(Dispatcher&&) = delete;
99 Dispatcher& operator=(Dispatcher&&) = delete;
100 virtual ~Dispatcher() = default;

102 /// @brief Binds a model.
103 /// @param typeId The model's registered type id.
104 /// @param sharing Private, or shared.
105 /// @param instanceKey For a shared binding, the instance key; empty for the model's shared singleton.
106 /// @return The bound channel. The caller holds it as long as it makes calls through it.
107 [[nodiscard]] virtual std::shared_ptr<ModelChannel> bind(std::string const& typeId, bridge::BindSharing sharing,
108 std::string const& instanceKey) = 0;
109};

111/// @brief Evaluates an action body without running it: the model's type id, the action id and the JSON body in, the
112/// query's value out (spec 5 §7). `ui::evaluatorOver` builds one over the UI service's `ui-evaluate`.
113using Evaluator = std::function<async::Completion<std::string>(std::string const& typeId, std::string const& actionId,
114 std::string const& bodyJson)>;
115
116/// @brief A `Dispatcher` over the bridge's model-free seams: `bindByType`, `executeRaw` and the string-keyed
117/// `attach`, through `RawHandler`.
118///
119/// An evaluation goes through the `Evaluator` it was given, since that envelope belongs to the UI service, not the
120/// bridge; without one it is refused with a `std::runtime_error`. It has no offline queue of its own: `queueOffline`
121/// is ignored unless a `QueueingDispatcher` wraps it. A shared binding without a key is bound unattached, which the
122/// bridge refuses at the first call; the interpreter never binds one, since a `"shared"` alias is a stateless model's
123/// and binds privately.
124class BridgeDispatcher final : public Dispatcher {
125public:
126 /// @brief Dispatches through @p bridge, and evaluates through @p evaluator.
127 /// @param bridge The bridge. Borrowed: it must outlive every channel.
128 /// @param cbExec The executor replies are delivered on: the runtime's owner. Borrowed.
129 /// @param evaluator What answers an `evaluate` query; empty to refuse them.
130 BridgeDispatcher(bridge::Bridge& bridge MORPH_LIFETIMEBOUND, exec::IExecutor* cbExec MORPH_LIFETIMEBOUND,
131 Evaluator evaluator = {})
132 : _bridge{&bridge}, _cbExec{cbExec}, _evaluator{std::move(evaluator)} {}
133
134 /// @brief Binds through a `RawHandler`.
135 /// @param typeId The model's registered type id.
136 /// @param sharing Private, or shared.
137 /// @param instanceKey For a shared binding, the key to attach to; empty to stay unattached.
138 /// @return The channel; destroying it deregisters the binding.
139 [[nodiscard]] std::shared_ptr<ModelChannel> bind(std::string const& typeId, bridge::BindSharing sharing,
140 std::string const& instanceKey) override {
141 return std::make_shared<Channel>(*_bridge, _cbExec, _evaluator, typeId, sharing, instanceKey);
142 }
143
144private:
145 class Channel final : public ModelChannel {
146 public:
147 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(bugprone-easily-swappable-parameters): the type id, then the key, as `bind` takes them.
148 Channel(bridge::Bridge& bridge, exec::IExecutor* cbExec, Evaluator evaluator, std::string const& typeId,
149 bridge::BindSharing sharing, std::string const& instanceKey)
150 : _cbExec{cbExec},
151 _evaluator{std::move(evaluator)},
152 _typeId{typeId},
153 _handler{bridge, cbExec, typeId, sharing, instanceKey} {}
154
155 [[nodiscard]] async::Completion<std::string> execute(std::string const& actionId, std::string const& bodyJson,
156 CallOptions options) override {
157 if (options.evaluate) {
158 if (_evaluator) {
159 return _evaluator(_typeId, actionId, bodyJson);
160 }
161 auto [refused, promise] = async::Completion<std::string>::makeSettleable(_cbExec);
162 promise.reject(std::make_exception_ptr(std::runtime_error{"evaluate needs the UI service"}));
163 return std::move(refused);
164 }
165 return _handler.execute(actionId, bodyJson);
166 }
167
168 private:
169 exec::IExecutor* _cbExec;
170 Evaluator _evaluator;
171 std::string _typeId;
172 bridge::RawHandler _handler;
173 };
174
175 bridge::Bridge* _bridge;
176 exec::IExecutor* _cbExec;
177 Evaluator _evaluator;
178};

217/// @brief The inline cap a session has unless it is given another: 1 MiB.
218inline constexpr std::size_t kDefaultInlineFileBytes = std::size_t{1024} * 1024;

220/// @brief The largest inline cap a session takes: base64 grows bytes by 4/3, and 64 KiB of an envelope are left for
221/// the rest of the body, so the encoded file still fits `wire::kMaxEnvelopeBytes`.
222inline constexpr std::size_t kMaxInlineFileBytes = (wire::kMaxEnvelopeBytes - (std::size_t{64} * 1024)) * 3 / 4;

419/// @brief What a `Session` is built with.
420struct SessionOptions {
421 /// @brief Timers for `debounce`, `refreshEvery` and the cache's eviction. Without one, `debounce` fetches at once,
422 /// `refreshEvery` never ticks and unused entries are kept. Borrowed.
423 reactive::Scheduler* scheduler = nullptr;
424 /// @brief The clock `staleTime` is measured on; empty uses `std::chrono::steady_clock`.
425 std::function<std::chrono::milliseconds()> clock;
426 /// @brief How long an entry no mounted query uses is kept (spec 5 §5: five minutes).
427 std::chrono::milliseconds keepUnused{std::chrono::minutes{5}};
428 /// @brief The catalog: `stateless` decides an alias's default instance; an action's `secretFields` are never
429 /// cached or kept in `result`.
430 Catalog catalog;
431 /// @brief Maps a failed call to its error kind (`denied`, `offline`, `timeout`, …); empty uses the default,
432 /// which knows the bridge's own failures and calls everything else `error`.
433 std::function<std::string(std::exception_ptr const&)> classify;
434 /// @brief Development mode: whether this session's screens record what the inspector reads. Off by default.
435 DevelopmentTools developmentTools = DevelopmentTools::Off;
436 /// @brief Sends the cache's watch changes to the server. Empty: the session still counts what its cache holds,
437 /// and sends nothing, which is right for a local source, whose replies carry every change it sees.
438 Watcher watcher;
439 /// @brief The most bytes a document moves inline in one file (`download` from bytes, `upload` into bytes, a
440 /// field component writing a base64 member); 1 to `kMaxInlineFileBytes`.
441 std::size_t maxInlineFileBytes = kDefaultInlineFileBytes;
442};

446/// @brief The text of a failure.
447/// @param error The failure.
448/// @return `what()`, or `unknown error`.
449[[nodiscard]] inline std::string failureText(std::exception_ptr const& error) {
450 try {
451 std::rethrow_exception(error);
452 } catch (std::exception const& failure) {
453 return failure.what();
454 } catch (...) {
455 return "unknown error";
456 }
457}

459/// @brief The default error kinds: the bridge's own failures, and `error` for the rest.
460/// @param error The failure.
461/// @return The kind.
462[[nodiscard]] inline std::string defaultErrorKind(std::exception_ptr const& error) {
463 try {
464 std::rethrow_exception(error);
465 } catch (backend::DisconnectedError const&) {
466 return "offline";
467 } catch (backend::TimeoutError const&) {
468 return "timeout";
469 } catch (backend::ClientTimeoutError const&) {
470 return "timeout";
471 } catch (backend::BackendChangedError const&) {
472 return "backendChanged";
473 } catch (...) {
474 return "error";
475 }
476}

478/// @brief A value's JSON text, with record fields in name order: a cache key's canonical body.
479/// @param value The value.
480/// @return The text.
481[[nodiscard]] inline std::string canonicalJson(Value const& value) {
482 return glz::write_json(valueToJson(value)).value_or(std::string{});
483}

485/// @brief A value with the field at @p path replaced, creating records along the way.
486/// @param base The value written into.
487/// @param path The field path.
488/// @param value The new value at the path.
489/// @return The new value.
490// NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-no-recursion): one level per path segment
491[[nodiscard]] inline Value withPath(Value const& base, std::span<std::string const> path, Value value) {
492 if (path.empty()) {
493 return value;
494 }
495 ValueRecord fields;
496 if (ValueRecord const* const record = base.asRecord()) {
497 fields = *record;
498 }
499 Value const inner = base.field(path.front()) != nullptr ? *base.field(path.front()) : Value{};
500 fields.insert_or_assign(path.front(), withPath(inner, path.subspan(1), std::move(value)));
501 return Value{std::move(fields)};
502}
503
504/// @brief A row's identity for `patch` and `optimistic`: its `id` field.
505/// @param row The row.
506/// @return The `id` field, or `null`.
507[[nodiscard]] inline Value rowId(Value const& row) {
508 Value const* const found = row.field("id");
509 return found == nullptr ? Value{} : *found;
510}
511
512/// @brief Writes @p with over a row: the fields of a record over a record's, otherwise the whole row.
513/// @param row The row.
514/// @param with The new content.
515/// @return The new row.
516[[nodiscard]] inline Value mergeRow(Value const& row, Value const& with) {
517 ValueRecord const* const fields = row.asRecord();
518 ValueRecord const* const over = with.asRecord();
519 if (fields == nullptr || over == nullptr) {
520 return with;
521 }
522 ValueRecord merged = *fields;
523 for (auto const& [name, field] : *over) {
524 merged.insert_or_assign(name, field);
525 }
526 return Value{std::move(merged)};
527}

529/// @brief Why a patch left a query's value as it was.
530enum class PatchMiss : std::uint8_t {
531 NoList, ///< The value, or its `at` member, is not a list: the patch can never apply, and is reported.
532 NoRow, ///< No row's `id` equals the key: the row is not loaded, which is not a fault.
533};
534
535/// @brief Replaces the row whose `id` equals @p key in a query's list of rows.
536/// @param value The query's value: the list itself, or a record holding it in member @p listMember.
537/// @param listMember The record member holding the list; empty when @p value is the list.
538/// @param key The row's id.
539/// @param with The new content, merged over the row.
540/// @return The new value, or why it is unchanged.
541// NOLINTBEGIN(bugprone-easily-swappable-parameters): a list, a key and a row are distinct roles of one type.
542[[nodiscard]] inline std::expected<Value, PatchMiss> patchRows(Value const& value, std::string_view listMember,
543 Value const& key, Value const& with) {
544 // NOLINTEND(bugprone-easily-swappable-parameters)
545 ValueRecord const* const record = listMember.empty() ? nullptr : value.asRecord();
546 if (!listMember.empty() && (record == nullptr || !record->contains(listMember))) {
547 return std::unexpected(PatchMiss::NoList);
548 }
549 Value const* const rows = record == nullptr ? &value : &record->find(listMember)->second;
550 ValueList const* const items = rows->asList();
551 if (items == nullptr) {
552 return std::unexpected(PatchMiss::NoList);
553 }
554 if (key.isNull()) {
555 return std::unexpected(PatchMiss::NoRow);
556 }
557 ValueList out = *items;
558 bool found = false;
559 for (Value& row : out) {
560 if (rowId(row) == key) {
561 row = mergeRow(row, with);
562 found = true;
563 }
564 }
565 if (!found) {
566 return std::unexpected(PatchMiss::NoRow);
567 }
568 if (record == nullptr) {
569 return Value{std::move(out)};
570 }
571 ValueRecord patched = *record;
572 patched.insert_or_assign(std::string{listMember}, Value{std::move(out)});
573 return Value{std::move(patched)};
574}
575
576/// @brief What a patch that found no list reports.
577/// @param query The query it patches.
578/// @param listMember The record member it names; empty when none.
579/// @return The diagnostic's reason.
580[[nodiscard]] inline std::string patchMissReason(std::string_view query, std::string_view listMember) {
581 if (listMember.empty()) {
582 return "the value of `" + std::string{query} +
583 "` is not a list, so the patch changes nothing; `at` names the record member that holds the list";
584 }
585 return "the value of `" + std::string{query} + "` has no list at `" + std::string{listMember} +
586 "`, so the patch changes nothing";
587}

589/// @brief Removes the named fields from a record, and from each record of a list.
590/// @param value The value.
591/// @param fields The field names.
592/// @return The value without them.
593// NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-no-recursion): one level per nested list or record of the value.
594[[nodiscard]] inline Value withoutFields(Value const& value, std::vector<std::string> const& fields) {
595 if (fields.empty()) {
596 return value;
597 }
598 if (ValueRecord const* const record = value.asRecord()) {
599 ValueRecord kept = *record;
600 for (std::string const& field : fields) {
601 kept.erase(field);
602 }
603 return Value{std::move(kept)};
604 }
605 if (ValueList const* const items = value.asList()) {
606 ValueList kept;
607 kept.reserve(items->size());
608 for (Value const& item : *items) {
609 kept.push_back(withoutFields(item, fields));
610 }
611 return Value{std::move(kept)};
612 }
613 return value;
614}
615
616/// @brief The members of a catalog record path: `"header.rows"` is `header`, then `rows`; `""` is none.
617/// @param path The path.
618/// @return Its members in order.
619[[nodiscard]] inline std::vector<std::string> pathMembers(std::string_view path) {
620 std::vector<std::string> members;
621 for (auto const part : std::views::split(path, '.')) {
622 if (!part.empty()) {
623 members.emplace_back(part.begin(), part.end());
624 }
625 }
626 return members;
627}
628
629/// @brief The rows of a keyed record that a value holds at a path.
630///
631/// A list on the way is looked through, as the result walker looks through a `std::vector`. At the path's end a
632/// record with the key field is a row, and a record without it is a map whose values are the rows.
633/// @param value The value.
634/// @param path The members still to follow.
635/// @param keyField The record's key field.
636/// @param out Where the rows go.
637// NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-no-recursion): one level per path member or nested list.
638inline void keyedRowsAt(Value const& value, std::span<std::string const> path, std::string_view keyField,
639 std::vector<Value const*>& out) {
640 if (ValueList const* const items = value.asList()) {
641 for (Value const& item : *items) {
642 keyedRowsAt(item, path, keyField, out);
643 }
644 return;
645 }
646 ValueRecord const* const record = value.asRecord();
647 if (record == nullptr) {
648 return;
649 }
650 if (!path.empty()) {
651 if (auto const found = record->find(path.front()); found != record->end()) {
652 keyedRowsAt(found->second, path.subspan(1), keyField, out);
653 }
654 return;
655 }
656 if (record->contains(keyField)) {
657 out.push_back(&value);
658 return;
659 }
660 for (auto const& [name, item] : *record) {
661 static_cast<void>(name);
662 if (ValueRecord const* const row = item.asRecord(); row != nullptr && row->contains(keyField)) {
663 out.push_back(&item);
664 }
665 }
666}
667
668/// @brief New rows by the canonical text of their key.
669using RowsByKey = std::map<std::string, Value const*, std::less<>>;
670
671/// @brief Merges new rows over the rows with the same key that a value holds at a path.
672/// @param value The value.
673/// @param path The members still to follow.
674/// @param keyField The record's key field.
675/// @param rows The new rows.
676/// @return The new value, or nothing when no row matched.
677// NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-no-recursion): one level per path member or nested list.
678[[nodiscard]] inline std::optional<Value> patchKeyedRows(Value const& value, std::span<std::string const> path,
679 std::string_view keyField, RowsByKey const& rows) {
680 if (ValueList const* const items = value.asList()) {
681 ValueList out = *items;
682 bool changed = false;
683 for (Value& item : out) {
684 if (auto patched = patchKeyedRows(item, path, keyField, rows)) {
685 item = std::move(*patched);
686 changed = true;
687 }
688 }
689 return changed ? std::optional<Value>{Value{std::move(out)}} : std::nullopt;
690 }
691 ValueRecord const* const record = value.asRecord();
692 if (record == nullptr) {
693 return std::nullopt;
694 }
695 if (!path.empty()) {
696 auto const found = record->find(path.front());
697 if (found == record->end()) {
698 return std::nullopt;
699 }
700 auto patched = patchKeyedRows(found->second, path.subspan(1), keyField, rows);
701 if (!patched) {
702 return std::nullopt;
703 }
704 ValueRecord out = *record;
705 out.insert_or_assign(path.front(), std::move(*patched));
706 return Value{std::move(out)};
707 }
708 if (auto const key = record->find(keyField); key != record->end()) {
709 auto const row = rows.find(canonicalJson(key->second));
710 return row == rows.end() ? std::nullopt : std::optional<Value>{mergeRow(value, *row->second)};
711 }
712 ValueRecord out = *record;
713 bool changed = false;
714 for (auto& [name, item] : out) {
715 static_cast<void>(name);
716 if (ValueRecord const* const row = item.asRecord(); row != nullptr && row->contains(keyField)) {
717 if (auto patched = patchKeyedRows(item, {}, keyField, rows)) {
718 item = std::move(*patched);
719 changed = true;
720 }
721 }
722 }
723 return changed ? std::optional<Value>{Value{std::move(out)}} : std::nullopt;
724}
725
726/// @brief One optimistic write still waiting for its reply.
727struct OptimisticLayer {
728 /// @brief The run that made it.
729 std::uint64_t run = 0;
730 /// @brief The record member holding the list; empty when the value is the list.
731 std::string at;
732 /// @brief The row's id.
733 Value key;
734 /// @brief What was written.
735 Value with;
736};
737
738/// @brief One entry of the session's query cache (spec 5 §5): one request in flight, one value, one error.
739struct CacheEntry {
740 /// @brief An empty entry.
741 /// @param runtime The runtime its signals belong to.
742 explicit CacheEntry(reactive::Runtime& runtime)
743 : value{runtime}, hasValue{runtime, false}, error{runtime}, errorKind{runtime}, pending{runtime, false} {}
744
745 /// @brief The cache key: model type, instance, action and canonical body.
746 std::string key;
747 /// @brief The model type.
748 std::string typeId;
749 /// @brief The action.
750 std::string action;
751 /// @brief The body's JSON text.
752 std::string body;
753 /// @brief Whether it is an `evaluate` query.
754 bool evaluate = false;
755 /// @brief The value shown: the confirmed value with the optimistic layers over it.
756 reactive::Signal<Value> value;
757 /// @brief Whether a reply has been applied.
758 reactive::Signal<bool> hasValue;
759 /// @brief The last failure's text; empty when none.
760 reactive::Signal<std::string> error;
761 /// @brief The last failure's kind; empty when none.
762 reactive::Signal<std::string> errorKind;
763 /// @brief Whether a request is in flight.
764 reactive::Signal<bool> pending;
765 /// @brief The value the server last confirmed.
766 Value confirmed;
767 /// @brief The optimistic writes still waiting, oldest first.
768 std::vector<OptimisticLayer> layers;
769 /// @brief The generation of the request in flight; a reply of an older one is dropped.
770 std::uint64_t generation = 0;
771 /// @brief When the last reply was applied.
772 std::optional<std::chrono::milliseconds> fetchedAt;
773 /// @brief Marked stale by a `refetch`, a backend switch or a change.
774 bool stale = false;
775 /// @brief Marked stale while a fetch was in flight: that fetch may have read before the change, so when it
776 /// settles the entry stays stale and fetches once more.
777 bool refetchAfter = false;
778 /// @brief The mounted queries using it.
779 int users = 0;
780 /// @brief The eviction timer, while no query uses it.
781 reactive::TimerHandle evict;
782 /// @brief The fields never cached.
783 std::vector<std::string> secretFields;
784 /// @brief The alias's instance token the entry was read through.
785 std::string instanceToken;
786 /// @brief The records the entry's action returns, with the key field and paths of each; empty for an
787 /// `evaluate` entry, which holds none.
788 std::vector<ActionRecordInfo> records;
789
790 /// @brief The catalog entry of a record the entry holds.
791 /// @param record The record's wire name.
792 /// @return It, or `nullptr` when the entry does not hold the record.
793 [[nodiscard]] ActionRecordInfo const* holding(std::string_view record) const {
794 auto const found = std::ranges::find(records, record, &ActionRecordInfo::record);
795 return found == records.end() ? nullptr : &*found;
796 }
797};
798
799/// @brief The rows of a keyed record a value holds, at each of the record's paths.
800/// @param value The value.
801/// @param paths The record's paths.
802/// @param keyField The record's key field.
803/// @return The rows.
804[[nodiscard]] inline std::vector<Value const*> keyedRowsOf(Value const& value, std::vector<std::string> const& paths,
805 std::string_view keyField) {
806 std::vector<Value const*> rows;
807 for (std::string const& path : paths) {
808 std::vector<std::string> const members = pathMembers(path);
809 keyedRowsAt(value, members, keyField, rows);
810 }
811 return rows;
812}
813
814/// @brief Merges new rows into a value at each of the record's paths.
815/// @param value The value.
816/// @param paths The record's paths.
817/// @param keyField The record's key field.
818/// @param rows The new rows by key.
819/// @return The new value, or nothing when no row matched.
820[[nodiscard]] inline std::optional<Value> patchHeldRows(Value const& value, std::vector<std::string> const& paths,
821 std::string_view keyField, RowsByKey const& rows) {
822 std::optional<Value> patched;
823 for (std::string const& path : paths) {
824 std::vector<std::string> const members = pathMembers(path);
825 auto next = patched ? patchKeyedRows(*patched, members, keyField, rows)
826 : patchKeyedRows(value, members, keyField, rows);
827 if (next) {
828 patched = std::move(next);
829 }
830 }
831 return patched;
832}
833
834/// @brief The entries one change marks stale, each once, in the order they were found.
835struct Marks {
836 /// @brief The entries.
837 std::vector<CacheEntry*> entries;
838
839 /// @brief Adds an entry, unless it is already there.
840 /// @param entry The entry.
841 void add(CacheEntry& entry) {
842 if (std::ranges::find(entries, &entry) == entries.end()) {
843 entries.push_back(&entry);
844 }
845 }
846};

854/// @brief How a mutation's reply was used.
855enum class ReplyUse : std::uint8_t {
856 Applied, ///< The reply is the latest: its values may patch the cache.
857 Discarded, ///< A newer run's reply was applied first, so its values are older and only mark.
858};

860/// @brief What running a host command (`host/1`) did.
861struct HostCommandResult {
862 /// @brief The outcome.
863 enum class Kind : std::uint8_t {
864 Ran, ///< The command ran.
865 Missing, ///< The client has no such command; nothing ran.
866 Refused, ///< The command exists and did not run: its arguments, or a connection that is not verified.
867 };
868 /// @brief The outcome.
869 Kind kind = Kind::Ran;
870 /// @brief Why it was refused; empty otherwise.
871 std::string reason;
872};

874/// @brief The client's host commands, as a session runs them (spec 6 §14).
875struct HostCommands {
876 /// @brief The commands the client can run now; `{"can": "host:name"}` is true for these.
877 std::set<std::string, std::less<>> available;
878 /// @brief Runs a command with its evaluated `args` (`null` when the document gives none).
879 std::function<HostCommandResult(std::string const& name, Value const& args)> run;
880};

882/// @brief What screens of one client session share (spec 5 §5, §12b): the query cache, the mounted queries, the
883/// principal's permitted actions, the formatting facts and the client's `env`, `session` and `host` values.
884///
885/// It belongs to the runtime's owner, outlives every screen mounted on it, and is cleared by `signOut` and on a
886/// principal change.
887class Session {
888public:
889 /// @brief An empty session.
890 /// @param runtime The runtime. Borrowed.
891 /// @param options Timers, clock, catalog and the inline cap.
892 /// @throws std::invalid_argument when `maxInlineFileBytes` is 0 or above `kMaxInlineFileBytes`.
893 explicit Session(reactive::Runtime& runtime MORPH_LIFETIMEBOUND, SessionOptions options = {})
894 : _runtime{&runtime},
895 _options{checkedOptions(std::move(options))},
896 _permitted{runtime},
897 _format{runtime, std::make_shared<FormatContext const>()},
898 _env{runtime},
899 _sessionValues{runtime},
900 _hostValues{runtime},
901 _hostCommandNames{runtime} {}
902
903 Session(Session const&) = delete;
904 Session& operator=(Session const&) = delete;
905 Session(Session&&) = delete;
906 Session& operator=(Session&&) = delete;
907 ~Session() = default;
908
909 /// @brief The runtime.
910 /// @return It.
911 [[nodiscard]] reactive::Runtime& runtime() const noexcept { return *_runtime; }
912
913 /// @brief The options.
914 /// @return They.
915 [[nodiscard]] SessionOptions const& options() const noexcept { return _options; }
916
917 /// @brief Sets the action ids the principal may run, as the catalog reply lists them; `{"can": ...}` follows them.
918 /// @param permitted The ids.
919 void setPermitted(std::set<std::string, std::less<>> permitted) { _permitted.set(std::move(permitted)); }
920
921 /// @brief Whether the principal may run an action, or the client can run a host command now. A tracked read.
922 ///
923 /// A `host:` name is answered from the client's own commands (`setHostCommands`), never from the server's
924 /// permitted set: the two have different owners, and a catalog refresh must not drop the client's commands.
925 /// @param action The action id, or `host:<command>`.
926 /// @return Whether it is permitted.
927 [[nodiscard]] bool can(std::string_view action) const {
928 static constexpr std::string_view kHostPrefix = "host:";
929 if (action.starts_with(kHostPrefix)) {
930 return _hostCommandNames.get().contains(action.substr(kHostPrefix.size()));
931 }
932 return _permitted.get().contains(action);
933 }
934
935 /// @brief Replaces the formatting facts; every `t` and display function re-evaluates.
936 /// @param format The facts.
937 void setFormatting(FormatContext format) { _format.set(std::make_shared<FormatContext const>(std::move(format))); }
938
939 /// @brief The formatting facts. A tracked read.
940 /// @return They.
941 [[nodiscard]] FormatContext const& formatting() const { return *_format.get(); }
942
943 /// @brief Changes the active locale, keeping the other formatting facts.
944 /// @param locale The BCP 47 locale.
945 void setLocale(std::string locale) {
946 FormatContext next = *_format.peek();
947 next.locale = std::move(locale);
948 setFormatting(std::move(next));
949 }
950
951 /// @brief Replaces the message catalogue, keeping the other formatting facts; every `t` re-resolves.
952 /// @param translations The provider, such as `MessageCatalogues::provider()`; empty shows every fallback.
953 void setTranslations(render::TranslationProvider translations) {
954 FormatContext next = *_format.peek();
955 next.translations = std::move(translations);
956 setFormatting(std::move(next));
957 }
958
959 /// @brief Sets the `env` values (`widthClass`, `locale`, `platform`, `online`, `backend`).
960 /// @param values The values.
961 void setEnvironment(ValueRecord values) { _env.set(std::move(values)); }
962
963 /// @brief Sets the `session` values (`principal`, `userName`, …).
964 /// @param values The values.
965 void setSessionValues(ValueRecord values) { _sessionValues.set(std::move(values)); }
966
967 /// @brief Sets the `host` values the application registered.
968 /// @param values The values.
969 void setHostValues(ValueRecord values) { _hostValues.set(std::move(values)); }
970
971 /// @brief Sets the client's host commands: the names `{"can": "host:name"}` answers for, and what runs them. A
972 /// session without a runner asks `InterpreterHost::hostCommand`.
973 /// @param commands The names and the runner.
974 void setHostCommands(HostCommands commands) {
975 _hostCommandRunner = std::move(commands.run);
976 _hostCommandNames.set(std::move(commands.available));
977 }
978
979 /// @brief What runs host commands.
980 /// @return It; empty when the application set none.
981 [[nodiscard]] std::function<HostCommandResult(std::string const&, Value const&)> const& hostCommandRunner()
982 const noexcept {
983 return _hostCommandRunner;
984 }
985
986 /// @brief Reads `env`, `session` or `host`. A tracked read.
987 /// @param form `Env`, `Session` or `Host`.
988 /// @param name The name.
989 /// @return The value, or `null`.
990 [[nodiscard]] Value client(ExprKind form, std::string_view name) const {
991 ValueRecord const& values = [&]() -> ValueRecord const& {
992 if (form == ExprKind::Env) {
993 return _env.get();
994 }
995 return form == ExprKind::Session ? _sessionValues.get() : _hostValues.get();
996 }();
997 auto const found = values.find(name);
998 return found == values.end() ? Value{} : found->second;
999 }

1001 /// @brief The app document's scope, which `{"ref": "app.name"}` reads and `{"set": "app.name"}` writes; set by
1002 /// `Interpreter::mountApp` for as long as the `AppRoot` lives.
1003 /// @return It, or `nullptr` when no app document is mounted.
1004 [[nodiscard]] detail::RtScope const* appScope() const noexcept { return _appScope; }
1005
1006 /// @brief Installs or clears the app document's scope. Called by `AppRoot`, nothing else.
1007 /// @param scope The scope, or `nullptr`.
1008 void setAppScope(detail::RtScope const* scope) noexcept { _appScope = scope; }
1009
1010 /// @brief Drops every cache entry: `signOut` and a principal change (spec 5 §5, "Isolation").
1011 void clear() {
1012 _runtime->batch([this] {
1013 for (auto const& [key, entry] : _entries) {
1014 static_cast<void>(key);
1015 ++entry->generation;
1016 entry->evict.cancel();
1017 countTopics(*entry, -1);
1018 }
1019 _entries.clear();
1020 for (detail::QueryRuntime* const query : _mounted) {
1021 detachQuery(*query);
1022 }
1023 });
1024 }
1025
1026 /// @brief Carries out a committed backend switch (spec 6 §9), in one batch: every mounted screen's
1027 /// `onBackendChange` runs first, then every entry is marked stale and the mounted queries refetch, and
1028 /// `{"env": "backend"}` becomes @p backend. A query on a private alias therefore never fetches before its
1029 /// screen has recovered from the switch.
1030 /// @param backend The backend now in use.
1031 void backendChanged(std::string const& backend);
1032
1033 /// @brief Registers a mounted screen or app document, whose `onBackendChange` a backend switch runs.
1034 /// @param screen It. Borrowed until `detachScreen`.
1035 void attachScreen(detail::ScreenCore& screen) { _screens.push_back(&screen); }
1036
1037 /// @brief Forgets a screen or app document.
1038 /// @param screen It.
1039 void detachScreen(detail::ScreenCore& screen) { std::erase(_screens, &screen); }
1040
1041 /// @brief Starts a query's request before its screen mounts, so the screen mounts on a warm cache.
1042 /// @param channel The alias's channel.
1043 /// @param token The alias's instance token (`Screen::instanceToken`).
1044 /// @param typeId The model type.
1045 /// @param action The action.
1046 /// @param body The body.
1047 void prefetch(std::shared_ptr<ModelChannel> const& channel, std::string const& token, std::string const& typeId,
1048 std::string const& action, Value const& body) {
1049 auto entry = acquire(token, typeId, action, false, body);
1050 if (!entry->pending.peek() && (!entry->hasValue.peek() || entry->stale)) {
1051 fetch(entry, channel);
1052 }
1053 release(entry);
1054 }
1055
1056 /// @brief The number of entries in the cache.
1057 /// @return It.
1058 [[nodiscard]] std::size_t cacheSize() const noexcept { return _entries.size(); }
1059
1060 /// @brief A fresh instance token for a private alias: what the cache key holds for its instance.
1061 /// @return It, unique in the session.
1062 [[nodiscard]] std::string privateToken() { return "private#" + std::to_string(++_privateTokens); }
1063
1064 /// @brief Whether the newest write to a document source was made by a user event (spec 5 §6, `source: "user"`).
1065 /// @return It.
1066 [[nodiscard]] bool lastWriteByUser() const noexcept { return _lastWriteUser; }
1067
1068 /// @brief Records a write to a document source.
1069 void noteWrite() noexcept { _lastWriteUser = _userDepth > 0; }
1070
1071 /// @brief Runs @p body as a user event: what it writes counts as the user's.
1072 /// @param body The body.
1073 void asUser(std::function<void()> const& body) {
1074 ++_userDepth;
1075 try {
1076 body();
1077 } catch (...) {
1078 --_userDepth;
1079 throw;
1080 }
1081 --_userDepth;
1082 }
1083
1084 /// @brief The cache key of a query.
1085 /// @param token The alias's instance token.
1086 /// @param typeId The model type.
1087 /// @param action The action.
1088 /// @param evaluate Whether it is an `evaluate` query.
1089 /// @param body The canonical body.
1090 /// @return The key.
1091 [[nodiscard]] static std::string cacheKey(std::string const& token, std::string const& typeId,
1092 std::string const& action, bool evaluate, std::string const& body) {
1093 return typeId + '\x1f' + token + '\x1f' + (evaluate ? "evaluate:" : "") + action + '\x1f' + body;
1094 }
1095
1096 /// @brief Finds or makes an entry and counts one more user.
1097 /// @param token The alias's instance token.
1098 /// @param typeId The model type.
1099 /// @param action The action.
1100 /// @param evaluate Whether it is an `evaluate` query.
1101 /// @param body The body.
1102 /// @return The entry.
1103 std::shared_ptr<detail::CacheEntry> acquire(std::string const& token, std::string const& typeId,
1104 std::string const& action, bool evaluate, Value const& body) {
1105 std::string const text = detail::canonicalJson(body);
1106 std::string key = cacheKey(token, typeId, action, evaluate, text);
1107 auto found = _entries.find(key);
1108 if (found == _entries.end()) {
1109 auto entry = std::make_shared<detail::CacheEntry>(*_runtime);
1110 entry->key = key;
1111 entry->typeId = typeId;
1112 entry->action = action;
1113 entry->body = text;
1114 entry->evaluate = evaluate;
1115 entry->instanceToken = token;
1116 if (_options.catalog.action) {
1117 if (auto const info = _options.catalog.action(action)) {
1118 entry->secretFields = info->secretFields;
1119 if (!evaluate) {
1120 entry->records = info->records;
1121 }
1122 }
1123 }
1124 countTopics(*entry, +1);
1125 found = _entries.emplace(std::move(key), std::move(entry)).first;
1126 }
1127 ++found->second->users;
1128 found->second->evict.cancel();
1129 return found->second;
1130 }
1131
1132 /// @brief Counts one user less; an entry nobody uses is dropped after `keepUnused`.
1133 /// @param entry The entry.
1134 void release(std::shared_ptr<detail::CacheEntry> const& entry) {
1135 if (--entry->users > 0 || _options.scheduler == nullptr) {
1136 return;
1137 }
1138 std::weak_ptr<detail::CacheEntry> const weak = entry;
1139 entry->evict = _options.scheduler->after(_options.keepUnused, [this, weak] {
1140 auto const held = weak.lock();
1141 if (held && held->users == 0) {
1142 countTopics(*held, -1);
1143 _entries.erase(held->key);
1144 flushWatches();
1145 }
1146 });
1147 }
1148
1149 /// @brief Sends an entry's request under a new generation; a reply of an older generation is dropped.
1150 /// @param entry The entry.
1151 /// @param channel The channel to send it through; `nullptr` fails the request at once.
1152 void fetch(std::shared_ptr<detail::CacheEntry> const& entry, std::shared_ptr<ModelChannel> const& channel) {
1153 // The watch goes out before the read, on the same connection, so a change committed after the read is
1154 // seen as an event.
1155 flushWatches();
1156 std::uint64_t const generation = ++entry->generation;
1157 if (channel == nullptr) {
1158 settleFailure(*entry, "the model alias has no instance", "error");
1159 return;
1160 }
1161 entry->pending.set(true);
1162 std::weak_ptr<detail::CacheEntry> const weak = entry;
1163 try {
1164 auto completion = channel->execute(entry->action, entry->body, CallOptions{.evaluate = entry->evaluate});
1165 completion
1166 .then([this, weak, generation](std::string const& reply) {
1167 auto const held = weak.lock();
1168 if (held && held->generation == generation) {
1169 settleReply(*held, reply);
1170 }
1171 })
1172 .onError([this, weak, generation](std::exception_ptr const& error) {
1173 auto const held = weak.lock();
1174 if (held && held->generation == generation) {
1175 settleFailure(*held, detail::failureText(error), classify(error));
1176 }
1177 });
1178 } catch (...) {
1179 std::exception_ptr const error = std::current_exception();
1180 settleFailure(*entry, detail::failureText(error), classify(error));
1181 }
1182 }
1183
1184 /// @brief Writes an entry's confirmed value and re-applies its optimistic layers over it.
1185 /// @param entry The entry.
1186 /// @param confirmed The confirmed value.
1187 void confirm(detail::CacheEntry& entry, Value const& confirmed) {
1188 entry.confirmed = detail::withoutFields(confirmed, entry.secretFields);
1189 showLayers(entry);
1190 }
1191
1192 /// @brief Recomputes what an entry shows from its confirmed value and its layers.
1193 /// @param entry The entry.
1194 void showLayers(detail::CacheEntry& entry) {
1195 Value shown = entry.confirmed;
1196 for (detail::OptimisticLayer const& layer : entry.layers) {
1197 if (auto patched = detail::patchRows(shown, layer.at, layer.key, layer.with)) {
1198 shown = std::move(*patched);
1199 }
1200 }
1201 noteWrite();
1202 entry.value.set(std::move(shown));
1203 }
1204
1205 /// @brief The error kind of a failure.
1206 /// @param error The failure.
1207 /// @return The kind.
1208 [[nodiscard]] std::string classify(std::exception_ptr const& error) const {
1209 return _options.classify ? _options.classify(error) : detail::defaultErrorKind(error);
1210 }
1211
1212 /// @brief The clock.
1213 /// @return Now.
1214 [[nodiscard]] std::chrono::milliseconds now() const {
1215 if (_options.clock) {
1216 return _options.clock();
1217 }
1218 return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(
1219 std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch());
1220 }

1222 /// @brief Registers a mounted query, which a reconnect and a backend switch refetch.
1223 /// @param query The query.
1224 void attachQuery(detail::QueryRuntime& query) { _mounted.push_back(&query); }
1225
1226 /// @brief Unregisters a mounted query.
1227 /// @param query The query.
1228 void forgetQuery(detail::QueryRuntime& query) { std::erase(_mounted, &query); }
1229
1230 /// @brief A call of @p actionId on a model of @p typeId succeeded: applies the action's effects to the cache
1231 /// (spec 8 §9).
1232 ///
1233 /// `updates R` merges the reply's rows of `R` into each entry holding `R`, matched by the record's key field at
1234 /// the entry's paths, with no fetch; an entry whose fetch is in flight also fetches once more, since that fetch
1235 /// may have read before the write. `changes R` marks each entry holding `R` stale. `changesInstance` marks each
1236 /// entry read through the same instance. A marked entry refetches through a mounted query that uses it. A
1237 /// discarded reply only marks: its `updates` act as `changes`.
1238 /// @param typeId The model type.
1239 /// @param actionId The action.
1240 /// @param reply The reply's value.
1241 /// @param use Whether the reply was applied or discarded.
1242 /// @param instanceToken The instance token of the alias the call went through.
1243 void actionSucceeded(std::string const& typeId, std::string const& actionId, Value const& reply, ReplyUse use,
1244 std::string const& instanceToken);
1245
1246 /// @brief The connection to the server was made again (spec 8 §7, "Reconnect"): sends the whole watch set with
1247 /// `replace: true`, then marks every entry but an `evaluate` one stale. A mounted entry refetches, and one
1248 /// whose fetch is in flight fetches once more when that fetch settles, so a change missed while the
1249 /// connection was down is read again.
1250 void reconnected();
1251
1252 /// @brief The topics the cache holds now: every record an entry holds, and the keyed shared instance of every
1253 /// entry whose action holds no record. What `reconnected` sends.
1254 /// @return The topics, records and instances each in name order; `replace` is false.
1255 [[nodiscard]] wire::WatchBody watchSet() const;
1256
1257 /// @brief Applies a server event to the cache (spec 8 §9).
1258 ///
1259 /// A `changes` event marks the entries it names stale, and a `resync` sends the whole watch set again, as
1260 /// `reconnected` does, and marks every entry but an `evaluate` one;
1261 /// each marked entry refetches through a mounted query that uses it, and one no query uses refetches when a
1262 /// query mounts on it. An event of another topic, or a payload that cannot be read, is ignored.
1263 /// @param event The event.
1264 void deliverEvent(wire::EventBody const& event);
1265
1266 /// @brief Applies a `changes` event's payload to the cache, in one reactive batch.
1267 ///
1268 /// A record change with keys marks each entry holding the record whose value has a row with one of the keys,
1269 /// and an entry holding it keyless; a record change without keys marks every entry holding the record. An
1270 /// instance change marks every entry read through that instance: the keyed shared one its primary key names,
1271 /// or, with no primary key, the connection's own private ones of that model type.
1272 /// @param changes The payload.
1273 void applyChanges(wire::ChangesBody const& changes);
1274
1275 /// @brief Marks an entry stale. While its fetch is in flight, the entry also refetches once that fetch settles,
1276 /// because the fetch may have read before the change.
1277 /// @param entry The entry.
1278 static void markStale(detail::CacheEntry& entry) {
1279 entry.stale = true;
1280 if (entry.pending.peek()) {
1281 entry.refetchAfter = true;
1282 }
1283 }
1284
1285private:
1286 // A cap of 0 moves nothing inline, and one above the largest would not fit an envelope once encoded.
1287 [[nodiscard]] static SessionOptions checkedOptions(SessionOptions options) {
1288 if (options.maxInlineFileBytes == 0 || options.maxInlineFileBytes > kMaxInlineFileBytes) {
1289 throw std::invalid_argument{"morph::ui::Session: maxInlineFileBytes is " +
1290 std::to_string(options.maxInlineFileBytes) + "; it is 1 to " +
1291 std::to_string(kMaxInlineFileBytes) + " (kMaxInlineFileBytes)"};
1292 }
1293 return options;
1294 }
1295
1296 void settleReply(detail::CacheEntry& entry, std::string const& reply) {
1297 auto json = parseJson(reply);
1298 auto value = json ? valueFromJson(*json) : std::unexpected(json.error());
1299 if (!value) {
1300 settleFailure(entry, "the reply is not a document value: " + value.error(), "error");
1301 return;
1302 }
1303 _runtime->batch([&] {
1304 confirm(entry, *value);
1305 entry.hasValue.set(true);
1306 entry.error.set({});
1307 entry.errorKind.set({});
1308 entry.pending.set(false);
1309 entry.fetchedAt = now();
1310 entry.stale = entry.refetchAfter;
1311 if (entry.refetchAfter) {
1312 entry.refetchAfter = false;
1313 refetchMounted(entry);
1314 }
1315 });
1316 }
1317
1318 /// @brief Refetches an entry through the mounted queries that use it; one fetch even when several do.
1319 /// @param entry The entry.
1320 void refetchMounted(detail::CacheEntry const& entry);

1328 void applyReplyEffects(std::string const& typeId, std::string const& actionId, Value const& reply, ReplyUse use,
1329 std::string const& instanceToken);

1331 /// @brief Counts an entry's topics in or out, queueing a `watch` for a count that leaves zero and an `unwatch`
1332 /// for one that returns to it.
1333 /// @param entry The entry.
1334 /// @param delta `+1` when the entry is made, `-1` when it is dropped.
1335 void countTopics(detail::CacheEntry const& entry, int delta);
1336
1337 /// @brief Sends the queued watch changes, at most one `watch` and one `unwatch`; drops them when there is no
1338 /// watcher.
1339 void flushWatches();
1340
1341 /// @brief Sends one watch request, ignoring its reply: a refused topic simply sends no events.
1342 /// @param kind The kind, `watch` or `unwatch`.
1343 /// @param body The body.
1344 void sendWatch(std::string_view kind, wire::WatchBody const& body) const;
1345
1346 /// @brief Marks every entry but an `evaluate` one stale and refetches the mounted ones, in one batch.
1347 void markAllStale();
1348
1349 /// @brief Marks each entry of @p marks stale and refetches it through a mounted query that uses it.
1350 /// @param marks The entries.
1351 void markAndRefetch(detail::Marks const& marks);
1352
1353 /// @brief Applies one `updates` or `changes` effect of a reply: patches the entries holding the record, or marks
1354 /// them.
1355 /// @param effect The effect.
1356 /// @param record The record it names.
1357 /// @param info The action's catalog entry, for the records its reply holds.
1358 /// @param reply The reply's value.
1359 /// @param use Whether the reply was applied or discarded.
1360 /// @param marks Where entries to mark go.
1361 void applyRecordEffect(ActionEffect const& effect, std::string const& record, ActionInfo const& info,
1362 Value const& reply, ReplyUse use, detail::Marks& marks);
1363
1364 /// @brief Finds the entries a `changes` event's record change names.
1365 /// @param change The change.
1366 /// @param marks Where they go.
1367 void markRecordChange(effects::RecordChange const& change, detail::Marks& marks);
1368
1369 /// @brief Finds the entries a `changes` event's instance change names.
1370 /// @param instance The instance.

1372 void markInstanceChange(wire::InstanceTopic const& instance, detail::Marks& marks);
1373
1374 void settleFailure(detail::CacheEntry& entry, std::string text, std::string kind) {
1375 _runtime->batch([&] {
1376 noteWrite();
1377 entry.error.set(std::move(text));
1378 entry.errorKind.set(std::move(kind));
1379 entry.pending.set(false);
1380 });
1381 }

1519/// @brief An element's live values (spec 5 §6).

1524 : draft{runtime},
1525 committed{runtime},
1526 edited{runtime, false},
1527 touched{runtime, false},
1528 focused{runtime, false},
1529 open{runtime, false},
1530 submitted{runtime, false},
1531 selection{runtime, Value{ValueList{}}},
1532 activeKey{runtime},
1533 checksVersion{runtime, 0},
1534 inner{runtime, nullptr} {}

1536 /// @brief The node.
1537 DocNode const* node = nullptr;
1538 /// @brief The scope that declares it.
1539 RtScope* scope = nullptr;

1541 /// a date-time input's timestamp.

1557 /// @brief A table's last activated key.
1558 reactive::Signal<Value> activeKey;
1559 /// @brief Bumped when a check targeting it comes or goes.

1561 /// @brief A dialog's or drawer's scope while its content is mounted.
1562 reactive::Signal<RtScope*> inner;

1566 /// uncontrolled.

1569 /// errors and the failing checks' messages.
1570 reactive::Computed<Value>* errors = nullptr;
1571 /// @brief A table's rows or a select's options, for its counts and `selectedOption`.

1576 /// unknown or does not build.

1579 /// step's schema is unknown or does not build.

1581};

1583/// @brief One check at run time.
1584struct CheckRuntime {
1585 /// @brief The declaration.
1586 CheckDecl const* decl = nullptr;
1587 /// @brief Whether `assert` is `false`.
1588 reactive::Computed<bool>* failing = nullptr;
1589 /// @brief The message, as text.
1590 reactive::Computed<std::string>* message = nullptr;
1591 /// @brief The elements it targets.
1592 std::vector<ElementState*> targets;
1593
1594 CheckRuntime() = default;
1595 CheckRuntime(CheckRuntime const&) = delete;
1596 CheckRuntime& operator=(CheckRuntime const&) = delete;
1597 CheckRuntime(CheckRuntime&&) = delete;
1598 CheckRuntime& operator=(CheckRuntime&&) = delete;
1599
1600 /// @brief Leaves its targets.
1601 ~CheckRuntime() {
1602 for (ElementState* const target : targets) {
1603 std::erase(target->checks, this);
1604 target->checksVersion.set(target->checksVersion.peek() + 1);
1605 }
1606 }
1607};

1639/// @brief One document scope at run time: the screen, a dialog's or drawer's content, a switch case or a row.
1640///
1641/// It lives while anything that reads it does: the view nodes lowered in it hold it by `shared_ptr`, a reply or
1642/// a timer holds it weakly. It belongs to a `ScreenCore`, which outlives it.
1643class RtScope : public std::enable_shared_from_this<RtScope> {
1644public:
1645 /// @brief An empty scope.
1646 /// @param screen The screen.
1647 /// @param enclosing The enclosing scope; `nullptr` for the screen and a component fallback.
1648 /// @param current The row of a row scope; `nullptr` otherwise.
1649 /// @param depth The reactive scope depth of what it owns.
1650 RtScope(ScreenCore& screen, std::shared_ptr<RtScope> enclosing, reactive::Signal<Value> const* current,
1651 std::size_t depth);
1652
1653 RtScope(RtScope const&) = delete;
1654 RtScope& operator=(RtScope const&) = delete;
1655 RtScope(RtScope&&) = delete;
1656 RtScope& operator=(RtScope&&) = delete;
1657
1658 /// @brief Releases what it owns, and tells the dialog it belongs to.
1659 ~RtScope();
1660
1661 /// @brief Resolves a name, innermost scope first.
1662 /// @param name The name.
1663 /// @return The declaration, or `nullptr`.
1664 [[nodiscard]] NameRef const* find(std::string_view name) const {
1665 for (RtScope const* scope = this; scope != nullptr; scope = scope->parent.get()) {
1666 auto const found = scope->names.find(name);
1667 if (found != scope->names.end()) {
1668 return &found->second;
1669 }
1670 }
1671 return nullptr;
1672 }
1673
1674 /// @brief The innermost row, from this scope outwards.
1675 /// @return The row signal, or `nullptr`.
1676 [[nodiscard]] reactive::Signal<Value> const* innermostRow() const {
1677 for (RtScope const* scope = this; scope != nullptr; scope = scope->parent.get()) {
1678 if (scope->row != nullptr) {
1679 return scope->row;
1680 }
1681 }
1682 return nullptr;
1683 }
1684
1685 /// @brief The innermost scope that decides when errors show and is submitted: a dialog's, or the screen's.
1686 /// @return The scope.
1687 [[nodiscard]] RtScope const& policyScope() const {
1688 RtScope const* scope = this;
1689 while (scope->submitted == nullptr && scope->parent != nullptr) {
1690 scope = scope->parent.get();
1691 }
1692 return *scope;
1693 }
1694
1695 /// @brief Whether every element of the scope is valid and no blocking check of it fails. A tracked read.
1696 /// @return It.
1697 [[nodiscard]] bool ready() const;
1698
1699 /// @brief The screen.
1700 ScreenCore& core;
1701 /// @brief The enclosing scope.
1702 std::shared_ptr<RtScope> parent;
1703 /// @brief The row of a row scope.
1704 reactive::Signal<Value> const* row = nullptr;
1705 /// @brief The dialog or drawer whose content it is.
1706 ElementState* owner = nullptr;
1707 /// @brief `touched`, `submit` or `always`, for a scope that decides it.
1708 std::string showErrors;
1709 /// @brief `submitted` of a scope that decides when errors show.
1710 reactive::Signal<bool>* submitted = nullptr;
1711 /// @brief Its names.
1712 std::map<std::string, NameRef, std::less<>> names;
1713 /// @brief Its state.
1714 std::vector<std::unique_ptr<StateSlot>> states;
1715 /// @brief Its elements, in document order.
1716 std::vector<std::unique_ptr<ElementState>> elements;
1717 /// @brief Its transfers.
1718 std::vector<std::unique_ptr<TransferState>> transfers;
1719 /// @brief Its model aliases.
1720 std::vector<std::unique_ptr<ModelAlias>> models;
1721 /// @brief Its queries.
1722 std::vector<std::unique_ptr<QueryRuntime>> queries;
1723 /// @brief Its mutations.
1724 std::vector<std::unique_ptr<MutationRuntime>> mutations;
1725 /// @brief Its checks.
1726 std::vector<std::unique_ptr<CheckRuntime>> checks;
1727 /// @brief The reactive nodes it owns; declared last, so they go first.
1728 reactive::Scope nodes;
1729};

1731/// @brief The `Environment` the evaluator reads through: a scope chain and the names bound at one place.
1732class ScopeEnv final : public Environment {
1733public:
1734 /// @brief Reads @p scope.
1735 /// @param scope The scope.
1736 /// @param bindings The names bound here; may be `nullptr`.
1737 /// @param row A row to read instead of the scope's (a table's `key`, evaluated before its row scope exists).
1738 ScopeEnv(RtScope const& scope, Bindings const* bindings, Value const* row = nullptr)
1739 : _scope{&scope}, _bindings{bindings}, _row{row} {}
1740
1741 /// @brief Reads a name: a binding, then the scope chain.
1742 /// @param head The name.
1743 /// @param path The path after it.
1744 /// @return The value.
1745 [[nodiscard]] Value ref(std::string_view head, std::span<std::string const> path) const override;
1746
1747 /// @brief Reads the innermost row.
1748 /// @param path The path.
1749 /// @return The value.
1750 [[nodiscard]] Value row(std::span<std::string const> path) const override {
1751 if (_row != nullptr) {
1752 return walk(*_row, path);
1753 }
1754 reactive::Signal<Value> const* const current = _scope->innermostRow();
1755 return current == nullptr ? Value{} : walk(current->get(), path);
1756 }
1757
1758 /// @brief Reads a query or mutation form.
1759 /// @param form The form.
1760 /// @param name The query or mutation.
1761 /// @return The value.
1762 [[nodiscard]] Value control(ExprKind form, std::string_view name) const override;
1763
1764 /// @brief Reads a customization choice.
1765 /// @param point The point.
1766 /// @param path The path.
1767 /// @return The value.
1768 [[nodiscard]] Value pref(std::string_view point, std::span<std::string const> path) const override;
1769
1770 /// @brief Reads `env`, `session` or `host`.
1771 /// @param form The form.
1772 /// @param name The name.

1774 [[nodiscard]] Value client(ExprKind form, std::string_view name) const override;
1775
1776 /// @brief The session's formatting facts.
1777 /// @return They.
1778 [[nodiscard]] FormatContext const& formatting() const override;

1780 /// @brief Reports to the screen's diagnostics.
1781 /// @param path The expression's path.
1782 /// @param reason What went wrong.
1783 void report(std::string_view path, std::string_view reason) const override;

1785private:

1791/// @brief Evaluates an expression in a scope.
1792/// @param scope The scope.
1793/// @param bindings The names bound here; may be `nullptr`.
1794/// @param expr The expression; `nullptr` evaluates to `null`.
1795/// @return The value.
1796[[nodiscard]] inline Value evalIn(RtScope const& scope, Bindings const* bindings, ExprPtr const& expr) {
1797 if (!expr) {
1798 return Value{};
1799 }
1800 ScopeEnv const env{scope, bindings};
1801 return evaluate(*expr, env);
1802}
1803
1804/// @brief Whether a value counts as given for `required`: not `null`, not an empty string or list.
1805/// @param value The value.
1806/// @return It.
1807[[nodiscard]] inline bool engaged(Value const& value) {
1808 if (value.isNull()) {
1809 return false;
1810 }
1811 if (std::string const* const text = value.asString()) {
1812 return !text->empty();
1813 }
1814 if (ValueList const* const items = value.asList()) {
1815 return !items->empty();
1816 }
1817 return true;
1818}
1819
1820/// @brief A value as text for a widget: a string as itself, a number in the locale, a timestamp in ISO 8601,
1821/// `null` as nothing, anything else as JSON.
1822/// @param value The value.
1823/// @param format The formatting facts.
1824/// @return The text.
1825[[nodiscard]] inline std::string textOf(Value const& value, FormatContext const& format) {
1826 if (value.isNull()) {
1827 return {};
1828 }
1829 if (std::string const* const text = value.asString()) {
1830 return *text;
1831 }
1832 if (bool const* const flag = value.asBool()) {
1833 return *flag ? "true" : "false";
1834 }
1835 if (Quantity const* const quantity = value.asQuantity()) {
1836 return formatNumber(value, format.numeric).value_or(std::string{}) + " " +
1837 unitDisplay(quantity->unit, format.units);
1838 }
1839 if (auto number = formatNumber(value, format.numeric)) {
1840 return *std::move(number);
1841 }
1842 if (time::DateTime const* const instant = value.asTimestamp()) {
1843 return instant->toIso8601();
1844 }
1845 return canonicalJson(value);
1846}
1847
1848/// @brief A value as a view key: an `int` or a string as itself, anything else as its JSON text.
1849/// @param value The value.
1850/// @return The key.
1851[[nodiscard]] inline Key keyOf(Value const& value) {
1852 if (std::int64_t const* const number = value.asInt()) {
1853 return Key{*number};
1854 }
1855 if (std::string const* const text = value.asString()) {
1856 return Key{*text};
1857 }
1858 return Key{canonicalJson(value)};
1859}
1860
1861/// @brief A view key as a value.
1862/// @param key The key.
1863/// @return An `int` or a string.
1864[[nodiscard]] inline Value valueOfKey(Key const& key) {
1865 if (std::int64_t const* const number = std::get_if<std::int64_t>(&key)) {
1866 return Value{*number};
1867 }
1868 return Value{std::get<std::string>(key)};
1869}
1870
1871/// @brief A list of strings out of a value: a string, a list of strings, or nothing.
1872/// @param value The value.
1873/// @return The strings.
1874[[nodiscard]] inline std::vector<std::string> stringsOf(Value const& value) {
1875 std::vector<std::string> out;
1876 if (std::string const* const text = value.asString()) {
1877 out.push_back(*text);
1878 } else if (ValueList const* const items = value.asList()) {
1879 for (Value const& item : *items) {
1880 if (std::string const* const element = item.asString()) {
1881 out.push_back(*element);
1882 }
1883 }
1884 }
1885 return out;
1886}
1887
1888/// @brief A list of strings as a value.
1889/// @param texts The strings.
1890/// @return The list.
1891[[nodiscard]] inline Value listOfStrings(std::vector<std::string> const& texts) {
1892 ValueList items;
1893 items.reserve(texts.size());
1894 for (std::string const& text : texts) {
1895 items.emplace_back(text);
1896 }
1897 return Value{std::move(items)};
1898}

1900/// @brief A query at run time (spec 5 §5): a key over the scope, an entry of the session's cache, latest wins.
1901class QueryRuntime {
1902public:
1903 /// @brief A query of @p scope, not yet started.
1904 /// @param decl The declaration.
1905 /// @param scope The scope.
1906 /// @param alias The model alias it goes through.
1907 QueryRuntime(QueryDecl const& decl, RtScope& scope, ModelAlias* alias);
1908
1909 QueryRuntime(QueryRuntime const&) = delete;
1910 QueryRuntime& operator=(QueryRuntime const&) = delete;
1911 QueryRuntime(QueryRuntime&&) = delete;
1912 QueryRuntime& operator=(QueryRuntime&&) = delete;
1913
1914 /// @brief Stops its timers and releases its entry.
1915 ~QueryRuntime();
1916
1917 /// @brief Starts it: makes its key and the Effect that follows it, and its refresh timer.
1918 void start();
1919
1920 /// @brief The value: the entry's, kept from the previous key while the new one has none. A tracked read.
1921 /// @return It.
1922 [[nodiscard]] Value value() const;
1923
1924 /// @brief Whether a request is in flight or waiting out its debounce. A tracked read.
1925 /// @return It.
1926 [[nodiscard]] bool pending() const;
1927
1928 /// @brief The failure's text, `null` when none. A tracked read.
1929 /// @return It.
1930 [[nodiscard]] Value error() const;
1931
1932 /// @brief The failure's kind, `null` when none. A tracked read.
1933 /// @return It.
1934 [[nodiscard]] Value errorKind() const;
1935
1936 /// @brief Whether the query has a value or a failure for its current key, or is idle. A tracked read, for a
1937 /// boundary.
1938 /// @return It.
1939 [[nodiscard]] bool settled() const;
1940
1941 /// @brief Refetches the current key now, ending a debounce wait.
1942 void refetch();
1943
1944 /// @brief Fetches the key its body has now, inside the batch that changed the body: switches to that key's entry
1945 /// when it differs from the current one, and fetches the current one otherwise. A backend switch uses it,
1946 /// so a body `onBackendChange` changed is fetched once, with what the recovery set, and the old key is
1947 /// not fetched first.
1948 void refetchCurrent();
1949
1950 /// @brief Marks its entry stale and refetches it.
1951 void invalidate() {
1952 if (auto const& current = _entry.peek()) {
1953 current->stale = true;
1954 }
1955 refetch();
1956 }
1957
1958 /// @brief Forgets its entry without releasing it: the session dropped the cache.
1959 void detach() {
1960 _entry.set(nullptr);
1961 _carried.set(Value{});
1962 _target = {};
1963 }
1964
1965 /// @brief The current entry. A tracked read.
1966 /// @return It, or `nullptr` while idle.
1967 [[nodiscard]] std::shared_ptr<CacheEntry> const& entry() const { return _entry.get(); }
1968
1969 /// @brief The declaration.
1970 /// @return It.
1971 [[nodiscard]] QueryDecl const& decl() const noexcept { return *_decl; }
1972
1973 /// @brief The model type.
1974 /// @return It.
1975 [[nodiscard]] std::string const& typeId() const noexcept { return _typeId; }
1976
1977 /// @brief The channel its alias is bound to now.
1978 /// @return It, or `nullptr` while the alias is unbound.
1979 [[nodiscard]] std::shared_ptr<ModelChannel> channel() const;
1980
1981private:
1982 /// @brief What a key evaluates to: the cache entry it names and the body, or idle.
1983 struct Target {
1984 bool idle = true;
1985 std::string token;
1986 Value body;
1987 std::string bodyText;
1988 bool operator==(Target const& other) const {
1989 return idle == other.idle && token == other.token && bodyText == other.bodyText;
1990 }
1991 };
1992
1993 void switchTo(Target const& target);
1994
1995 QueryDecl const* _decl;
1996 std::string _typeId;
1997 RtScope* _scope;
1998 ModelAlias* _alias;
1999 reactive::Signal<std::shared_ptr<CacheEntry>> _entry;
2000 reactive::Signal<Value> _carried;
2001 reactive::Signal<bool> _waiting;
2002 Target _target;
2003 Target _pendingTarget;
2004 // The query's key, owned by its scope's nodes; set once `start` made it.
2005 reactive::Computed<Target> const* _key = nullptr;
2006 reactive::TimerHandle _debounce;
2007 reactive::TimerHandle _refresh;
2008 std::shared_ptr<bool> _alive = std::make_shared<bool>(true);
2009};

2011/// @brief One run of a mutation, as a command sees it: whether it succeeded, and the reply.
2012using RunDone = std::function<void(bool succeeded, Value const& reply)>;
2013
2014/// @brief A mutation at run time (spec 5 §5): concurrency, optimistic writes and the reply's effects.
2015class MutationRuntime {
2016public:
2017 /// @brief A mutation of @p scope.
2018 /// @param decl The declaration.
2019 /// @param scope The scope.
2020 /// @param alias The model alias it goes through.
2021 MutationRuntime(MutationDecl const& decl, RtScope& scope, ModelAlias* alias);
2022
2023 MutationRuntime(MutationRuntime const&) = delete;
2024 MutationRuntime& operator=(MutationRuntime const&) = delete;
2025 MutationRuntime(MutationRuntime&&) = delete;
2026 MutationRuntime& operator=(MutationRuntime&&) = delete;
2027
2028 /// @brief Drops the replies still to come.
2029 ~MutationRuntime();
2030
2031 /// @brief Runs it, queues the run or refuses it, as its concurrency says.
2032 /// @param body The body.
2033 /// @param bindings The names bound where the run was started, for `onSuccess` and `onError`.
2034 /// @param done Called once the run settles, or at once when it is refused.
2035 void run(Value body, std::shared_ptr<Bindings const> bindings, RunDone done);
2036
2037 /// @brief Whether a run is in flight or queued. A tracked read.
2038 /// @return It.
2039 [[nodiscard]] bool pending() const { return _inFlight.get() > 0; }
2040
2041 /// @brief The last applied result. A tracked read.
2042 /// @return It.
2043 [[nodiscard]] Value result() const { return _result.get(); }
2044
2045 /// @brief The last applied failure's text, or `null`. A tracked read.
2046 /// @return It.
2047 [[nodiscard]] Value error() const { return _error.get(); }
2048
2049 /// @brief The last applied failure's kind, or `null`. A tracked read.
2050 /// @return It.
2051 [[nodiscard]] Value errorKind() const { return _errorKind.get(); }
2052
2053 /// @brief The declaration.
2054 /// @return It.
2055 [[nodiscard]] MutationDecl const& decl() const noexcept { return *_decl; }
2056
2057 /// @brief The model type.
2058 /// @return It.
2059 [[nodiscard]] std::string const& typeId() const noexcept { return _typeId; }
2060
2061private:
2062 struct Run {
2063 std::uint64_t id = 0;
2064 Value body;
2065 std::shared_ptr<Bindings const> bindings;
2066 RunDone done;
2067 std::string serialKey;
2068 std::vector<std::shared_ptr<CacheEntry>> layered;
2069 };
2070
2071 void send(std::shared_ptr<Run> const& run);
2072 void settle(std::shared_ptr<Run> const& run, std::optional<Value> reply, std::exception_ptr const& error);
2073 void next(std::string const& serialKey);
2074 void applyOptimistic(Run& run);
2075 void dropLayers(Run& run);
2076
2077 MutationDecl const* _decl;
2078 RtScope* _scope;
2079 ModelAlias* _alias;
2080 std::string _typeId;
2081 ScreenCore* _core;
2082 reactive::Signal<int> _inFlight;
2083 reactive::Signal<Value> _result;
2084 reactive::Signal<Value> _error;
2085 reactive::Signal<Value> _errorKind;
2086 std::uint64_t _runs = 0;
2087 std::uint64_t _latest = 0;
2088 std::map<std::string, std::deque<std::shared_ptr<Run>>, std::less<>> _queues;
2089 std::set<std::string, std::less<>> _busy;
2090 std::shared_ptr<bool> _alive = std::make_shared<bool>(true);
2091};

2263/// @brief One mounted screen's interpreter: its document, diagnostics, slots and preferences, and the code that
2264/// declares scopes, lowers nodes and runs commands.
2265class ScreenCore {
2266public:
2267 /// @brief The core of a screen about to mount.
2268 /// @param doc The document.
2269 /// @param owner The session.
2270 /// @param calls The dispatcher.
2271 /// @param options The interpreter's options.
2272 /// @param mount The mount's options.
2273 ScreenCore(std::shared_ptr<Document const> doc, Session& owner, Dispatcher& calls,
2274 InterpreterOptions const& options, MountOptions const& mount)
2275 : session{owner},
2276 dispatcher{calls},
2277 host{options.host},
2278 onDiagnostic{options.diagnostics},
2279 borrowed{mount.borrowed},
2280 depth{mount.depth},
2281 prefs{session.runtime()},
2282 submitted{session.runtime(), false},
2283 pendingWork{session.runtime(), 0},
2284 recording{owner.options().developmentTools == DevelopmentTools::On},
2285 _doc{std::move(doc)} {
2286 ValueRecord defaults;
2287 for (auto const& [name, point] : _doc->customize) {
2288 defaults.insert_or_assign(name, point.defaultValue);
2289 }
2290 prefDefaults = defaults;
2291 prefs.set(std::move(defaults));
2292 session.attachScreen(*this);
2293 }

2295 ScreenCore(ScreenCore const&) = delete;

2297 ScreenCore(ScreenCore&&) = delete;
2298 ScreenCore& operator=(ScreenCore&&) = delete;
2299 /// @brief Takes the screen off the session, so a later backend switch does not run its `onBackendChange`.
2300 ~ScreenCore() { session.detachScreen(*this); }

2302 /// @brief Runs a lifecycle list in the document's own scope, as a screen's or app document's own command list.
2303 /// @param key The lifecycle key, such as `onBackendChange`.
2304 void runLifecycleOf(std::string_view key) {
2305 auto const found = _doc->lifecycle.find(key);
2306 auto const scope = rootScope.lock();
2307 if (found == _doc->lifecycle.end() || !scope) {
2308 return;
2309 }
2310 CommandCtx const ctx{.scope = scope,
2311 .bindings = std::make_shared<Bindings>(),
2312 .cancelClose = std::make_shared<bool>(false),
2313 .boundary = nullptr};
2314 runList(found->second, ctx, {});
2315 }

2317 /// @brief The document.
2318 /// @return It.
2319 [[nodiscard]] Document const& doc() const noexcept { return *_doc; }
2320
2321 /// @brief The runtime.
2322 /// @return It.
2323 [[nodiscard]] reactive::Runtime& runtime() const noexcept { return session.runtime(); }
2324
2325 /// @brief Reports a diagnostic once per path.
2326 /// @param path Where.
2327 /// @param reason What.
2328 void report(std::string_view path, std::string_view reason) {
2329 if (inspecting) {
2330 return;
2331 }
2332 std::string key = std::string{path} + '\x1f' + std::string{reason};
2333 if (!reported.insert(std::move(key)).second) {
2334 return;
2335 }
2336 Refusal const refusal{.document = _doc->id, .path = std::string{path}, .reason = std::string{reason}};
2337 diagnostics.push_back(refusal);
2338 if (onDiagnostic) {
2339 onDiagnostic(refusal);
2340 }
2341 }

2343 /// @brief The next slot id: the interpreter numbers every bound property of the document.
2344 /// @return It.

2347 // --- Declaring a scope -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

2349 /// @brief Declares a scope's names and starts its reactive parts.
2350 /// @param scope The scope.
2351 /// @param decl Its declarations; `nullptr` when it declares none.
2352 /// @param content The nodes whose elements belong to it.
2353 /// @param commands The command lists whose transfers belong to it.
2354 void declare(RtScope& scope, ScopeDecl const* decl, std::vector<DocNode const*> const& content,
2355 std::vector<Commands const*> const& commands);
2356
2357 /// @brief Makes a state's signal from its init, once.
2358 /// @param scope The scope that declares it.
2359 /// @param slot The state.
2360 void initState(RtScope const& scope, StateSlot& slot) const {
2361 if (slot.value || slot.initializing) {
2362 return;
2363 }
2364 if (std::optional<Value> keptValue = keptState(scope, *slot.decl)) {
2365 slot.value = std::make_unique<reactive::Signal<Value>>(runtime(), std::move(*keptValue));
2366 return;
2367 }
2368 slot.initializing = true;
2369 Value init = runtime().untracked([&] { return evalIn(scope, nullptr, slot.decl->init); });
2370 slot.value = std::make_unique<reactive::Signal<Value>>(runtime(), std::move(init));
2371 slot.initializing = false;
2372 }

2378 [[nodiscard]] Value elementValue(ElementState const& element, std::string_view name) const;

2387 /// @brief Runs a command list: each command in order in one batch; done when every command in it is.
2388 /// @param commands The list.
2389 /// @param ctx Where it runs.
2390 /// @param done Called once, with whether every command succeeded; may be empty.

2393 /// @brief Runs one command.

2397 void runOne(Command const& command, CommandCtx const& ctx, Done done);
2398
2399 /// @brief Runs a command list for an event of the user's.
2400 /// @param commands The list; `nullptr` runs nothing.
2401 /// @param ctx Where it was lowered.
2402 /// @param event The event's payload.
2403 void runEvent(Commands const* commands, LowerCtx const& ctx, Value event) {
2404 if (commands == nullptr || commands->empty()) {
2405 return;
2406 }
2407 auto bindings = std::make_shared<Bindings>(*ctx.bindings);
2408 bindings->push_back(Binding{.name = "event", .read = [event = std::move(event)] { return event; }});
2409 CommandCtx const command{.scope = ctx.scope,
2410 .bindings = std::move(bindings),
2411 .cancelClose = std::make_shared<bool>(false),
2412 .boundary = ctx.boundary};
2413 session.asUser([&] { runtime().batch([&] { runList(*commands, command, {}); }); });
2414 }

2421 [[nodiscard]] ActionModels lowerActionParts(std::span<DocNodePtr const> parts, LowerCtx const& ctx);

2427 [[nodiscard]] static Node actionBarOf(ActionModels actions);

2437 /// @brief Lowers a document node to a view node.
2438 /// @param node The node.
2439 /// @param ctx Where.
2440 /// @return The view node.
2441 [[nodiscard]] Node lower(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx);
2442
2443 /// @brief Lowers a node list into one node: the node itself, or a column of them.
2444 /// @param nodes The nodes.
2445 /// @param ctx Where.
2446 /// @return The node.
2447 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-no-recursion): one level per nested node of the document.
2448 [[nodiscard]] Node lowerAll(std::span<DocNodePtr const> nodes, LowerCtx const& ctx) {
2449 if (nodes.size() == 1) {
2450 return lower(*nodes.front(), ctx);
2451 }
2452 Column column;
2453 for (DocNodePtr const& child : nodes) {
2454 column.children.push_back(lower(*child, ctx));
2455 }
2456 return ui::column(std::move(column));
2457 }

2460 // scopes and runtimes read and write directly.

2470 /// unmounting.

2474 /// @brief The screen scope's reactive depth.

2476 /// @brief The diagnostics reported, in order.

2486 /// @brief The open dialogs and drawers, the mutation runs and the transfers in flight, across every scope of the

2490 bool const recording;

2492 /// @brief Counts pending work in or out.
2493 /// @param delta What started (positive) or ended (negative).

2495 /// @brief The document's own scope, once mounted.
2496 std::weak_ptr<RtScope> rootScope;
2497 /// @brief A state of the screen this one replaces: its declared type's name and its value.
2498 struct KeptState {
2499 /// @brief The declared type's name.
2500 std::string type;
2501 /// @brief The value.
2502 Value value;
2503 };
2504 /// @brief The states of the own scope of the screen this one replaces, by name (`MountOptions::keepStateOf`).
2505 std::map<std::string, KeptState, std::less<>> keptStates;
2506 /// @brief A node as it was lowered, which the inspector lists while its scope lives.
2507 struct LoweredNode {
2508 /// @brief The node.
2509 DocNode const* node = nullptr;
2510 /// @brief The scope it was lowered in.
2511 std::weak_ptr<RtScope> scope;
2512 /// @brief The names bound where it was lowered.
2513 std::weak_ptr<Bindings const> bindings;
2514 };
2515 /// @brief Every node lowered, in lowering order; an entry whose scope is gone is pruned as more are added.
2516 std::vector<LoweredNode> loweredNodes;
2517 /// @brief The screen's live scopes, in creation order.
2518 std::vector<RtScope*> scopes;
2519 /// @brief The latest command lists run, oldest first, at most `kCommandLogSize`.
2520 std::deque<CommandLogEntry> commandLog;
2521 /// @brief Set while the inspector evaluates, so that an expression error it meets is not reported.
2522 bool inspecting = false;
2523 // NOLINTEND(cppcoreguidelines-non-private-member-variables-in-classes)
2524
2525 /// @brief The value a state of the screen's own scope keeps from the screen it replaces: that screen's value of
2526 /// the state of the same name, when its declared type is the same and admits it.
2527 /// @param scope The scope that declares the state.
2528 /// @param decl The declaration.
2529 /// @return The value, or nothing for a state that starts from its init.
2530 [[nodiscard]] std::optional<Value> keptState(RtScope const& scope, StateDecl const& decl) const {
2531 if (keptStates.empty() || rootScope.lock().get() != &scope) {
2532 return std::nullopt;
2533 }
2534 auto const found = keptStates.find(decl.name);
2535 if (found == keptStates.end() || found->second.type != decl.type.name() ||
2536 !decl.type.admits(found->second.value)) {
2537 return std::nullopt;
2538 }
2539 return found->second.value;
2540 }

2606 /// @brief A bound property: a constant for a literal, a numbered slot otherwise.
2607 template <typename T, typename Convert>
2608 Prop<T> bindProp(LowerCtx const& ctx, ExprPtr const& expr, T fallback, Convert convert) {
2609 if (!expr) {
2610 return Prop<T>{std::move(fallback)};
2611 }
2612 if (expr->kind == ExprKind::Literal) {
2613 return Prop<T>{convert(expr->literal, session.formatting())};
2614 }
2615 return Prop<T>{ui::slot(
2616 nextSlot(), [scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, expr, convert, session = &session]() -> T {
2617 return convert(evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), expr), session->formatting());
2618 })};
2619 }
2620
2621 /// @brief A text's role: a literal one as the loader checked it; a computed one evaluated in its slot, where a
2622 /// name of no role is reported once for its path and drawn `Normal`.
2623 Prop<TextRole> roleProp(LowerCtx const& ctx, ExprPtr const& expr);
2624
2625 /// @brief A property read through @p read, as a numbered slot.
2626 template <typename T, typename Read>
2627 Prop<T> slotProp(Read read) {
2628 return Prop<T>{ui::slot(nextSlot(), std::move(read))};
2629 }
2630
2631 /// @brief Evaluates an expression once, untracked: a property the view tree sets once.
2632 [[nodiscard]] Value once(LowerCtx const& ctx, ExprPtr const& expr) const {
2633 return runtime().untracked([&] { return evalIn(*ctx.scope, ctx.bindings.get(), expr); });
2634 }
2635
2636 /// @brief Keeps a command list in the inspector's log.
2637 void logList(Commands const& commands) {
2638 CommandLogEntry entry{.event = {}, .commands = {}, .batch = runtime().core()->currentBatch()};
2639 std::string_view const first = commands.front().path;
2640 entry.event = std::string{first.substr(0, first.rfind('/') == std::string_view::npos ? 0 : first.rfind('/'))};
2641 for (Command const& command : commands) {
2642 entry.commands.push_back(
2643 LoggedCommand{.kind = commandKey(command.kind), .target = command.target, .path = command.path});
2644 }
2645 if (commandLog.size() == kCommandLogSize) {
2646 commandLog.pop_front();
2647 }
2648 commandLog.push_back(std::move(entry));
2649 }
2650
2651 std::shared_ptr<Document const> _doc;
2652 SlotId _slots = 1;
2653 /// @brief Expires with the screen, so a reply that arrives after it is gone reports nothing.
2654 std::shared_ptr<bool> _alive = std::make_shared<bool>(true);
2655};
