2691/// @brief A mounted screen: its scopes, its view mounted through `Mounted`, and what its host asks of it.
2692///
2693/// Neither copyable nor movable. It belongs to the runtime's owner; the runtime, the session, the dispatcher and
2694/// the backend outlive it. Destroying it runs `onUnmount`, unmounts the view and releases every scope.
2695class Screen {
2696public:
2697 Screen(Screen const&) = delete;
2698 Screen& operator=(Screen const&) = delete;
2699 Screen(Screen&&) = delete;
2700 Screen& operator=(Screen&&) = delete;
2701
2702 /// @brief Runs `onUnmount`, then unmounts.
2703 ~Screen() {
2704 try {
2705 if (Commands const* const commands = lifecycleList("onUnmount")) {
2706 runCommands(*commands);
2707 }
2708 } catch (...) { // NOLINT(bugprone-empty-catch): a destructor has no one to report to.
2709 }
2710 _core->focusElement = {};
2711 _mounted.reset();
2712 _headActions.clear();
2713 _headStatus.clear();
2714 _scope.reset();
2715 }
2716
2717 /// @brief The root widget.
2718 /// @return It, valid as long as the screen.
2719 [[nodiscard]] Widget& root() const {
2720 if (!_mounted) {
2721 throw std::logic_error{"the screen is not mounted"};
2722 }
2723 return _mounted->root();
2724 }
2725
2726 /// @brief The document's id.
2727 /// @return It.
2728 [[nodiscard]] std::string const& id() const noexcept { return _core->doc().id; }
2729
2730 /// @brief Evaluates an expression in the screen's scope: what a host reads (`title`, `identity`), and what a
2731 /// test inspects.
2732 /// @param expression The expression's JSON.
2733 /// @return The value; `null` for an expression that does not parse.
2734 [[nodiscard]] Value read(Json const& expression) const {
2735 auto parsed = parseExpression(expression);
2736 if (!parsed) {
2737 return Value{};
2738 }
2739 return detail::evalIn(*_scope, nullptr, *parsed);
2740 }
2741
2742 /// @brief Evaluates the document's `title`.
2743 /// @return It, or `null`.
2744 [[nodiscard]] Value title() const { return detail::evalIn(*_scope, nullptr, _core->doc().title); }
2745
2746 /// @brief Evaluates the document's `identity`.
2747 /// @return It, or `null`.
2748 [[nodiscard]] Value identity() const { return detail::evalIn(*_scope, nullptr, _core->doc().identity); }
2749
2750 /// @brief Evaluates the document's `subtitle`, the head's line under the title.
2751 /// @return It, or `null`.
2752 [[nodiscard]] Value subtitle() const { return detail::evalIn(*_scope, nullptr, _core->doc().subtitle); }
2753
2754 /// @brief The head's status badges that are visible now, in order. A tracked read.
2755 /// @return They.
2756 [[nodiscard]] std::vector<HeadBadge> status() const {
2757 std::vector<HeadBadge> shown;
2758 for (detail::BadgeModel const& badge : _headStatus) {
2759 if (badge.visible.evaluate()) {
2760 shown.push_back(HeadBadge{
2761 .text = badge.text.evaluate(), .tone = badge.tone.evaluate(), .icon = badge.icon.evaluate()});
2762 }
2763 }
2764 return shown;
2765 }
2766
2767 /// @brief The head's actions that are visible now, in order, each with whether it is enabled. A tracked read.
2768 /// @return They.
2769 [[nodiscard]] std::vector<HeadAction> actions() const {
2770 std::vector<HeadAction> shown;
2771 for (detail::ActionModel const& action : _headActions) {
2772 if (action.visible.evaluate()) {
2773 shown.push_back(HeadAction{.id = action.id,
2774 .label = action.label.evaluate(),
2775 .icon = action.icon.evaluate(),
2776 .emphasis = action.emphasis,
2777 .enabled = action.enabled.evaluate()});
2778 }
2779 }
2780 return shown;
2781 }
2782
2783 /// @brief Runs a head action's `onClick` as a user event in the screen scope, in one batch.
2784 /// @param actionId The action's id.
2785 /// @return Whether it ran: `false`, with a diagnostic, for an id the head does not hold, or holds hidden or
2786 /// disabled.
2787 bool runAction(std::string_view actionId) {
2788 auto const found = std::ranges::find(_headActions, actionId, &detail::ActionModel::id);
2789 if (found == _headActions.end()) {
2790 _core->report("/actions", "head action " + std::string{actionId} + " is unknown");
2791 return false;
2792 }
2793 auto const [visible, enabled] =
2794 runtime().untracked([&] { return std::pair{found->visible.evaluate(), found->enabled.evaluate()}; });
2795 if (!visible || !enabled) {
2796 _core->report(found->path, "head action " + found->id + (visible ? " is disabled" : " is hidden"));
2797 return false;
2798 }
2799 if (found->run) {
2800 found->run();
2801 }
2802 return true;
2803 }
2804
2805 /// @brief Evaluates the document's `dirty`.
2806 /// @return Whether it is `true`.
2807 [[nodiscard]] bool dirty() const {
2808 Value const value = detail::evalIn(*_scope, nullptr, _core->doc().dirty);
2809 bool const* const flag = value.asBool();
2810 return flag != nullptr && *flag;
2811 }

2813 /// @brief Whether the screen has work a close waits for: an open dialog or drawer, a mutation run, or an upload or
2814 /// download in flight, in any of its scopes (spec 6 §3). A tracked read, so an Effect that reads it runs
2815 /// again when it changes.
2816 /// @return It.
2817 [[nodiscard]] bool pending() const { return _core->pendingWork.get() > 0; }

2819 /// @brief The reactive runtime the screen runs on.

2821 [[nodiscard]] reactive::Runtime& runtime() const noexcept { return _core->runtime(); }

2823 /// @brief Runs `onClose`, as the host does before it closes the screen.
2824 /// @return False when `onClose` ran `cancelClose`: the screen stays open.
2825 bool requestClose() {
2826 std::shared_ptr<bool const> const cancelled = beginClose();
2827 return cancelled == nullptr || !*cancelled;
2828 }
2829
2830 /// @brief Runs `onClose`, and hands back the flag its `cancelClose` sets.
2831 ///
2832 /// The flag is shared with every command list `onClose` starts, such as the `onResult` of a confirm dialog it
2833 /// opens, so it can still be set after this returns; a host reads it once the screen is no longer `pending()`.
2834 /// @return The flag, or `nullptr` when the document declares no `onClose`.
2835 [[nodiscard]] std::shared_ptr<bool const> beginClose() {
2836 Commands const* const commands = lifecycleList("onClose");
2837 if (commands == nullptr) {
2838 return nullptr;
2839 }
2840 return runCommandsFlag(*commands);
2841 }
2842
2843 /// @brief Whether the document declares a lifecycle command list.
2844 /// @param key The key: `onClose`, `onSave`, …
2845 /// @return It.
2846 [[nodiscard]] bool declares(std::string_view key) const { return lifecycleList(key) != nullptr; }
2847
2848 /// @brief Runs a lifecycle command list: `onSave`, `onBackendChange`, or any other the document declares.
2849 /// @param key The key.
2850 void runLifecycle(std::string_view key) {
2851 if (Commands const* const commands = lifecycleList(key)) {
2852 runCommands(*commands);
2853 }
2854 }

2856 /// @brief The diagnostics reported so far, each path and reason once.
2857 /// @return They.
2858 [[nodiscard]] std::vector<Refusal> const& diagnostics() const noexcept { return _core->diagnostics; }
2859
2860 /// @brief Sets the user's choice at a customization point, as the preferences store loaded or the user made
2861 /// it. A choice that does not fit the point is ignored (spec 5 §12b).
2862 /// @param point The point.
2863 /// @param value The choice.
2864 /// @return Whether it fits and was taken.
2865 bool setPreference(std::string const& point, Value value) {
2866 auto const found = _core->doc().customize.find(point);
2867 if (found == _core->doc().customize.end() || !fits(found->second, value)) {
2868 return false;
2869 }
2870 ValueRecord prefs = _core->prefs.peek();
2871 prefs.insert_or_assign(point, std::move(value));
2872 _core->prefs.set(std::move(prefs));
2873 return true;
2874 }

2876 /// @brief The screen's document, whose `customize` block names the points a preferences store loads.
2877 /// @return It.
2878 [[nodiscard]] Document const& document() const noexcept { return _core->doc(); }

2880 /// @brief What an alias of this screen lends to a screen it opens that borrows it.
2881 /// @param alias The alias.
2882 /// @return Its channel and token; an empty channel when it has none.
2883 [[nodiscard]] BorrowedModel lend(std::string_view alias) const;

2886 friend class Interpreter;
2887 friend class Inspector;

2889 Screen() = default;

2891 /// The states of the screen's own scope that have a value, by name: what a screen that replaces it keeps.
2892 [[nodiscard]] std::map<std::string, detail::ScreenCore::KeptState, std::less<>> ownState() const {
2893 std::map<std::string, detail::ScreenCore::KeptState, std::less<>> states;
2894 for (auto const& slot : _scope->states) {
2895 if (slot->value) {
2896 states.insert_or_assign(
2897 slot->decl->name,
2898 detail::ScreenCore::KeptState{.type = slot->decl->type.name(), .value = slot->value->peek()});
2899 }
2900 }
2901 return states;
2902 }
2903
2904 [[nodiscard]] Commands const* lifecycleList(std::string_view key) const {
2905 auto const found = _core->doc().lifecycle.find(key);
2906 return found == _core->doc().lifecycle.end() ? nullptr : &found->second;
2907 }
2908
2909 /// Runs a command list as the screen's own (not a user's); returns whether it ran `cancelClose`.
2910 bool runCommands(Commands const& commands) { return *runCommandsFlag(commands); }
2911
2912 /// Runs a command list as the screen's own; returns the `cancelClose` flag it and what it starts share.
2913 std::shared_ptr<bool const> runCommandsFlag(Commands const& commands) {
2914 detail::CommandCtx const ctx{.scope = _scope,
2915 .bindings = std::make_shared<detail::Bindings>(),
2916 .cancelClose = std::make_shared<bool>(false),
2917 .boundary = nullptr};
2918 _core->runtime().batch([&] { _core->runList(commands, ctx, {}); });
2919 return ctx.cancelClose;
2920 }
2921
2922 [[nodiscard]] static bool fits(CustomizePoint const& point, Value const& value) {
2923 if (point.kind == "choice") {
2924 std::string const* const text = value.asString();
2925 return text != nullptr && listed(std::span<std::string const>{point.options}, *text);
2926 }
2927 if (point.kind == "value") {
2928 return point.type.admits(value);
2929 }
2930 return true;
2931 }
2932
2933 [[nodiscard]] static bool listed(std::span<std::string const> options, std::string const& text) {
2934 return std::ranges::find(options, text) != options.end();
2935 }
2936
2937 std::unique_ptr<detail::ScreenCore> _core;
2938 std::shared_ptr<detail::RtScope> _scope;
2939 std::optional<Mounted> _mounted;
2940 // The head's parts, bound in the screen scope.
2941 std::vector<detail::BadgeModel> _headStatus;
2942 detail::ActionModels _headActions;
2943};
2944
2945/// @brief The app document mounted as the root scope every screen of the session shares (spec 6 §5).
2946///
2947/// Its state, lets, queries and mutations live once for the session. A screen reads them as `{"ref": "app.name"}`,
2948/// a binding on one updates, and `{"set": "app.name", …}` writes the app document's state. A query of the app
2949/// document runs once however many screens read it. Destroying the root runs its `onUnmount`, takes its scope off the
2950/// session and releases its model instances; a host does that before it clears the session on sign-out.
2951class AppRoot {
2952public:
2953 AppRoot(AppRoot const&) = delete;
2954 AppRoot& operator=(AppRoot const&) = delete;
2955 AppRoot(AppRoot&&) = delete;
2956 AppRoot& operator=(AppRoot&&) = delete;
2957
2958 /// @brief Runs `onUnmount`, takes the scope off the session, and releases everything.
2959 ~AppRoot() {
2960 try {
2961 if (auto const found = _core->doc().lifecycle.find("onUnmount"); found != _core->doc().lifecycle.end()) {
2962 runCommands(found->second);
2963 }
2964 } catch (...) { // NOLINT(bugprone-empty-catch): a destructor has no one to report to.
2965 }
2966 _core->session.setAppScope(nullptr);
2967 _scope.reset();
2968 }
2969
2970 /// @brief Evaluates an expression in the app document's scope.
2971 /// @param expression The expression's JSON.
2972 /// @return Its value; `null` for an expression that does not parse.
2973 [[nodiscard]] Value read(Json const& expression) const {
2974 auto parsed = parseExpression(expression);
2975 if (!parsed) {
2976 return Value{};
2977 }
2978 return detail::evalIn(*_scope, nullptr, *parsed);
2979 }
2980
2981 /// @brief The diagnostics reported so far.
2982 /// @return They.
2983 [[nodiscard]] std::vector<Refusal> const& diagnostics() const noexcept { return _core->diagnostics; }
2984
2985private:
2986 friend class Interpreter;
2987
2988 AppRoot() = default;
2989
2990 void runCommands(Commands const& commands) {
2991 detail::CommandCtx const ctx{.scope = _scope,
2992 .bindings = std::make_shared<detail::Bindings>(),
2993 .cancelClose = std::make_shared<bool>(false),
2994 .boundary = nullptr};
2995 _core->runtime().batch([&] { _core->runList(commands, ctx, {}); });
2996 }
2997
2998 std::unique_ptr<detail::ScreenCore> _core;
2999 std::shared_ptr<detail::RtScope> _scope;
3000};
3001
3002/// @brief Mounts UI documents (spec 5): one per client process or window, over a session and a dispatcher.
3003class Interpreter {
3004public:
3005 /// @brief An interpreter.
3006 /// @param session The session the screens share. Borrowed.
3007 /// @param dispatcher Where model calls go. Borrowed.
3008 /// @param options The host and the diagnostic callback.
3009 Interpreter(Session& session MORPH_LIFETIMEBOUND, Dispatcher& dispatcher MORPH_LIFETIMEBOUND,
3010 InterpreterOptions options = {})
3011 : _session{&session}, _dispatcher{&dispatcher}, _options{std::move(options)} {}
3012
3013 /// @brief Mounts a screen.
3014 ///
3015 /// The document has loaded (`loadDocument`); what mounting adds is what only the opener knows: the params, and
3016 /// the models a `{"from": alias}` instance borrows. A param that is missing and not optional, a param of the
3017 /// wrong type, a borrowed model the opener did not lend and a document without a view are refused.
3018 /// @param doc The document.
3019 /// @param params The params, by name; names the document does not declare are ignored.
3020 /// @param backend The backend to mount on. Borrowed: it outlives the screen.
3021 /// @param options Where to mount, and the models lent.
3022 /// @return The screen, or the refusal.
3023 [[nodiscard]] std::expected<std::unique_ptr<Screen>, Refusal> mount(std::shared_ptr<Document const> doc,
3024 ValueRecord const& params,
3025 IViewBackend& backend,
3026 MountOptions const& options = {});
3027
3028 /// @brief Mounts the app document as the session's root scope (spec 6 §5).
3029 ///
3030 /// Refused: a document whose id is not `app`, and a second app document while one is mounted on the session.
3031 /// @param doc The app document, loaded.
3032 /// @return The root, or the refusal. Keep it as long as the session's screens may read `app.*`.
3033 [[nodiscard]] std::expected<std::unique_ptr<AppRoot>, Refusal> mountApp(std::shared_ptr<Document const> doc);
3034
3035private:
3036 Session* _session;
3037 Dispatcher* _dispatcher;
3038 InterpreterOptions _options;
3039};

3045inline void Session::backendChanged(std::string const& backend) {
3046 _runtime->batch([this, &backend] {
3047 std::vector<detail::ScreenCore*> const screens = _screens;
3048 for (detail::ScreenCore* const screen : screens) {
3049 if (std::ranges::find(_screens, screen) != _screens.end()) {
3050 screen->runLifecycleOf("onBackendChange");
3051 }
3052 }
3053 ValueRecord env = _env.peek();
3054 env.insert_or_assign("backend", Value{backend});
3055 _env.set(std::move(env));
3056 for (auto const& [key, entry] : _entries) {
3057 static_cast<void>(key);
3058 markStale(*entry);
3059 }
3060 std::vector<detail::QueryRuntime*> const mounted = _mounted;
3061 for (detail::QueryRuntime* const query : mounted) {
3062 query->refetchCurrent();
3063 }
3064 });
3065}
3066
3067inline void Session::refetchMounted(detail::CacheEntry const& entry) {
3068 std::vector<detail::QueryRuntime*> const mounted = _mounted;
3069 for (detail::QueryRuntime* const query : mounted) {
3070 if (_runtime->untracked([query] { return query->entry(); }).get() == &entry) {
3071 query->refetchCurrent();
3072 }
3073 }
3074}
3075
3076// NOLINTNEXTLINE(bugprone-easily-swappable-parameters): a model type and an action id, as every caller names them.
3077inline void Session::applyReplyEffects(std::string const& typeId, std::string const& actionId, Value const& reply,
3078 ReplyUse use, std::string const& instanceToken) {
3079 if (!_options.catalog.action) {
3080 return;
3081 }
3082 std::optional<ActionInfo> const info = _options.catalog.action(actionId);
3083 if (!info || !info->effects) {
3084 return;
3085 }
3086 detail::Marks marks;
3087 for (ActionEffect const& effect : *info->effects) {
3088 if (effect.kind == "changesInstance") {
3089 for (auto const& [key, entry] : _entries) {
3090 static_cast<void>(key);
3091 if (!entry->evaluate && entry->typeId == typeId && entry->instanceToken == instanceToken) {
3092 marks.add(*entry);
3093 }
3094 }
3095 } else if (effect.record && (effect.kind == "updates" || effect.kind == "changes")) {
3096 applyRecordEffect(effect, *effect.record, *info, reply, use, marks);
3097 }
3098 }
3099 markAndRefetch(marks);
3100}
3101
3102inline void Session::applyRecordEffect(ActionEffect const& effect, std::string const& record, ActionInfo const& info,
3103 Value const& reply, ReplyUse use, detail::Marks& marks) {
3104 // The reply's rows of the record, by key; none when the reply does not hold it keyed, or must only mark.
3105 auto const own = std::ranges::find(info.records, record, &ActionRecordInfo::record);
3106 std::optional<std::string> const ownKey =
3107 effect.kind == "updates" && use == ReplyUse::Applied && own != info.records.end() ? own->keyField
3108 : std::nullopt;
3109 detail::RowsByKey rows;
3110 if (ownKey) {
3111 for (Value const* const row : detail::keyedRowsOf(reply, own->paths, *ownKey)) {
3112 rows.insert_or_assign(detail::canonicalJson(*row->field(*ownKey)), row);
3113 }
3114 }
3115 for (auto const& [key, entry] : _entries) {
3116 static_cast<void>(key);
3117 ActionRecordInfo const* const held = entry->holding(record);
3118 if (held == nullptr) {
3119 continue;
3120 }
3121 if (!ownKey || !held->keyField) {
3122 marks.add(*entry);
3123 continue;
3124 }
3125 if (auto patched = detail::patchHeldRows(entry->confirmed, held->paths, *held->keyField, rows)) {
3126 confirm(*entry, *patched);
3127 }
3128 // A fetch in flight may have read before the write, and would settle over the patch.
3129 if (entry->pending.peek()) {
3130 markStale(*entry);
3131 }
3132 }
3133}
3134
3135inline void Session::markAndRefetch(detail::Marks const& marks) {
3136 for (detail::CacheEntry* const entry : marks.entries) {
3137 markStale(*entry);
3138 }
3139 for (detail::CacheEntry const* const entry : marks.entries) {
3140 refetchMounted(*entry);
3141 }
3142}
3143
3144inline void Session::countTopics(detail::CacheEntry const& entry, int delta) {
3145 if (entry.evaluate) {
3146 return;
3147 }
3148 // One topic: its count, and the queues a change of the count from or to zero goes to.
3149 auto const count = [delta](auto& refs, auto const& topic, auto& watches, auto& unwatches) {
3150 int& refsOf = refs[topic];
3151 refsOf += delta;
3152 if (delta > 0 && refsOf == 1 && unwatches.erase(topic) == 0) {
3153 watches.insert(topic);
3154 } else if (refsOf <= 0) {
3155 refs.erase(topic);
3156 if (watches.erase(topic) == 0) {
3157 unwatches.insert(topic);
3158 }
3159 }
3160 };
3161 if (!entry.records.empty()) {
3162 for (ActionRecordInfo const& record : entry.records) {
3163 count(_recordRefs, record.record, _watchRecords, _unwatchRecords);
3164 }
3165 return;
3166 }
3167 constexpr std::string_view kShared = "shared:";
3168 if (entry.instanceToken.starts_with(kShared)) {
3169 count(_instanceRefs, std::pair{entry.typeId, entry.instanceToken.substr(kShared.size())}, _watchInstances,
3170 _unwatchInstances);
3171 }
3172}
3173
3174inline void Session::sendWatch(std::string_view kind, wire::WatchBody const& body) const {
3175 auto completion = _options.watcher(std::string{kind}, glz::write_json(body).value_or(std::string{}));
3176 completion.then([](std::string const&) {}).onError([](std::exception_ptr const&) {});
3177}
3178
3179inline void Session::flushWatches() {
3180 if (!_options.watcher) {
3181 _watchRecords.clear();
3182 _unwatchRecords.clear();
3183 _watchInstances.clear();
3184 _unwatchInstances.clear();
3185 return;
3186 }
3187 auto const take = [](auto& records, auto& instances) {
3188 wire::WatchBody body;
3189 body.records.assign(records.begin(), records.end());
3190 for (auto const& [modelType, primary] : instances) {
3191 body.instances.push_back(wire::InstanceTopic{.modelType = modelType, .primary = primary, .instance = 0});
3192 }
3193 records.clear();
3194 instances.clear();
3195 return body;
3196 };
3197 if (!_watchRecords.empty() || !_watchInstances.empty()) {
3198 sendWatch(wire::kWatchKind, take(_watchRecords, _watchInstances));
3199 }
3200 if (!_unwatchRecords.empty() || !_unwatchInstances.empty()) {
3201 sendWatch(wire::kUnwatchKind, take(_unwatchRecords, _unwatchInstances));
3202 }
3203}
3204
3205inline wire::WatchBody Session::watchSet() const {
3206 wire::WatchBody body;
3207 for (auto const& [record, refs] : _recordRefs) {
3208 static_cast<void>(refs);
3209 body.records.push_back(record);
3210 }
3211 for (auto const& [topic, refs] : _instanceRefs) {
3212 static_cast<void>(refs);
3213 body.instances.push_back(
3214 wire::InstanceTopic{.modelType = topic.first, .primary = topic.second, .instance = 0});
3215 }
3216 return body;
3217}
3218
3219inline void Session::markAllStale() {
3220 _runtime->batch([this] {
3221 detail::Marks marks;
3222 for (auto const& [key, entry] : _entries) {
3223 static_cast<void>(key);
3224 if (!entry->evaluate) {
3225 marks.add(*entry);
3226 }
3227 }
3228 markAndRefetch(marks);
3229 });
3230}
3231
3232inline void Session::reconnected() {
3233 // The whole set replaces what the server holds, so the queued changes are superseded.
3234 _watchRecords.clear();
3235 _unwatchRecords.clear();
3236 _watchInstances.clear();
3237 _unwatchInstances.clear();
3238 if (_options.watcher) {
3239 wire::WatchBody body = watchSet();
3240 body.replace = true;
3241 sendWatch(wire::kWatchKind, body);
3242 }
3243 markAllStale();
3244}
3245
3246inline void Session::deliverEvent(wire::EventBody const& event) {
3247 if (event.topic == wire::kResyncTopic) {
3248 reconnected();
3249 return;
3250 }
3251 if (event.topic != wire::kChangesTopic) {
3252 return;
3253 }
3254 if (auto changes = wire::readChangesBody(event.payload.str)) {
3255 applyChanges(*changes);
3256 }
3257}
3258
3259inline void Session::applyChanges(wire::ChangesBody const& changes) {
3260 _runtime->batch([&] {
3261 detail::Marks marks;
3262 for (effects::RecordChange const& change : changes.records) {
3263 markRecordChange(change, marks);
3264 }
3265 for (wire::InstanceTopic const& instance : changes.instances) {
3266 markInstanceChange(instance, marks);
3267 }
3268 markAndRefetch(marks);
3269 });
3270}
3271
3272inline void Session::markRecordChange(effects::RecordChange const& change, detail::Marks& marks) {
3273 // The keys' canonical text, so a key the server wrote is compared with the rows' own.
3274 std::set<std::string, std::less<>> keys;
3275 for (glz::raw_json const& key : change.keys.value_or(std::vector<glz::raw_json>{})) {
3276 auto json = parseJson(key.str);
3277 auto value = json ? valueFromJson(*json) : std::unexpected(json.error());
3278 if (value) {
3279 keys.insert(detail::canonicalJson(*value));
3280 }
3281 }
3282 for (auto const& [name, entry] : _entries) {
3283 static_cast<void>(name);
3284 ActionRecordInfo const* const held = entry->holding(change.record);
3285 if (held == nullptr) {
3286 continue;
3287 }
3288 // An entry still waiting for its first value may come to hold a key; keyless rows cannot be told apart.
3289 if (!change.keys || !held->keyField || !entry->hasValue.peek()) {
3290 marks.add(*entry);
3291 continue;
3292 }
3293 std::string const& keyField = *held->keyField;
3294 bool const holdsKey = std::ranges::any_of(
3295 detail::keyedRowsOf(entry->confirmed, held->paths, keyField),
3296 [&](Value const* row) { return keys.contains(detail::canonicalJson(*row->field(keyField))); });
3297 if (holdsKey) {
3298 marks.add(*entry);
3299 }
3300 }
3301}
3302
3303inline void Session::markInstanceChange(wire::InstanceTopic const& instance, detail::Marks& marks) {
3304 std::string const shared = "shared:" + instance.primary;
3305 for (auto const& [name, entry] : _entries) {
3306 static_cast<void>(name);
3307 if (entry->evaluate || entry->typeId != instance.modelType) {
3308 continue;
3309 }
3310 // Without a primary key, the instance is one of the connection's own private ones.
3311 bool const same =
3312 instance.primary.empty() ? !entry->instanceToken.starts_with("shared") : entry->instanceToken == shared;
3313 if (same) {
3314 marks.add(*entry);
3315 }
3316 }
3317}
3318
3319inline void Session::actionSucceeded(std::string const& typeId, std::string const& actionId, Value const& reply,
3320 ReplyUse use, std::string const& instanceToken) {
3321 _runtime->batch([&] { applyReplyEffects(typeId, actionId, reply, use, instanceToken); });
3322}

3324inline void Session::detachQuery(detail::QueryRuntime& query) { query.detach(); }

3326namespace detail {

3328/// @brief The text of an instance key, as the bridge's string-keyed attach takes it.
3329/// @param key The key's value.
3330/// @return The text; empty for `null`.
3331[[nodiscard]] inline std::string instanceKeyText(Value const& key) {
3332 if (key.isNull()) {
3333 return {};
3334 }
3335 if (std::int64_t const* const number = key.asInt()) {
3336 return std::to_string(*number);
3337 }
3338 if (std::string const* const text = key.asString()) {
3339 return *text;
3340 }
3341 return canonicalJson(key);
3342}

3344/// @brief The channel an alias is bound to for its current token, binding it when the token changed.
3345/// @param alias The alias.
3346/// @param core The screen.
3347/// @return The channel, or `nullptr` while the alias is unbound.
3348[[nodiscard]] inline std::shared_ptr<ModelChannel> channelOf(ModelAlias& alias, ScreenCore& core) {
3349 std::string const token = core.runtime().untracked([&] { return alias.token->get(); });
3350 if (token.empty()) {
3351 return nullptr;
3352 }
3353 if (alias.channel && alias.boundToken == token) {
3354 return alias.channel;
3355 }
3356 std::string const& type = alias.decl->type;
3357 switch (alias.mode) {
3358 case InstanceMode::Borrowed: {
3359 auto const found = core.borrowed.find(alias.decl->name);
3360 alias.channel = found == core.borrowed.end() ? nullptr : found->second.channel;
3361 break;
3362 }
3363 case InstanceMode::Shared:
3364 // `shared` is for a stateless model, whose instances are interchangeable: its calls go to an instance of
3365 // the alias's own, and what it shares with other screens is the query cache, through the token.
3366 alias.channel = core.dispatcher.bind(type, bridge::BindSharing::Private, {});
3367 break;
3368 case InstanceMode::Keyed:
3369 alias.channel = core.dispatcher.bind(type, bridge::BindSharing::Shared, token.substr(7));
3370 break;
3371 case InstanceMode::Private:
3372 case InstanceMode::Default:
3373 default:
3374 alias.channel = core.dispatcher.bind(type, bridge::BindSharing::Private, {});
3375 break;
3376 }
3377 alias.boundToken = token;
3378 return alias.channel;
3379}

3381inline RtScope::RtScope(ScreenCore& screen, std::shared_ptr<RtScope> enclosing, reactive::Signal<Value> const* current,
3382 std::size_t depth)
3383 : core{screen}, parent{std::move(enclosing)}, row{current}, nodes{screen.runtime(), depth} {

3389inline RtScope::~RtScope() {
3390 if (core.recording) {
3391 std::erase(core.scopes, this);
3392 }
3393 if (owner != nullptr) {
3394 core.addPending(-1);
3395 if (owner->inner.peek() == this) {
3396 owner->inner.set(nullptr);
3397 }
3398 }
3399}

3401// NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-no-recursion): an element's value can read a nested scope's readiness, one level per nesting.
3402inline bool RtScope::ready() const {
3403 for (auto const& element : elements) {
3404 Value const shown = core.elementValue(*element, "visible");
3405 bool const* const visible = shown.asBool();
3406 ValueList const* const errors = element->errors->get().asList();
3407 if ((visible == nullptr || *visible) && errors != nullptr && !errors->empty()) {
3408 return false;
3409 }
3410 }
3411 for (auto const& check : checks) {
3412 if (check->decl->blocking && check->failing->get()) {
3413 return false;
3414 }
3415 }
3416 return true;
3417}
3418
3419// NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-no-recursion): an `app.` name is read in the root scope with its head consumed, once per segment.
3420inline Value ScopeEnv::ref(std::string_view head, std::span<std::string const> path) const {
3421 if (head == "app") {
3422 RtScope const* const app = _scope->core.session.appScope();
3423 if (app == nullptr || path.empty()) {
3424 return Value{};
3425 }
3426 return ScopeEnv{*app, nullptr}.ref(path.front(), path.subspan(1));
3427 }
3428 if (_bindings != nullptr) {
3429 for (Binding const& bound : std::views::reverse(*_bindings)) {
3430 if (bound.name == head) {
3431 return walk(bound.read(), path);
3432 }
3433 }
3434 }
3435 NameRef const* const name = _scope->find(head);
3436 if (name == nullptr) {
3437 return Value{};
3438 }
3439 switch (name->category) {
3440 case NameCategory::Param:
3441 return walk(name->param, path);
3442 case NameCategory::State:
3443 _scope->core.initState(*name->state->scope, *name->state);
3444 // State inits are acyclic (`loadDocument` checks it), so the value is made by now.
3445 return walk(name->state->value->get(), path);
3446 case NameCategory::Let:
3447 return walk(name->let->get(), path);
3448 case NameCategory::Query:
3449 return walk(name->query->value(), path);
3450 case NameCategory::Element:
3451 if (path.empty()) {
3452 return Value{};
3453 }
3454 return walk(_scope->core.elementValue(*name->element, path.front()), path.subspan(1));
3455 case NameCategory::Transfer: {
3456 if (path.empty()) {
3457 return Value{};
3458 }
3459 TransferState const& transfer = *name->transfer;
3460 Value value;
3461 if (path.front() == "progress") {
3462 value = transfer.progress.get();
3463 } else if (path.front() == "pending") {
3464 value = Value{transfer.pending.get()};
3465 } else if (path.front() == "error") {
3466 value = transfer.error.get();
3467 }
3468 return walk(value, path.subspan(1));
3469 }
3470 case NameCategory::Model:
3471 case NameCategory::Mutation:
3472 default:
3473 return Value{};
3474 }
3475}
3476
3477// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): one case per control form and kind of name.
3478inline Value ScopeEnv::control(ExprKind form, std::string_view name) const {
3479 Session const& session = _scope->core.session;
3480 NameRef const* const found = _scope->find(name);
3481 if (form == ExprKind::Can) {
3482 if (found != nullptr && found->category == NameCategory::Query) {
3483 return session.can(found->query->decl().action);
3484 }
3485 if (found != nullptr && found->category == NameCategory::Mutation) {
3486 return session.can(found->mutation->decl().action);
3487 }
3488 return session.can(name);
3489 }
3490 if (found != nullptr && found->category == NameCategory::Query) {
3491 QueryRuntime const& query = *found->query;
3492 if (form == ExprKind::Query) {
3493 return query.value();
3494 }
3495 if (form == ExprKind::Pending) {
3496 return query.pending();
3497 }
3498 if (form == ExprKind::Error) {
3499 return query.error();
3500 }
3501 return form == ExprKind::ErrorKind ? query.errorKind() : Value{};
3502 }
3503 if (found != nullptr && found->category == NameCategory::Mutation) {
3504 MutationRuntime const& mutation = *found->mutation;
3505 if (form == ExprKind::Result) {
3506 return mutation.result();
3507 }
3508 if (form == ExprKind::Pending) {
3509 return mutation.pending();
3510 }
3511 if (form == ExprKind::Error) {
3512 return mutation.error();
3513 }
3514 return form == ExprKind::ErrorKind ? mutation.errorKind() : Value{};
3515 }
3516 return Value{};
3517}
3518
3519inline Value ScopeEnv::pref(std::string_view point, std::span<std::string const> path) const {
3520 ValueRecord const& prefs = _scope->core.prefs.get();
3521 auto const found = prefs.find(point);
3522 return found == prefs.end() ? Value{} : walk(found->second, path);
3523}

3530
3531inline void ScopeEnv::report(std::string_view path, std::string_view reason) const {
3532 _scope->core.report(path, reason);
3533}

3535// --- Queries ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3536
3537inline QueryRuntime::QueryRuntime(QueryDecl const& decl, RtScope& scope, ModelAlias* alias)
3538 : _decl{&decl},
3539 _typeId{alias->decl->type},
3540 _scope{&scope},
3541 _alias{alias},
3542 _entry{scope.core.runtime()},
3543 _carried{scope.core.runtime()},
3544 _waiting{scope.core.runtime(), false} {
3545 scope.core.session.attachQuery(*this);
3546}
3547
3548inline QueryRuntime::~QueryRuntime() {
3549 _debounce.cancel();
3550 _refresh.cancel();
3551 _scope->core.session.forgetQuery(*this);
3552 if (auto const& current = _entry.peek()) {
3553 _scope->core.session.release(current);
3554 }
3555}
3556
3557inline std::shared_ptr<ModelChannel> QueryRuntime::channel() const { return channelOf(*_alias, _scope->core); }
3558
3559// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): the query's key, its fetch and its refresh triggers.
3560inline void QueryRuntime::start() {
3561 RtScope& scope = *_scope;
3562 auto& key = scope.nodes.computed([this]() -> Target {
3563 Target target;
3564 if (_decl->when) {
3565 Value const when = evalIn(*_scope, nullptr, _decl->when);
3566 bool const* const flag = when.asBool();
3567 if (flag == nullptr || !*flag) {
3568 return target;
3569 }
3570 }
3571 std::string token = _alias->token->get();
3572 if (token.empty()) {
3573 return target;
3574 }
3575 Value body = _decl->body ? evalIn(*_scope, nullptr, _decl->body) : Value{ValueRecord{}};
3576 if (body.isNull()) {
3577 return target;
3578 }
3579 target.idle = false;
3580 target.token = std::move(token);
3581 target.bodyText = canonicalJson(body);
3582 target.body = std::move(body);
3583 return target;
3584 });
3585 _key = &key;
3586 reactive::Scheduler* const scheduler = scope.core.session.options().scheduler;
3587 std::weak_ptr<bool> const alive = _alive;
3588 scope.nodes.effect([this, &key, scheduler, alive, first = true]() mutable {
3589 Target target = key.get();
3590 _scope->core.runtime().untracked([&] {
3591 if (first || target.idle || _decl->debounce <= 0 || scheduler == nullptr) {
3592 first = false;
3593 _debounce.cancel();
3594 _waiting.set(false);
3595 switchTo(target);
3596 return;
3597 }
3598 _pendingTarget = std::move(target);
3599 _waiting.set(true);
3600 _debounce = scheduler->after(std::chrono::milliseconds{_decl->debounce}, [this, alive] {
3601 if (alive.expired()) {
3602 return;
3603 }
3604 _scope->core.runtime().batch([this] {
3605 _waiting.set(false);
3606 switchTo(_pendingTarget);
3607 });
3608 });
3609 });
3610 });
3611 if (_decl->refreshEvery > 0 && scheduler != nullptr) {
3612 _refresh = scheduler->every(std::chrono::milliseconds{_decl->refreshEvery}, [this, alive] {
3613 if (alive.expired()) {
3614 return;
3615 }
3616 auto const current = _entry.peek();
3617 if (!current || _waiting.peek() || current->pending.peek()) {
3618 return;
3619 }
3620 _scope->core.runtime().batch([&] { _scope->core.session.fetch(current, channel()); });
3621 });
3622 }
3623}
3624
3625inline void QueryRuntime::switchTo(Target const& target) {
3626 Session& session = _scope->core.session;
3627 std::shared_ptr<CacheEntry> const old = _entry.peek();
3628 if (old && target == _target) {
3629 return;
3630 }
3631 Value shown = old && old->hasValue.peek() ? old->value.peek() : _carried.peek();
3632 _target = target;
3633 if (target.idle) {
3634 _carried.set(Value{});
3635 _entry.set(nullptr);
3636 if (old) {
3637 session.release(old);
3638 }
3639 return;
3640 }
3641 auto fresh = session.acquire(target.token, _typeId, _decl->action, _decl->evaluate, target.body);
3642 _carried.set(std::move(shown));
3643 _entry.set(fresh);
3644 if (old) {
3645 session.release(old);
3646 }
3647 bool const young = fresh->fetchedAt.has_value() &&
3648 session.now() - *fresh->fetchedAt < std::chrono::milliseconds{_decl->staleTime};
3649 if (!fresh->pending.peek() && (!fresh->hasValue.peek() || fresh->stale || !young)) {
3650 session.fetch(fresh, channel());
3651 }
3652}
3653
3654inline void QueryRuntime::refetch() {
3655 _scope->core.runtime().batch([this] {
3656 bool switched = false;
3657 if (_waiting.peek()) {
3658 _debounce.cancel();
3659 _waiting.set(false);
3660 switchTo(_pendingTarget);
3661 switched = true;
3662 }
3663 auto const current = _entry.peek();
3664 if (current && !(switched && current->pending.peek())) {
3665 _scope->core.session.fetch(current, channel());
3666 }
3667 });
3668}
3669
3670inline void QueryRuntime::refetchCurrent() {
3671 if (_key == nullptr) {
3672 refetch();
3673 return;
3674 }
3675 _scope->core.runtime().batch([this] {
3676 _debounce.cancel();
3677 _waiting.set(false);
3678 Target const target = _key->peek();
3679 if (!(_entry.peek() && target == _target)) {
3680 switchTo(target);
3681 return;
3682 }
3683 if (auto const current = _entry.peek(); current && !current->pending.peek()) {
3684 _scope->core.session.fetch(current, channel());
3685 }
3686 });
3687}
3688
3689inline Value QueryRuntime::value() const {
3690 auto const& current = _entry.get();
3691 if (current) {
3692 if (current->hasValue.get()) {
3693 return current->value.get();
3694 }
3695 if (!current->error.get().empty()) {
3696 return Value{};
3697 }
3698 }
3699 return _carried.get();
3700}
3701
3702inline bool QueryRuntime::pending() const {
3703 if (_waiting.get()) {
3704 return true;
3705 }
3706 auto const& current = _entry.get();
3707 return current && current->pending.get();
3708}
3709
3710inline Value QueryRuntime::error() const {
3711 auto const& current = _entry.get();
3712 if (!current || current->error.get().empty()) {
3713 return Value{};
3714 }
3715 return Value{current->error.get()};
3716}
3717
3718inline Value QueryRuntime::errorKind() const {
3719 auto const& current = _entry.get();
3720 if (!current || current->errorKind.get().empty()) {
3721 return Value{};
3722 }
3723 return Value{current->errorKind.get()};
3724}
3725
3726inline bool QueryRuntime::settled() const {
3727 auto const& current = _entry.get();
3728 return !current || current->hasValue.get() || !current->error.get().empty();
3729}

3731// --- Mutations -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3732
3733inline MutationRuntime::MutationRuntime(MutationDecl const& decl, RtScope& scope, ModelAlias* alias)
3734 : _decl{&decl},
3735 _scope{&scope},
3736 _alias{alias},
3737 _typeId{alias->decl->type},
3738 _core{&scope.core},
3739 _inFlight{scope.core.runtime(), 0},
3740 _result{scope.core.runtime()},
3741 _error{scope.core.runtime()},
3742 _errorKind{scope.core.runtime()} {}
3743
3744inline MutationRuntime::~MutationRuntime() {
3745 *_alive = false;
3746 // A run whose reply will now never be read is no longer pending.
3747 if (int const running = _inFlight.peek(); running > 0) {
3748 _core->addPending(-running);
3749 }
3750}
3751
3752// NOLINTBEGIN(misc-no-recursion): a mutation's commands can run another mutation, and a serial queue sends its next
3753// run as the last one settles.
3754inline void MutationRuntime::run(Value body, std::shared_ptr<Bindings const> bindings, RunDone done) {
3755 auto run = std::make_shared<Run>();
3756 run->body = std::move(body);
3757 run->bindings = std::move(bindings);
3758 run->done = std::move(done);
3759 if (_decl->concurrency == Concurrency::Exclusive && _inFlight.peek() > 0) {
3760 run->done(false, Value{});
3761 return;
3762 }
3763 _inFlight.set(_inFlight.peek() + 1);
3764 _core->addPending(1);
3765 if (_decl->concurrency == Concurrency::Serial) {
3766 // The key reads the run's body, so a run keys the same whichever command started it.
3767 Bindings withBody = *run->bindings;
3768 withBody.push_back(Binding{.name = "body", .read = [body = run->body] { return body; }});
3769 Value const key = evalIn(*_scope, &withBody, _decl->serialKey);
3770 run->serialKey = key.isNull() ? std::string{} : canonicalJson(key);
3771 if (_busy.contains(run->serialKey)) {
3772 _queues[run->serialKey].push_back(run);
3773 return;
3774 }
3775 _busy.insert(run->serialKey);
3776 }
3777 send(run);
3778}
3779
3780inline void MutationRuntime::send(std::shared_ptr<Run> const& run) {
3781 run->id = ++_runs;
3782 _latest = run->id;
3783 applyOptimistic(*run);
3784 std::shared_ptr<ModelChannel> const channel = channelOf(*_alias, _scope->core);
3785 if (channel == nullptr) {
3786 settle(run, std::nullopt, std::make_exception_ptr(std::runtime_error{"the model alias has no instance"}));
3787 return;
3788 }
3789 std::weak_ptr<bool> const alive = _alive;
3790 try {
3791 auto completion = channel->execute(_decl->action, canonicalJson(run->body),
3792 CallOptions{.queueOffline = _decl->offlineQueue});
3793 completion
3794 .then([this, alive, run](std::string const& reply) {
3795 if (alive.expired()) {
3796 return;
3797 }
3798 auto json = parseJson(reply);
3799 auto value = json ? valueFromJson(*json) : std::unexpected(json.error());
3800 if (!value) {
3801 settle(run, std::nullopt,
3802 std::make_exception_ptr(
3803 std::runtime_error{"the reply is not a document value: " + value.error()}));
3804 return;
3805 }
3806 settle(run, std::move(*value), nullptr);
3807 })
3808 .onError([this, alive, run](std::exception_ptr const& error) {
3809 if (!alive.expired()) {
3810 settle(run, std::nullopt, error);
3811 }
3812 });
3813 } catch (...) {
3814 settle(run, std::nullopt, std::current_exception());
3815 }
3816}
3817
3818inline void MutationRuntime::applyOptimistic(Run& run) {
3819 if (!_decl->optimistic) {
3820 return;
3821 }
3822 NameRef const* const target = _scope->find(_decl->optimistic->query);
3823 if (target == nullptr || target->category != NameCategory::Query) {
3824 return;
3825 }
3826 auto entry = _scope->core.runtime().untracked([&] { return target->query->entry(); });
3827 if (!entry) {
3828 return;
3829 }
3830 Bindings bindings = *run.bindings;
3831 bindings.push_back(Binding{.name = "body", .read = [body = run.body] { return body; }});
3832 Value key = _scope->core.runtime().untracked([&] { return evalIn(*_scope, &bindings, _decl->optimistic->key); });
3833 Value with = _scope->core.runtime().untracked([&] { return evalIn(*_scope, &bindings, _decl->optimistic->with); });
3834 // Before a value has arrived there is no list to miss.
3835 if (entry->hasValue.peek() &&
3836 patchRows(entry->confirmed, _decl->optimistic->at, key, with).error_or(PatchMiss::NoRow) ==
3837 PatchMiss::NoList) {
3838 _scope->core.report(pointerAppend(_decl->path, "optimistic"),
3839 patchMissReason(_decl->optimistic->query, _decl->optimistic->at));
3840 }
3841 entry->layers.push_back(
3842 OptimisticLayer{.run = run.id, .at = _decl->optimistic->at, .key = std::move(key), .with = std::move(with)});
3843 _scope->core.session.showLayers(*entry);
3844 run.layered.push_back(std::move(entry));
3845}
3846
3847inline void MutationRuntime::dropLayers(Run& run) {
3848 for (auto const& entry : run.layered) {
3849 std::erase_if(entry->layers, [&](OptimisticLayer const& layer) { return layer.run == run.id; });
3850 _scope->core.session.showLayers(*entry);
3851 }
3852 run.layered.clear();
3853}
3854
3855// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): one branch per outcome a reply can have.
3856inline void MutationRuntime::settle(std::shared_ptr<Run> const& run, std::optional<Value> reply,
3857 std::exception_ptr const& error) {
3858 ScreenCore& core = _scope->core;
3859 Session& session = core.session;
3860 bool const applied = _decl->concurrency != Concurrency::Latest || run->id == _latest;
3861 std::shared_ptr<RtScope> const scope = _scope->shared_from_this();
3862 auto commandCtx = [&](Bindings extra) {
3863 return CommandCtx{.scope = scope,
3864 .bindings = std::make_shared<Bindings>(std::move(extra)),
3865 .cancelClose = std::make_shared<bool>(false),
3866 .boundary = nullptr};
3867 };
3868 Value delivered;
3869 bool succeeded = false;
3870 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): one branch per outcome a reply can have.
3871 core.runtime().batch([&] {
3872 _inFlight.set(_inFlight.peek() - 1);
3873 _core->addPending(-1);
3874 if (reply) {
3875 succeeded = true;
3876 // The run's optimistic writes are confirmed by the reply: they become part of the confirmed rows.
3877 for (auto const& entry : run->layered) {
3878 Value confirmed = entry->confirmed;
3879 for (OptimisticLayer const& layer : entry->layers) {
3880 if (layer.run == run->id) {
3881 if (auto patched = patchRows(confirmed, layer.at, layer.key, layer.with)) {
3882 confirmed = std::move(*patched);
3883 }
3884 }
3885 }
3886 std::erase_if(entry->layers, [&](OptimisticLayer const& layer) { return layer.run == run->id; });
3887 session.confirm(*entry, confirmed);
3888 }
3889 run->layered.clear();
3890 std::vector<std::string> secret;
3891 if (session.options().catalog.action) {
3892 if (auto const info = session.options().catalog.action(_decl->action)) {
3893 secret = info->secretFields;
3894 }
3895 }
3896 delivered = withoutFields(*reply, secret);
3897 std::string const token =
3898 _alias == nullptr ? std::string{} : core.runtime().untracked([&] { return _alias->token->get(); });
3899 if (!applied) {
3900 session.actionSucceeded(_typeId, _decl->action, *reply, ReplyUse::Discarded, token);
3901 return;
3902 }
3903 _result.set(*reply);
3904 _error.set(Value{});
3905 _errorKind.set(Value{});
3906 session.actionSucceeded(_typeId, _decl->action, *reply, ReplyUse::Applied, token);
3907 core.runList(_decl->onSuccess, commandCtx(*run->bindings), {});
3908 if (!secret.empty()) {
3909 _result.set(delivered);
3910 }
3911 return;
3912 }
3913 dropLayers(*run);
3914 std::string const kind = session.classify(error);
3915 if (applied) {
3916 _error.set(Value{failureText(error)});
3917 _errorKind.set(Value{kind});
3918 core.runList(_decl->onError, commandCtx(*run->bindings), {});
3919 }
3920 if (kind == "denied" && core.host != nullptr) {
3921 core.host->permissionsStale();
3922 }
3923 });
3924 if (_decl->concurrency == Concurrency::Serial) {
3925 next(run->serialKey);
3926 }
3927 run->done(succeeded, delivered);
3928}
3929
3930inline void MutationRuntime::next(std::string const& serialKey) {
3931 auto const found = _queues.find(serialKey);
3932 if (found == _queues.end() || found->second.empty()) {
3933 _queues.erase(serialKey);
3934 _busy.erase(serialKey);
3935 return;
3936 }
3937 std::shared_ptr<Run> const queued = found->second.front();
3938 found->second.pop_front();
3939 _scope->core.runtime().batch([&] { send(queued); });
3940}
3941// NOLINTEND(misc-no-recursion)
3942
3943} // namespace detail
3944
3945namespace detail {
3946
3947// --- Declaring scopes ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3948
3949/// @brief The element a node of a scope keeps its state in.
3950/// @param scope The scope that declares it.
3951/// @param node The node.
3952/// @return The element, or `nullptr` for a node that keeps none.
3953[[nodiscard]] inline ElementState* elementFor(RtScope const& scope, DocNode const& node) {
3954 for (auto const& element : scope.elements) {
3955 if (element->node == &node) {
3956 return element.get();
3957 }
3958 }
3959 return nullptr;
3960}
3961
3962/// @brief The transfers of the `upload` commands in a list, nested lists included.
3963/// @param commands The list.
3964/// @param out Where the transfer ids go.
3965// NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-no-recursion): one level per nested command list
3966inline void transfersOf(Commands const& commands, std::vector<std::string>& out) {
3967 for (Command const& command : commands) {
3968 if (command.kind == CommandKind::Upload && !command.transfer.empty()) {
3969 out.push_back(command.transfer);
3970 }
3971 transfersOf(command.commands, out);
3972 transfersOf(command.alternative, out);
3973 }
3974}
3975
3976// NOLINTBEGIN(misc-no-recursion): a document is a tree of nodes and parts, and collecting descends it.
3977// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): one case per kind of node and part.
3978inline void ScreenCore::collect(DocNode const& node, RtScope& scope, std::vector<Commands const*>& commands) {
3979 KindSpec const* const spec = findKind(node.kind, false);
3980 if (!node.id.empty() || statefulKind(node.kind)) {
3981 auto element = std::make_unique<ElementState>(runtime());
3982 element->node = &node;
3983 element->scope = &scope;
3984 if (!node.id.empty()) {
3985 NameRef name;
3986 name.category = NameCategory::Element;
3987 name.element = element.get();
3988 scope.names.insert_or_assign(node.id, name);
3989 }
3990 wireErrors(*element);
3991 scope.elements.push_back(std::move(element));
3992 }
3993 bool const createsScope = spec != nullptr && (spec->flags & kScope) != 0;
3994 for (auto const& [key, list] : node.events) {
3995 KeySpec const* const keyed = spec == nullptr ? nullptr : keySpec(*spec, key);
3996 if (!createsScope || keyed == nullptr || (keyed->flags & kInner) == 0) {
3997 commands.push_back(&list);
3998 }
3999 }
4000 for (auto const& [chord, list] : node.keys) {
4001 static_cast<void>(chord);
4002 commands.push_back(&list);
4003 }
4004 for (auto const& [key, nodes] : node.children) {
4005 KeySpec const* const keyed = spec == nullptr ? nullptr : keySpec(*spec, key);
4006 if (createsScope && keyed != nullptr && (keyed->flags & kInner) != 0) {
4007 continue;
4008 }
4009 for (DocNodePtr const& child : nodes) {
4010 collect(*child, scope, commands);
4011 }
4012 }
4013 for (auto const& [key, parts] : node.parts) {
4014 static_cast<void>(key);
4015 for (DocNodePtr const& part : parts) {
4016 KindSpec const* const partSpec = findKind(part->kind, true);
4017 if (partSpec != nullptr && (partSpec->flags & kScope) != 0) {
4018 continue;
4019 }
4020 for (auto const& [event, list] : part->events) {
4021 static_cast<void>(event);
4022 commands.push_back(&list);
4023 }
4024 for (auto const& [childKey, nodes] : part->children) {
4025 KeySpec const* const keyed = partSpec == nullptr ? nullptr : keySpec(*partSpec, childKey);
4026 if (keyed != nullptr && (keyed->flags & kInner) != 0) {
4027 continue;
4028 }
4029 for (DocNodePtr const& child : nodes) {
4030 collect(*child, scope, commands);
4031 }
4032 }
4033 }
4034 }
4035}
4036// NOLINTEND(misc-no-recursion)
4037
4038// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): one section per kind of declaration.
4039inline void ScreenCore::declare(RtScope& scope, ScopeDecl const* decl, std::vector<DocNode const*> const& content,
4040 std::vector<Commands const*> const& commands) {
4041 std::vector<Commands const*> lists = commands;
4042 for (DocNode const* const node : content) {
4043 collect(*node, scope, lists);
4044 }
4045 std::vector<std::string> transferIds;
4046 for (Commands const* const list : lists) {
4047 transfersOf(*list, transferIds);
4048 }
4049 for (std::string const& transferId : transferIds) {
4050 if (scope.names.contains(transferId)) {
4051 continue;
4052 }
4053 scope.transfers.push_back(std::make_unique<TransferState>(runtime()));
4054 NameRef name;
4055 name.category = NameCategory::Transfer;
4056 name.transfer = scope.transfers.back().get();
4057 scope.names.insert_or_assign(transferId, name);
4058 }
4059 if (decl != nullptr) {
4060 for (ModelDecl const& model : decl->models) {
4061 auto alias = std::make_unique<ModelAlias>();
4062 alias->decl = &model;
4063 alias->mode = model.instance;
4064 if (alias->mode == InstanceMode::Default) {
4065 std::optional<ModelInfo> const info =
4066 session.options().catalog.model ? session.options().catalog.model(model.type) : std::nullopt;
4067 alias->mode = info && info->stateless ? InstanceMode::Shared : InstanceMode::Private;
4068 }
4069 ModelAlias* const raw = alias.get();
4070 switch (raw->mode) {
4071 case InstanceMode::Keyed:
4072 raw->token = &scope.nodes.computed([&scope, raw]() -> std::string {
4073 std::string const key = instanceKeyText(evalIn(scope, nullptr, raw->decl->key));
4074 return key.empty() ? std::string{} : "shared:" + key;
4075 });
4076 break;
4077 case InstanceMode::Shared:
4078 raw->token = &scope.nodes.computed([] { return std::string{"shared"}; });
4079 break;
4080 case InstanceMode::Borrowed: {
4081 auto const found = borrowed.find(model.name);
4082 std::string token = found == borrowed.end() ? std::string{} : found->second.token;
4083 raw->token = &scope.nodes.computed([token = std::move(token)] { return token; });
4084 break;
4085 }
4086 case InstanceMode::Private:
4087 case InstanceMode::Default:
4088 default: {
4089 std::string token = session.privateToken();
4090 raw->token = &scope.nodes.computed([token = std::move(token)] { return token; });
4091 break;
4092 }
4093 }
4094 NameRef name;
4095 name.category = NameCategory::Model;
4096 name.model = raw;
4097 scope.names.insert_or_assign(model.name, name);
4098 scope.models.push_back(std::move(alias));
4099 }
4100 for (LetDecl const& let : decl->lets) {
4101 NameRef name;
4102 name.category = NameCategory::Let;
4103 name.letExpr = let.value;
4104 name.let = &scope.nodes.computed([&scope, expr = let.value] { return evalIn(scope, nullptr, expr); });
4105 scope.names.insert_or_assign(let.name, name);
4106 }
4107 for (StateDecl const& state : decl->state) {
4108 auto slot = std::make_unique<StateSlot>();
4109 slot->decl = &state;
4110 slot->scope = &scope;
4111 NameRef name;
4112 name.category = NameCategory::State;
4113 name.state = slot.get();
4114 scope.names.insert_or_assign(state.name, name);
4115 scope.states.push_back(std::move(slot));
4116 }
4117 auto aliasOf = [&scope](std::string const& model) -> ModelAlias* {
4118 NameRef const* const found = scope.find(model);
4119 return found != nullptr && found->category == NameCategory::Model ? found->model : nullptr;
4120 };
4121 for (QueryDecl const& query : decl->queries) {
4122 scope.queries.push_back(std::make_unique<QueryRuntime>(query, scope, aliasOf(query.model)));
4123 NameRef name;
4124 name.category = NameCategory::Query;
4125 name.query = scope.queries.back().get();
4126 scope.names.insert_or_assign(query.name, name);
4127 }
4128 for (MutationDecl const& mutation : decl->mutations) {
4129 scope.mutations.push_back(std::make_unique<MutationRuntime>(mutation, scope, aliasOf(mutation.model)));
4130 NameRef name;
4131 name.category = NameCategory::Mutation;
4132 name.mutation = scope.mutations.back().get();
4133 scope.names.insert_or_assign(mutation.name, name);
4134 }
4135 }
4136 for (auto const& slot : scope.states) {
4137 initState(scope, *slot);
4138 }
4139 for (auto const& element : scope.elements) {
4140 wireElement(*element);
4141 }
4142 if (decl == nullptr) {
4143 return;
4144 }
4145 for (CheckDecl const& check : decl->checks) {
4146 auto made = std::make_unique<CheckRuntime>();
4147 made->decl = &check;
4148 made->failing = &scope.nodes.computed([&scope, expr = check.assertion] {
4149 Value const asserted = evalIn(scope, nullptr, expr);
4150 bool const* const flag = asserted.asBool();
4151 return flag != nullptr && !*flag;
4152 });
4153 made->message = &scope.nodes.computed([&scope, expr = check.message, session = &session] {
4154 return textOf(evalIn(scope, nullptr, expr), session->formatting());
4155 });
4156 for (std::string const& target : check.targets) {
4157 NameRef const* const found = scope.find(target);
4158 if (found != nullptr && found->category == NameCategory::Element) {
4159 found->element->checks.push_back(made.get());
4160 made->targets.push_back(found->element);
4161 found->element->checksVersion.set(found->element->checksVersion.peek() + 1);
4162 }
4163 }
4164 scope.checks.push_back(std::move(made));
4165 }
4166 for (auto const& query : scope.queries) {
4167 query->start();
4168 }
4169 for (WatchDecl const& watch : decl->watches) {
4170 auto& source = scope.nodes.computed([&scope, expr = watch.on] { return evalIn(scope, nullptr, expr); });
4171 scope.nodes.effect([this, &scope, &source, watched = &watch, first = true]() mutable {
4172 static_cast<void>(source.get());
4173 if (first) {
4174 first = false;
4175 return;
4176 }
4177 bool const user = session.lastWriteByUser();
4178 if (watched->source == WatchSource::User && !user) {
4179 return;
4180 }
4181 runtime().untracked([&] {
4182 CommandCtx const ctx{.scope = scope.shared_from_this(),
4183 .bindings = std::make_shared<Bindings>(),
4184 .cancelClose = std::make_shared<bool>(false),
4185 .boundary = nullptr};
4186 if (user) {
4187 session.asUser([&] { runList(watched->body, ctx, {}); });
4188 } else {
4189 runList(watched->body, ctx, {});
4190 }
4191 });
4192 });
4193 }
4194}
4195
4196/// @brief Whether two values show the same in an input: by text for a text input, by value otherwise.
4197/// @param kind The input's kind.
4198/// @param lhs One value.
4199/// @param rhs The other.
4200/// @param format The formatting facts.
4201/// @return It.
4202[[nodiscard]] inline bool sameShown(std::string_view kind, Value const& lhs, Value const& rhs,
4203 FormatContext const& format) {
4204 if (kind == "textInput" || kind == "filePicker") {
4205 return textOf(lhs, format) == textOf(rhs, format);
4206 }
4207 return lhs == rhs;
4208}
4209
4210/// @brief The key of a select option: a record's `key`, `id` or `value` field, or the option itself.
4211/// @param option The option.
4212/// @return The key.
4213[[nodiscard]] inline Value optionKey(Value const& option) {
4214 if (option.asRecord() == nullptr) {
4215 return option;
4216 }
4217 for (std::string_view const field : {"key", "id", "value"}) {
4218 if (Value const* const found = option.field(field)) {
4219 return *found;
4220 }
4221 }
4222 return Value{};
4223}
4224
4225// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): one rule per source of an error.
4226inline void ScreenCore::wireErrors(ElementState& element) {
4227 RtScope& scope = *element.scope;
4228 element.errors = &scope.nodes.computed([this, &element]() -> Value {
4229 static_cast<void>(element.checksVersion.get());
4230 DocNode const& field = *element.node;
4231 RtScope const& owner = *element.scope;
4232 std::vector<std::string> errors;
4233 if (ExprPtr const required = field.prop("required")) {
4234 Value const requiredNow = evalIn(owner, nullptr, required);
4235 bool const* const flag = requiredNow.asBool();
4236 if (flag != nullptr && *flag && !engaged(inputValue(element))) {
4237 errors.emplace_back("Required");
4238 }
4239 }
4240 for (std::string& text : stringsOf(evalIn(owner, nullptr, field.prop("errors")))) {
4241 errors.push_back(std::move(text));
4242 }
4243 if (!field.id.empty()) {
4244 std::vector<std::string> const path{"errors", field.id};
4245 for (auto const& query : owner.queries) {
4246 for (std::string& text : stringsOf(walk(query->value(), path))) {
4247 errors.push_back(std::move(text));
4248 }
4249 }
4250 for (auto const& mutation : owner.mutations) {
4251 for (std::string& text : stringsOf(walk(mutation->result(), path))) {
4252 errors.push_back(std::move(text));
4253 }
4254 }
4255 }
4256 for (CheckRuntime const* const check : element.checks) {
4257 if (check->failing->get()) {
4258 errors.push_back(check->message->get());
4259 }
4260 }
4261 return listOfStrings(errors);
4262 });
4263}
4264
4265// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): one case per kind of element.
4266inline void ScreenCore::wireElement(ElementState& element) {
4267 DocNode const& node = *element.node;
4268 RtScope& scope = *element.scope;
4269 std::string_view const kind = node.kind;
4270 if (kind == "form") {
4271 wireForm(element);
4272 return;
4273 }
4274 if (kind == "collection" || kind == "wizard") {
4275 wireComposite(element);
4276 return;
4277 }
4278 bool const input = kind == "textInput" || kind == "checkbox" || kind == "select" || kind == "dateTimeInput" ||
4279 kind == "slider" || kind == "filePicker";
4280 if (input) {
4281 std::string_view key = "value";
4282 if (kind == "checkbox") {
4283 key = "checked";
4284 } else if (kind == "select") {
4285 key = "selected";
4286 }
4287 ExprPtr const expr = kind == "filePicker" ? nullptr : node.prop(key);
4288 bool const controlled = expr && (expr->kind != ExprKind::Literal || !expr->literal.isNull());
4289 if (controlled) {
4290 element.bound = &scope.nodes.computed([&scope, expr] { return evalIn(scope, nullptr, expr); });
4291 element.draft.set(runtime().untracked([&] { return element.bound->get(); }));
4292 scope.nodes.effect([this, &element, kind] {
4293 Value const bound = element.bound->get();
4294 runtime().untracked([&] {
4295 if (!element.edited.peek()) {
4296 element.draft.set(bound);
4297 } else if (sameShown(kind, element.draft.peek(), bound, session.formatting())) {
4298 element.edited.set(false);
4299 }
4300 });
4301 });
4302 } else if (kind == "checkbox") {
4303 element.draft.set(false);
4304 }
4305 }
4306 if (kind == "select") {
4307 element.rows =
4308 &scope.nodes.computed([&scope, expr = node.prop("options")] { return evalIn(scope, nullptr, expr); });
4309 if (element.bound == nullptr && node.name("onStale") == "clear") {
4310 scope.nodes.effect([this, &element] {
4311 Value const options = element.rows->get();
4312 runtime().untracked([&] {
4313 Value const selected = element.draft.peek();
4314 if (selected.isNull()) {
4315 return;
4316 }
4317 ValueList const* const items = options.asList();
4318 bool const kept = items != nullptr && std::ranges::any_of(*items, [&](Value const& option) {
4319 return optionKey(option) == selected;
4320 });
4321 if (!kept) {
4322 session.noteWrite();
4323 element.draft.set(Value{});
4324 }
4325 });
4326 });
4327 }
4328 }
4329 if (kind == "table" && node.prop("rows")) {
4330 element.rows =
4331 &scope.nodes.computed([&scope, expr = node.prop("rows")] { return evalIn(scope, nullptr, expr); });
4332 }
4333}
