4335/// @brief A JSON text as a document value; `null` when it is not JSON or holds what a value cannot (a fraction).
4336/// @param text The JSON text.
4337/// @return The value.
4338[[nodiscard]] inline Value jsonTextValue(std::string_view text) {
4339 auto const json = parseJson(text);
4340 if (!json) {
4341 return Value{};
4342 }
4343 auto value = valueFromJson(*json);
4344 return value ? *std::move(value) : Value{};
4345}
4346
4347/// @brief One field of a form as a record: `value` (the encoded value, `null` while blank or invalid), `draft` (the
4348/// text), `valid`, `required`, `visible`, `readonly` and `errors`. Tracked.
4349/// @param field The field.
4350/// @return The record.
4351[[nodiscard]] inline Value formFieldValue(forms::FieldState const& field) {
4352 ValueRecord record;
4353 forms::Encoding const& encoding = field.encoded().get();
4354 Value value;
4355 if (encoding.has_value() && encoding->has_value()) {
4356 value = (*encoding)->value.isNull() ? jsonTextValue((*encoding)->json) : (*encoding)->value;
4357 }
4358 std::optional<forms::FieldError> const& error = field.error().get();
4359 record.insert_or_assign("value", std::move(value));
4360 record.insert_or_assign("draft", Value{field.spec().kind == forms::FieldKind::Object ||
4361 field.spec().kind == forms::FieldKind::ObjectArray
4362 ? std::string{}
4363 : field.draft()});
4364 record.insert_or_assign("valid", Value{!error.has_value()});
4365 record.insert_or_assign("required", Value{field.required().get()});
4366 record.insert_or_assign("visible", Value{field.visible().get()});
4367 record.insert_or_assign("readonly", Value{field.readonly().get()});
4368 record.insert_or_assign("errors",
4369 error.has_value() ? Value{ValueList{Value{error->message}}} : Value{ValueList{}});
4370 return Value{std::move(record)};
4371}
4372
4373/// @brief A form's element values (spec 5 §6): `ready`, `body` (the record the form would submit, `null` while not
4374/// ready), `submitted` (whether a submission was sent), `pending`, and each field by its wire name. Tracked.
4375/// @param element The form's element.
4376/// @param name The value's name.
4377/// @return The value; `null` for a name the form does not have, or a form without a session.
4378[[nodiscard]] inline Value formValue(ElementState const& element, std::string_view name) {
4379 forms::FormSession const* const form = element.form.get();
4380 if (form == nullptr) {
4381 return Value{};
4382 }
4383 if (name == "ready") {
4384 return form->ready();
4385 }
4386 if (name == "body") {
4387 std::optional<std::string> const body = form->body();
4388 return body.has_value() ? jsonTextValue(*body) : Value{};
4389 }
4390 if (name == "submitted") {
4391 return form->submitAttempts() > 0;
4392 }
4393 if (name == "pending") {
4394 return form->pending();
4395 }
4396 for (auto const& field : form->fields()) {
4397 if (field->spec().name == name) {
4398 return formFieldValue(*field);
4399 }
4400 }
4401 return Value{};
4402}
4403
4404inline Value ScreenCore::inputValue(ElementState const& element) const {
4405 std::string_view const kind = element.node->kind;
4406 if (kind == "checkbox") {
4407 return elementValue(element, "checked");
4408 }
4409 if (kind == "select") {
4410 return elementValue(element, "selected");
4411 }
4412 return elementValue(element, "value");
4413}
4414
4415// NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-no-recursion,readability-function-cognitive-complexity): one case per element value.
4416inline Value ScreenCore::elementValue(ElementState const& element, std::string_view name) const {
4417 DocNode const& node = *element.node;
4418 RtScope const& scope = *element.scope;
4419 std::string_view const kind = node.kind;
4420 auto flagOf = [&](std::string_view key, bool fallback) -> Value {
4421 ExprPtr const expr = node.prop(key);
4422 if (!expr) {
4423 return fallback;
4424 }
4425 Value const value = evalIn(scope, nullptr, expr);
4426 bool const* const flag = value.asBool();
4427 return flag != nullptr && *flag;
4428 };
4429 auto errors = [&]() -> Value { return element.errors->get(); };
4430 auto count = [](Value const& list) -> Value {
4431 ValueList const* const items = list.asList();
4432 return static_cast<std::int64_t>(items == nullptr ? 0 : items->size());
4433 };
4434 if (name == "visible" || name == "enabled") {
4435 return flagOf(name, true);
4436 }
4437 if (name == "errors") {
4438 return errors();
4439 }
4440 if (name == "valid") {
4441 Value const current = errors();
4442 ValueList const* const items = current.asList();
4443 return items == nullptr || items->empty();
4444 }
4445 if (name == "shownErrors") {
4446 RtScope const& policy = scope.policyScope();
4447 std::string const mode = policy.showErrors.empty() ? _doc->showErrors : policy.showErrors;
4448 bool const submittedNow = policy.submitted != nullptr && policy.submitted->get();
4449 if (mode == "always" || (mode == "submit" && submittedNow) ||
4450 (mode != "submit" && (submittedNow || element.touched.get()))) {
4451 return errors();
4452 }
4453 return Value{ValueList{}};
4454 }
4455 if (kind == "dialog" || kind == "drawer") {
4456 if (name == "open") {
4457 return node.prop("open") ? flagOf("open", false) : Value{element.open.get()};
4458 }
4459 if (name == "ready") {
4460 RtScope const* const inner = element.inner.get();
4461 return inner != nullptr && inner->ready();
4462 }
4463 if (name == "submitted") {
4464 return element.submitted.get();
4465 }
4466 return Value{};
4467 }
4468 if (kind == "table") {
4469 if (name == "selection") {
4470 return element.selection.get();
4471 }
4472 if (name == "activeKey") {
4473 return element.activeKey.get();
4474 }
4475 if (name == "selectedCount") {
4476 return count(element.selection.get());
4477 }
4478 if (name == "viewCount" || name == "sourceCount") {
4479 return element.rows == nullptr ? Value{std::int64_t{0}} : count(element.rows->get());
4480 }
4481 ExprPtr const rows = node.prop("rows");
4482 if ((name == "pending" || name == "error") && rows && rows->kind == ExprKind::Query) {
4483 ScopeEnv const env{scope, nullptr};
4484 return env.control(name == "pending" ? ExprKind::Pending : ExprKind::Error, rows->name);
4485 }
4486 return name == "pending" ? Value{false} : Value{};
4487 }
4488 if (kind == "form") {
4489 return formValue(element, name);
4490 }
4491 if (name == "draft") {
4492 return element.draft.get();
4493 }
4494 if (name == "dirty") {
4495 return element.edited.get();
4496 }
4497 if (name == "focused") {
4498 return element.focused.get();
4499 }
4500 if (name == "touched") {
4501 return element.touched.get();
4502 }
4503 if (name == "checked" || name == "selected") {
4504 return element.bound != nullptr ? element.bound->get() : element.draft.get();
4505 }
4506 if (name == "selectedOption") {
4507 Value const selected = elementValue(element, "selected");
4508 ValueList const* const options = element.rows == nullptr ? nullptr : element.rows->get().asList();
4509 if (options != nullptr && !selected.isNull()) {
4510 for (Value const& option : *options) {
4511 if (optionKey(option) == selected) {
4512 return option;
4513 }
4514 }
4515 }
4516 return Value{};
4517 }
4518 if (name == "value") {
4519 if (element.bound != nullptr) {
4520 return element.bound->get();
4521 }
4522 return element.committed.get();
4523 }
4524 return Value{};
4525}
4526
4527// --- Commands --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4528
4529// NOLINTBEGIN(misc-no-recursion): command lists nest
4530inline void ScreenCore::runList(Commands const& commands, CommandCtx const& ctx, Done done) {
4531 if (!done) {
4532 done = [](bool) {};
4533 }
4534 if (commands.empty()) {
4535 done(true);
4536 return;
4537 }
4538 struct Join {
4539 std::size_t left = 0;
4540 bool ok = true;
4541 Done done;
4542 };
4543 if (recording) {
4544 logList(commands);
4545 }
4546 auto join = std::make_shared<Join>(Join{.left = commands.size() + 1, .ok = true, .done = std::move(done)});
4547 auto finish = [join](bool succeeded) {
4548 join->ok = join->ok && succeeded;
4549 if (--join->left == 0) {
4550 join->done(join->ok);
4551 }
4552 };
4553 for (Command const& command : commands) {
4554 runOne(command, ctx, finish);
4555 }
4556 finish(true);
4557}
4558
4559// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): one case per command of ui/1.
4560inline void ScreenCore::runOne(Command const& command, CommandCtx const& ctx, Done done) {
4561 if (!done) {
4562 done = [](bool) {};
4563 }
4564 RtScope const& scope = *ctx.scope;
4565 auto eval = [&](ExprPtr const& expr) { return evalIn(scope, ctx.bindings.get(), expr); };
4566 auto finish = [&done](bool succeeded) { done(succeeded); };
4567 switch (command.kind) {
4568 case CommandKind::Set:
4569 runSet(command, ctx, done);
4570 return;
4571 case CommandKind::Reset:
4572 runReset(command, ctx, done);
4573 return;
4574 case CommandKind::Run:
4575 runMutation(command, ctx, std::move(done));
4576 return;
4577 case CommandKind::Refetch: {
4578 // A loaded document's `refetch` names a query in scope (`loadDocument` checks it), as `run` names a
4579 // mutation and `open` a dialog.
4580 scope.find(command.target)->query->refetch();
4581 finish(true);
4582 return;
4583 }
4584 case CommandKind::Open:
4585 case CommandKind::Close: {
4586 if (command.kind == CommandKind::Close && command.target == "self") {
4587 finish((host != nullptr && host->closeSelf(_doc->id, std::nullopt)) ||
4588 unsupported(command, "`close: self`"));
4589 return;
4590 }
4591 ElementState& element = *scope.find(command.target)->element;
4592 if (element.node->prop("open")) {
4593 report(command.path, "the dialog's `open` is bound to an expression");
4594 finish(false);
4595 return;
4596 }
4597 bool const opening = command.kind == CommandKind::Open;
4598 if (opening && !element.open.peek()) {
4599 element.submitted.set(false);
4600 }
4601 session.noteWrite();
4602 element.open.set(opening);
4603 finish(true);
4604 return;
4605 }
4606 case CommandKind::Navigate: {
4607 NavigateRequest const request{.screen = command.target,
4608 .route = eval(command.extra),
4609 .params = eval(command.value),
4610 .as = command.option};
4611 if (host == nullptr) {
4612 finish(unsupported(command, "`navigate`"));
4613 return;
4614 }
4615 std::weak_ptr<RtScope> const weak = ctx.scope;
4616 CommandCtx const kept = detached(ctx);
4617 auto onResult = [this, weak, kept, list = &command.commands](Value const& result) {
4618 if (auto const held = weak.lock()) {
4619 auto bindings = std::make_shared<Bindings>(*kept.bindings);
4620 bindings->push_back(Binding{.name = "event", .read = [result] { return result; }});
4621 CommandCtx const next{.scope = held,
4622 .bindings = bindings,
4623 .cancelClose = kept.cancelClose,
4624 .boundary = kept.boundary};
4625 runtime().batch([&] { runList(*list, next, {}); });
4626 }
4627 };
4628 auto onCancel = [this, weak, kept, list = &command.alternative] {
4629 if (auto const held = weak.lock()) {
4630 CommandCtx next = kept;
4631 next.scope = held;
4632 runtime().batch([&] { runList(*list, next, {}); });
4633 }
4634 };
4635 finish(host->navigate(request, std::move(onResult), std::move(onCancel)) ||
4636 unsupported(command, "`navigate`"));
4637 return;
4638 }
4639 case CommandKind::Return:
4640 finish(host != nullptr && host->closeSelf(_doc->id, eval(command.value))
4641 ? true
4642 : unsupported(command, "`return`"));
4643 return;
4644 case CommandKind::Focus:
4645 if (focusElement && focusElement(command.target)) {
4646 finish(true);
4647 return;
4648 }
4649 report(command.path, "`" + command.target + "` is not mounted");
4650 finish(false);
4651 return;
4652 case CommandKind::Host:
4653 runHostCommand(command, ctx, done);
4654 return;
4655 case CommandKind::SwitchBackend: {
4656 std::weak_ptr<RtScope> const weak = ctx.scope;
4657 auto committed = [this, weak, target = command.target, path = command.path,
4658 done](std::expected<void, std::string> const& outcome) {
4659 if (!weak.lock()) {
4660 return;
4661 }
4662 if (!outcome) {
4663 report(path, "backendSwitchFailed: " + outcome.error());
4664 done(false);
4665 return;
4666 }
4667 session.backendChanged(target);
4668 done(true);
4669 };
4670 if (host != nullptr && host->switchBackend(command.target, std::move(committed))) {
4671 return;
4672 }
4673 report(command.path, "backend `" + command.target + "` is not listed");
4674 finish(false);
4675 return;
4676 }
4677 case CommandKind::ResetPrefs: {
4678 ValueRecord prefsNow = prefs.peek();
4679 if (command.target == "all") {
4680 prefsNow = prefDefaults;
4681 } else if (auto const found = prefDefaults.find(command.target); found != prefDefaults.end()) {
4682 prefsNow.insert_or_assign(command.target, found->second);
4683 }
4684 prefs.set(std::move(prefsNow));
4685 if (host != nullptr) {
4686 host->resetPrefs(_doc->id, command.target);
4687 }
4688 finish(true);
4689 return;
4690 }
4691 case CommandKind::SetLocale:
4692 session.setLocale(command.target);
4693 if (host != nullptr) {
4694 host->setLocale(command.target);
4695 }
4696 finish(true);
4697 return;
4698 case CommandKind::Notify: {
4699 std::string const text = textOf(eval(command.value), session.formatting());
4700 finish(host != nullptr && host->notify(text, command.option) ? true : unsupported(command, "`notify`"));
4701 return;
4702 }
4703 case CommandKind::Seq: {
4704 // A step that waits for a reply keeps the rest of the sequence in that reply's handler, which the
4705 // dispatcher may hold past the screen: the sequence holds its scope weakly and stops once it is gone.
4706 CommandCtx const inner = detached(CommandCtx{.scope = nullptr,
4707 .bindings = std::make_shared<Bindings>(*ctx.bindings),
4708 .cancelClose = ctx.cancelClose,
4709 .boundary = ctx.boundary});
4710 std::weak_ptr<RtScope> const weak = ctx.scope;
4711 auto step = std::make_shared<std::function<void(std::size_t)>>();
4712 *step = [this, inner, weak, list = &command.commands, done = std::move(done),
4713 weakStep = std::weak_ptr<std::function<void(std::size_t)>>{step}](std::size_t index) {
4714 auto const held = weak.lock();
4715 if (index == list->size() || !held) {
4716 done(held != nullptr);
4717 return;
4718 }
4719 auto const self = weakStep.lock();
4720 CommandCtx current = inner;
4721 current.scope = held;
4722 runOne(list->at(index), current, [self, index, done](bool succeeded) {
4723 if (!succeeded) {
4724 done(false);
4725 return;
4726 }
4727 (*self)(index + 1);
4728 });
4729 };
4730 (*step)(0);
4731 return;
4732 }
4733 case CommandKind::All: {
4734 CommandCtx const inner{.scope = ctx.scope,
4735 .bindings = std::make_shared<Bindings>(*ctx.bindings),
4736 .cancelClose = ctx.cancelClose,
4737 .boundary = ctx.boundary};
4738 runList(command.commands, inner, std::move(done));
4739 return;
4740 }
4741 case CommandKind::If: {
4742 Value const condition = eval(command.value);
4743 bool const* const flag = condition.asBool();
4744 if (flag == nullptr) {
4745 finish(true);
4746 return;
4747 }
4748 runList(*flag ? command.commands : command.alternative, ctx, std::move(done));
4749 return;
4750 }
4751 case CommandKind::CancelClose:
4752 *ctx.cancelClose = true;
4753 finish(true);
4754 return;
4755 case CommandKind::Retry:
4756 // `retry` is valid only inside a boundary's `error`, which is lowered with its boundary.
4757 for (QueryRuntime* const query : ctx.boundary->queries) {
4758 if (!runtime().untracked([&] { return query->error(); }).isNull()) {
4759 query->refetch();
4760 }
4761 }
4762 finish(true);
4763 return;
4764 case CommandKind::SignIn: {
4765 NameRef const* const found = scope.find(command.target);
4766 Value const reply = found != nullptr && found->category == NameCategory::Mutation
4767 ? runtime().untracked([&] { return found->mutation->result(); })
4768 : Value{};
4769 session.clear();
4770 finish(host != nullptr && host->signIn(reply) ? true : unsupported(command, "`signIn`"));
4771 return;
4772 }
4773 case CommandKind::SignOut:
4774 session.clear();
4775 if (host != nullptr) {
4776 host->signOut();
4777 }
4778 finish(true);
4779 return;
4780 case CommandKind::Upload:
4781 case CommandKind::Download:
4782 default:
4783 runTransfer(command, ctx, std::move(done));
4784 return;
4785 }
4786}
4787
4788// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): a single run, or a run per list item.
4789inline void ScreenCore::runMutation(Command const& command, CommandCtx const& ctx, Done done) const {
4790 RtScope const& scope = *ctx.scope;
4791 MutationRuntime& mutation = *scope.find(command.target)->mutation;
4792 RtScope const& policy = scope.policyScope();
4793 if (policy.submitted != nullptr) {
4794 policy.submitted->set(true);
4795 }
4796 if (policy.owner != nullptr && !runtime().untracked([&] { return policy.ready(); })) {
4797 done(false);
4798 return;
4799 }
4800 RtScope const& declaring = *[&]() -> RtScope const* {
4801 for (RtScope const* candidate = &scope; candidate != nullptr; candidate = candidate->parent.get()) {
4802 if (candidate->names.contains(command.target)) {
4803 return candidate;
4804 }
4805 }
4806 return &scope;
4807 }();
4808 auto bodyFor = [&](Bindings const& bindings) {
4809 if (command.value) {
4810 return evalIn(scope, &bindings, command.value);
4811 }
4812 if (mutation.decl().body) {
4813 return evalIn(declaring, &bindings, mutation.decl().body);
4814 }
4815 return Value{ValueRecord{}};
4816 };
4817 if (!command.extra) {
4818 Value body = bodyFor(*ctx.bindings);
4819 mutation.run(std::move(body), std::make_shared<Bindings const>(*ctx.bindings),
4820 [bindings = ctx.bindings, bindAs = command.binding, done = std::move(done)](bool succeeded,
4821 Value const& reply) {
4822 if (succeeded && !bindAs.empty()) {
4823 bindings->push_back(Binding{.name = bindAs, .read = [reply] { return reply; }});
4824 }
4825 done(succeeded);
4826 });
4827 return;
4828 }
4829 Value const each = evalIn(scope, ctx.bindings.get(), command.extra);
4830 ValueList const items = each.asList() == nullptr ? ValueList{} : *each.asList();
4831 if (items.empty()) {
4832 done(true);
4833 return;
4834 }
4835 struct Each {
4836 std::size_t left = 0;
4837 bool ok = true;
4838 Done done;
4839 };
4840 auto state = std::make_shared<Each>(Each{.left = items.size(), .ok = true, .done = std::move(done)});
4841 std::vector<Value> bodies;
4842 std::vector<std::shared_ptr<Bindings const>> bound;
4843 for (Value const& item : items) {
4844 Bindings bindings = *ctx.bindings;
4845 if (!command.binding.empty()) {
4846 bindings.push_back(Binding{.name = command.binding, .read = [item] { return item; }});
4847 }
4848 bodies.push_back(bodyFor(bindings));
4849 bound.push_back(std::make_shared<Bindings const>(std::move(bindings)));
4850 }
4851 if (mutation.decl().concurrency != Concurrency::Exclusive) {
4852 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < bodies.size(); ++index) {
4853 mutation.run(bodies.at(index), bound.at(index), [state](bool succeeded, Value const&) {
4854 state->ok = state->ok && succeeded;
4855 if (--state->left == 0) {
4856 state->done(state->ok);
4857 }
4858 });
4859 }
4860 return;
4861 }
4862 // An exclusive mutation refuses a run while another is in flight, so its elements go one after another.
4863 auto step = std::make_shared<std::function<void(std::size_t)>>();
4864 *step = [&mutation, bodies, bound, state,
4865 weakStep = std::weak_ptr<std::function<void(std::size_t)>>{step}](std::size_t index) {
4866 if (index == bodies.size()) {
4867 state->done(state->ok);
4868 return;
4869 }
4870 auto const self = weakStep.lock();
4871 mutation.run(bodies.at(index), bound.at(index), [self, state, index](bool succeeded, Value const&) {
4872 if (!succeeded) {
4873 state->done(false);
4874 return;
4875 }
4876 (*self)(index + 1);
4877 });
4878 };
4879 (*step)(0);
4880}

4882// NOLINTEND(misc-no-recursion)
4883inline void ScreenCore::writeSlot(StateSlot& slot, std::span<std::string const> within, Value value,
4884 Command const& command, Done const& done) {
4885 slot.scope->core.initState(*slot.scope, slot);
4886 Type const& type = slot.decl->type;
4887 if (within.empty() && !type.isAny() && !type.admits(value)) {
4888 report(command.path, "`set` writes a value that is not a " + type.name());
4889 done(false);
4890 return;
4891 }
4892 Value next = withPath(slot.value->peek(), within, std::move(value));
4893 session.noteWrite();
4894 slot.value->set(std::move(next));
4895 done(true);
4896}

4898inline void ScreenCore::runSetApp(Command const& command, std::span<std::string const> rest, Value value,
4899 Done const& done) {
4900 if (RtScope const* const app = session.appScope(); app != nullptr && !rest.empty()) {
4901 NameRef const* const named = app->find(rest.front());
4902 if (named != nullptr && named->category == NameCategory::State) {
4903 writeSlot(*named->state, rest.subspan(1), std::move(value), command, done);
4904 return;
4905 }
4906 report(command.path, "`app." + rest.front() + "` is not state of the app document");
4907 done(false);
4908 return;
4909 }
4910 std::string name;
4911 for (std::string const& segment : rest) {
4912 name += name.empty() ? segment : "." + segment;
4913 }
4914 done(host != nullptr && host->setAppValue(name, value) ? true : unsupported(command, "`set` of `app`"));
4915}
4916
4917inline void ScreenCore::runSet(Command const& command, CommandCtx const& ctx, Done const& done) {
4918 RtScope const& scope = *ctx.scope;
4919 auto path = splitPath(command.target);
4920 if (!path || path->empty()) {
4921 done(false);
4922 return;
4923 }
4924 std::string const head = path->front();
4925 std::span<std::string const> const rest = std::span<std::string const>{*path}.subspan(1);
4926 Value value = evalIn(scope, ctx.bindings.get(), command.value);
4927 if (head == "app") {
4928 runSetApp(command, rest, std::move(value), done);
4929 return;
4930 }
4931 NameRef const* const found = scope.find(head);
4932 if (found != nullptr && found->category == NameCategory::State) {
4933 writeSlot(*found->state, rest, std::move(value), command, done);
4934 return;
4935 }
4936 if (found != nullptr && found->category == NameCategory::Element) {
4937 ElementState& element = *found->element;
4938 session.noteWrite();
4939 element.draft.set(value);
4940 if (element.bound == nullptr) {
4941 element.committed.set(std::move(value));
4942 }
4943 done(true);
4944 return;
4945 }
4946 report(command.path, "`set` names nothing writable here");
4947 done(false);
4948}

4950inline void ScreenCore::runReset(Command const& command, CommandCtx const& ctx, Done const& done) {
4951 RtScope const& scope = *ctx.scope;
4952 NameRef const* const found = scope.find(command.target);
4953 auto resetStates = [this](RtScope const& owner) {
4954 for (auto const& slot : owner.states) {
4955 if (slot->value) {
4956 Value init = runtime().untracked([&] { return evalIn(owner, nullptr, slot->decl->init); });
4957 slot->value->set(std::move(init));
4958 }
4959 }
4960 for (auto const& element : owner.elements) {
4961 element->draft.set(element->bound != nullptr ? runtime().untracked([&] { return element->bound->get(); })
4962 : Value{});
4963 element->committed.set(Value{});
4964 element->edited.set(false);
4965 element->touched.set(false);
4966 }
4967 };
4968 bool known = true;
4969 session.noteWrite();
4970 if (found != nullptr && found->category == NameCategory::State) {
4971 StateSlot& slot = *found->state;
4972 initState(*slot.scope, slot);
4973 slot.value->set(runtime().untracked([&] { return evalIn(*slot.scope, nullptr, slot.decl->init); }));
4974 } else if (found != nullptr && found->category == NameCategory::Element) {
4975 ElementState& element = *found->element;
4976 element.submitted.set(false);
4977 if (RtScope const* const inner = element.inner.peek()) {
4978 resetStates(*inner);
4979 }
4980 } else {
4981 report(command.path, "`reset` names no state or dialog here");
4982 known = false;
4983 }
4984 done(known);
4985}

4987inline void ScreenCore::runHostCommand(Command const& command, CommandCtx const& ctx, Done const& done) {
4988 Value const args = evalIn(*ctx.scope, ctx.bindings.get(), command.value);
4989 if (auto const& run = session.hostCommandRunner()) {
4990 HostCommandResult const result = run(command.target, args);
4991 if (result.kind == HostCommandResult::Kind::Missing) {
4992 report(command.path, "host command `" + command.target + "` is missing");
4993 } else if (result.kind == HostCommandResult::Kind::Refused) {
4994 report(command.path, result.reason);
4995 }
4996 done(result.kind == HostCommandResult::Kind::Ran);
4997 return;
4998 }
4999 bool const known = host != nullptr && host->hostCommand(command.target, args);
5000 if (!known) {
5001 report(command.path, "host command `" + command.target + "` is missing");
5002 }
5003 done(known);
5004}
5005
5006// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): a download and an upload, each settled.
5007/// @brief A transfer's share of its screen's pending count.
5008///
5009/// A transfer is pending from the host accepting it to its settle: its completion carries on the command list that
5010/// started it, which the close protocol and save-and-close wait for. The count is taken once the host accepts, so a
5011/// refused transfer never counts, and a host that settles before it returns leaves nothing taken. It is given back
5012/// once, also when the transfer settles after its scope is gone, but not after the screen itself is gone, since the
5013/// count went with it.
5014class TransferHold {
5015public:
5016 /// @brief A hold that counts nothing yet.
5017 /// @param core The screen whose count it moves.
5018 /// @param alive Expires with the screen.
5019 TransferHold(ScreenCore& core, std::weak_ptr<bool> alive) : _core{&core}, _alive{std::move(alive)} {}
5020
5021 /// @brief Counts the transfer, unless it has already settled.
5022 void take() {
5023 if (_state == State::NotTaken) {
5024 _state = State::Taken;
5025 _core->addPending(1);
5026 }
5027 }
5028
5029 /// @brief Gives the count back, if one was taken and the screen is still there; the transfer counts no more.
5030 void release() {
5031 if (_state == State::Taken && !_alive.expired()) {
5032 _core->addPending(-1);
5033 }
5034 _state = State::Released;
5035 }
5036
5037private:
5038 enum class State : std::uint8_t { NotTaken, Taken, Released };
5039
5040 ScreenCore* _core;
5041 std::weak_ptr<bool> _alive;
5042 State _state = State::NotTaken;
5043};
5044
5045/// @brief Bytes as base64 (RFC 4648, with padding): how a document carries an inline file.
5046/// @param bytes The bytes.
5047/// @return The text.
5048[[nodiscard]] inline std::string base64Encode(std::string_view bytes) {
5049 static constexpr std::string_view kAlphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/";
5050 std::string out;
5051 out.reserve(((bytes.size() + 2) / 3) * 4);
5052 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < bytes.size(); index += 3) {
5053 std::size_t const left = std::min<std::size_t>(3, bytes.size() - index);
5054 std::uint32_t group = 0;
5055 for (std::size_t offset = 0; offset < 3; ++offset) {
5056 group <<= 8U;
5057 if (offset < left) {
5058 group |= static_cast<unsigned char>(bytes.at(index + offset));
5059 }
5060 }
5061 for (std::size_t digit = 0; digit < 4; ++digit) {
5062 out.push_back(digit <= left ? kAlphabet.at((group >> (18U - (6U * digit))) & 0x3FU) : '=');
5063 }
5064 }
5065 return out;
5066}
5067
5068/// @brief Base64 text as bytes (RFC 4648, with or without padding).
5069/// @param text The text.
5070/// @return The bytes, or `std::nullopt` for text that is not base64.
5071[[nodiscard]] inline std::optional<std::string> base64Decode(std::string_view text) {
5072 while (!text.empty() && text.back() == '=') {
5073 text.remove_suffix(1);
5074 }
5075 if (text.size() % 4 == 1) {
5076 return std::nullopt;
5077 }
5078 auto digitOf = [](char chr) -> int {
5079 if (chr >= 'A' && chr <= 'Z') {
5080 return chr - 'A';
5081 }
5082 if (chr >= 'a' && chr <= 'z') {
5083 return chr - 'a' + 26;
5084 }
5085 if (chr >= '0' && chr <= '9') {
5086 return chr - '0' + 52;
5087 }
5088 if (chr == '+') {
5089 return 62;
5090 }
5091 return chr == '/' ? 63 : -1;
5092 };
5093 std::string out;
5094 out.reserve((text.size() * 3) / 4);
5095 std::uint32_t group = 0;
5096 int bits = 0;
5097 for (char const chr : text) {
5098 int const digit = digitOf(chr);
5099 if (digit < 0) {
5100 return std::nullopt;
5101 }
5102 group = (group << 6U) | static_cast<std::uint32_t>(digit);
5103 bits += 6;
5104 if (bits >= 8) {
5105 bits -= 8;
5106 out.push_back(static_cast<char>((group >> static_cast<std::uint32_t>(bits)) & 0xFFU));
5107 }
5108 }
5109 return out;
5110}
5111
5112/// @brief How many bytes base64 text decodes to, read from its length alone.
5113/// @param text The text.
5114/// @return The byte count.
5115[[nodiscard]] inline std::size_t base64Size(std::string_view text) {
5116 while (!text.empty() && text.back() == '=') {
5117 text.remove_suffix(1);
5118 }
5119 return (text.size() * 3) / 4;
5120}
5121
5122/// @brief A byte count as a person reads it: `512 bytes`, `2.4 KiB`, `1 MiB`.
5123/// @param bytes The count.
5124/// @return The text.
5125[[nodiscard]] inline std::string sizeText(std::size_t bytes) {
5126 constexpr std::size_t kKiB = 1024;
5127 if (bytes < kKiB) {
5128 return std::to_string(bytes) + " bytes";
5129 }
5130 bool const mebi = bytes >= kKiB * kKiB;
5131 std::size_t const unit = mebi ? kKiB * kKiB : kKiB;
5132 // One decimal place, rounded half up, and none when it is zero.
5133 std::size_t const tenths = ((bytes * 10) + (unit / 2)) / unit;
5134 std::string text = std::to_string(tenths / 10);
5135 if (tenths % 10 != 0) {
5136 text += "." + std::to_string(tenths % 10);
5137 }
5138 return text + (mebi ? " MiB" : " KiB");
5139}
5140
5141/// @brief A document's inline file content as bytes: base64 text, or a list of integers 0 to 255.
5142/// @param value The value.
5143/// @return The bytes, or why the value is neither.
5144[[nodiscard]] inline std::expected<std::string, std::string> inlineBytes(Value const& value) {
5145 if (std::string const* const text = value.asString()) {
5146 if (std::optional<std::string> bytes = base64Decode(*text)) {
5147 return *std::move(bytes);
5148 }
5149 return std::unexpected(std::string{"the text is not base64"});
5150 }
5151 if (ValueList const* const list = value.asList()) {
5152 std::string bytes;
5153 bytes.reserve(list->size());
5154 for (Value const& item : *list) {
5155 std::int64_t const* const byte = item.asInt();
5156 if (byte == nullptr || *byte < 0 || *byte > 255) {
5157 return std::unexpected(std::string{"a byte list holds integers 0 to 255"});
5158 }
5159 bytes.push_back(static_cast<char>(static_cast<unsigned char>(*byte)));
5160 }
5161 return bytes;
5162 }
5163 return std::unexpected(std::string{"inline bytes are base64 text or a list of bytes"});
5164}
5165
5166inline void ScreenCore::runTransfer(Command const& command, CommandCtx const& ctx, Done done) {
5167 Value const file = evalIn(*ctx.scope, ctx.bindings.get(), command.value);
5168 if (command.kind == CommandKind::Download) {
5169 runDownload(command, ctx, file, std::move(done));
5170 } else {
5171 runUpload(command, ctx, file, std::move(done));
5172 }
5173}
5174
5175inline void ScreenCore::runDownload(Command const& command, CommandCtx const& ctx, Value const& file, Done done) {
5176 Value const name = evalIn(*ctx.scope, ctx.bindings.get(), command.extra);
5177 auto const hold = std::make_shared<TransferHold>(*this, _alive);
5178 auto const settled = [this, weak = std::weak_ptr<RtScope>{ctx.scope}, target = command.target,
5179 preview = command.option == "preview", done,
5180 hold](std::expected<Value, std::string> const& reply) {
5181 auto const held = weak.lock();
5182 if (!held) {
5183 hold->release();
5184 return;
5185 }
5186 runtime().batch([&] {
5187 bool const succeeded = reply.has_value();
5188 NameRef const* const found = succeeded && preview ? held->find(target) : nullptr;
5189 if (found != nullptr && found->category == NameCategory::State) {
5190 initState(*found->state->scope, *found->state);
5191 session.noteWrite();
5192 found->state->value->set(*reply);
5193 }
5194 done(succeeded);
5195 hold->release();
5196 });
5197 };
5198 if (command.bytes) {
5199 std::optional<InlineFile> const inlined = inlineDownload(command, ctx, file, name);
5200 if (!inlined) {
5201 done(false);
5202 return;
5203 }
5204 if (host == nullptr || !host->saveFile(*inlined, command.option, settled)) {
5205 unsupported(command, "`download`");
5206 done(false);
5207 return;
5208 }
5209 hold->take();
5210 return;
5211 }
5212 if (host == nullptr || !host->download(file, command.option, name, settled)) {
5213 unsupported(command, "`download`");
5214 done(false);
5215 return;
5216 }
5217 hold->take();
5218}
5219
5220// Inline bytes are checked before the host is asked: content over the cap, or that does not decode, never reaches it.
5221inline std::optional<InlineFile> ScreenCore::inlineDownload(
5222 Command const& command, CommandCtx const& ctx,
5223 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(bugprone-easily-swappable-parameters): the command's `file` and `name`, in its order.
5224 Value const& file, Value const& name) {
5225 std::size_t const cap = session.options().maxInlineFileBytes;
5226 std::size_t size = 0;
5227 if (std::string const* const text = file.asString()) {
5228 size = base64Size(*text);
5229 } else if (ValueList const* const list = file.asList()) {
5230 size = list->size();
5231 }
5232 std::expected<std::string, std::string> bytes = size > cap ? std::unexpected(std::string{}) : inlineBytes(file);
5233 if (size > cap || (bytes && bytes->size() > cap)) {
5234 report(command.path, "download: " + sizeText(bytes ? bytes->size() : size) + " is over the " + sizeText(cap) +
5235 " inline cap; serve it through the file store");
5236 return std::nullopt;
5237 }
5238 if (!bytes) {
5239 report(command.path, "download: " + bytes.error());
5240 return std::nullopt;
5241 }
5242 return InlineFile{
5243 .name = textOf(name, session.formatting()),
5244 .mediaType = command.mediaType
5245 ? textOf(evalIn(*ctx.scope, ctx.bindings.get(), command.mediaType), session.formatting())
5246 : std::string{},
5247 .bytes = *std::move(bytes)};
5248}
5249
5250// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): one branch per outcome an upload can have.
5251inline void ScreenCore::runUpload(Command const& command, CommandCtx const& ctx, Value const& file, Done done) {
5252 RtScope const& scope = *ctx.scope;
5253 std::weak_ptr<RtScope> const weak = ctx.scope;
5254 auto const hold = std::make_shared<TransferHold>(*this, _alive);
5255 NameRef const* const transferName = command.transfer.empty() ? nullptr : scope.find(command.transfer);
5256 TransferState* const transfer =
5257 transferName != nullptr && transferName->category == NameCategory::Transfer ? transferName->transfer : nullptr;
5258 auto const progress = [weak, transfer](Value fraction) {
5259 if (weak.lock() && transfer != nullptr) {
5260 transfer->progress.set(std::move(fraction));
5261 }
5262 };
5263 // Settles with the members the mutation's body gets beside its own (the reference or the inline file), or the
5264 // failure.
5265 auto const settled = [this, weak, kept = detached(ctx), transfer, command = &command, done,
5266 hold](std::expected<ValueRecord, std::string> reply) {
5267 auto const held = weak.lock();
5268 if (!held) {
5269 hold->release();
5270 return;
5271 }
5272 runtime().batch([&] {
5273 if (transfer != nullptr) {
5274 transfer->pending.set(false);
5275 transfer->error.set(reply ? Value{} : Value{reply.error()});
5276 }
5277 if (!reply) {
5278 done(false);
5279 hold->release();
5280 return;
5281 }
5282 NameRef const* const found = held->find(command->target);
5283 // The mutation's body cannot name the reference (a body is checked where the mutation is declared),
5284 // so the reference is added to it under `as`, `file` by default.
5285 MutationRuntime& mutation = *found->mutation;
5286 Value const base = evalIn(*held, kept.bindings.get(), mutation.decl().body);
5287 ValueRecord fields = base.asRecord() == nullptr ? ValueRecord{} : *base.asRecord();
5288 for (auto& [member, value] : *reply) {
5289 fields.insert_or_assign(member, std::move(value));
5290 }
5291 // The run takes its own count before this one is given back, so pending never reads zero in between.
5292 mutation.run(Value{std::move(fields)}, std::make_shared<Bindings const>(*kept.bindings),
5293 [done](bool succeeded, Value const&) { done(succeeded); });
5294 hold->release();
5295 });
5296 };
5297 if (host == nullptr) {
5298 unsupported(command, "`upload`");
5299 done(false);
5300 return;
5301 }
5302 if (transfer != nullptr) {
5303 transfer->pending.set(true);
5304 transfer->progress.set(Value{std::int64_t{0}});
5305 transfer->error.set(Value{});
5306 }
5307 NameRef const* const target = scope.find(command.target);
5308 UploadRequest request{.file = file, .modelType = {}, .action = {}};
5309 if (target != nullptr && target->category == NameCategory::Mutation && target->mutation != nullptr) {
5310 request.modelType = target->mutation->typeId();
5311 request.action = target->mutation->decl().action;
5312 }
5313 std::string const member = command.binding.empty() ? std::string{"file"} : command.binding;
5314 bool started = false;
5315 if (command.bytes) {
5316 std::size_t const cap = session.options().maxInlineFileBytes;
5317 started = host->readFile(
5318 file, cap,
5319 [this, settled, progress, cap, member, command = &command](std::expected<InlineFile, std::string> read) {
5320 if (!read) {
5321 settled(std::unexpected(read.error()));
5322 return;
5323 }
5324 if (read->bytes.size() > cap) {
5325 // The host should have refused it; the cap holds whether or not it did.
5326 std::string why = "upload: " + sizeText(read->bytes.size()) + " is over the " + sizeText(cap) +
5327 " inline cap; send it through the file store";
5328 report(command->path, why);
5329 settled(std::unexpected(std::move(why)));
5330 return;
5331 }
5332 progress(Value{std::int64_t{1}});
5333 ValueRecord added;
5334 added.insert_or_assign(member, Value{base64Encode(read->bytes)});
5335 if (!command->nameAs.empty()) {
5336 added.insert_or_assign(command->nameAs, Value{read->name});
5337 }
5338 if (!command->typeAs.empty()) {
5339 added.insert_or_assign(command->typeAs, Value{read->mediaType});
5340 }
5341 settled(std::move(added));
5342 });
5343 } else {
5344 started = host->uploadFor(request, progress, [settled, member](std::expected<Value, std::string> reference) {
5345 if (!reference) {
5346 settled(std::unexpected(reference.error()));
5347 return;
5348 }
5349 ValueRecord added;
5350 added.insert_or_assign(member, *std::move(reference));
5351 settled(std::move(added));
5352 });
5353 }
5354 if (!started) {
5355 if (transfer != nullptr) {
5356 transfer->pending.set(false);
5357 transfer->progress.set(Value{});
5358 }
5359 unsupported(command, "`upload`");
5360 done(false);
5361 return;
5362 }
5363 hold->take();
5364}

5368namespace detail {

5370// --- Lowering --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5371
5372/// @brief A value as a `bool` property: `true` only for `true`.
5373/// @param value The value.
5374/// @param format Unused.
5375/// @return It.
5376[[nodiscard]] inline bool boolOf(Value const& value, FormatContext const& format) {
5377 static_cast<void>(format);
5378 bool const* const flag = value.asBool();
5379 return flag != nullptr && *flag;
5380}
5381
5382/// @brief A value as a text property.
5383/// @param value The value.
5384/// @param format The formatting facts.
5385/// @return Its text.
5386[[nodiscard]] inline std::string stringOf(Value const& value, FormatContext const& format) {
5387 return textOf(value, format);
5388}
5389
5390/// @brief A value as a custom component's text prop (spec 5 §10): an `int` or `exact` as plain decimal text, so no
5391/// id or amount loses precision; `json` as its JSON text; `string` as the formatted text.
5392/// @param value The value.
5393/// @param type The prop type the component declares.
5394/// @param format The formatting facts, for `string`.
5395/// @return The text.
5396[[nodiscard]] inline std::string componentText(Value const& value, std::string_view type,
5397 FormatContext const& format) {
5398 if (type == "json") {
5399 return canonicalJson(value);
5400 }
5401 if (type == "int" || type == "exact") {
5402 if (std::int64_t const* const whole = value.asInt()) {
5403 return std::to_string(*whole);
5404 }
5405 if (Decimal const* const number = value.asDecimal()) {
5406 return detail::decimalText(number->value, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(number->value.decimalPlaces.value));
5407 }
5408 if (Quantity const* const quantity = value.asQuantity()) {
5409 return detail::decimalText(quantity->value,
5410 static_cast<std::uint32_t>(quantity->value.decimalPlaces.value)) +
5411 " " + quantity->unit;
5412 }
5413 }
5414 return textOf(value, format);
5415}
5416
5417/// @brief A value as a custom component's `number` prop: the one kind that crosses as a double.
5418/// @param value The value.
5419/// @return It; zero for anything that is not a number.
5420[[nodiscard]] inline double componentNumber(Value const& value) {
5421 if (std::int64_t const* const whole = value.asInt()) {
5422 return static_cast<double>(*whole);
5423 }
5424 if (Decimal const* const number = value.asDecimal()) {
5425 return number->value.toDouble();
5426 }
5427 if (Quantity const* const quantity = value.asQuantity()) {
5428 return quantity->value.toDouble();
5429 }
5430 return 0.0;
5431}
5432
5433/// @brief A custom component's event payload as a value: `i:<int64>` an `int`, `s:<text>` a `string`, anything else
5434/// JSON text read as the event's declared type, and text that is none of those a `string`.
5435/// @param payload The payload, as the backend reports it.
5436/// @param type The payload type the component declares; null for an undeclared event.
5437/// @return The value.
5438[[nodiscard]] inline Value componentPayload(std::string const& payload, Type const* type) {
5439 std::string_view const text{payload};
5440 if (text.starts_with("i:")) {
5441 std::int64_t whole = 0;
5442 std::string_view const digits = text.substr(2);
5443 char const* const last = std::to_address(digits.end());
5444 auto const [end, error] = std::from_chars(std::to_address(digits.begin()), last, whole);
5445 if (error == std::errc{} && end == last) {
5446 return Value{whole};
5447 }
5448 }
5449 if (text.starts_with("s:")) {
5450 return Value{std::string{text.substr(2)}};
5451 }
5452 if (auto json = parseJson(text); json && type != nullptr) {
5453 if (auto value = valueFromJson(*json, *type)) {
5454 return std::move(*value);
5455 }
5456 }
5457 return Value{payload};
5458}
5459
5460/// @brief A value as an integer: an `int`, or a decimal truncated toward zero.
5461/// @param value The value.
5462/// @param fallback What anything else gives.
5463/// @return It.
5464[[nodiscard]] inline std::int64_t intOf(Value const& value, std::int64_t fallback) {
5465 if (std::int64_t const* const number = value.asInt()) {
5466 return *number;
5467 }
5468 if (Decimal const* const number = value.asDecimal()) {
5469 return static_cast<std::int64_t>(number->value.toDouble());
5470 }
5471 return fallback;
5472}
5473
5474/// @brief A text role by name.
5475/// @param name `normal`, `muted`, `heading` (or `title`), `section`, `error`, `success`.
5476/// @return The role; `nullopt` for any other name.
5477[[nodiscard]] inline std::optional<TextRole> roleNamed(std::string_view name) {
5478 if (name == "normal") {
5479 return TextRole::Normal;
5480 }
5481 if (name == "muted") {
5482 return TextRole::Muted;
5483 }
5484 if (name == "heading" || name == "title") {
5485 return TextRole::Heading;
5486 }
5487 if (name == "section") {
5488 return TextRole::Section;
5489 }
5490 if (name == "error") {
5491 return TextRole::Error;
5492 }
5493 if (name == "success") {
5494 return TextRole::Success;
5495 }
5496 return std::nullopt;
5497}
5498
5499/// @brief A text role by name, as `roleNamed` reads it.
5500/// @param value The name.
5501/// @param format Unused.
5502/// @return The role; `Normal` for any other name.
5503[[nodiscard]] inline TextRole roleOf(Value const& value, FormatContext const& format) {
5504 return roleNamed(textOf(value, format)).value_or(TextRole::Normal);
5505}
5506
5507/// @brief A tone by name.
5508/// @param value `neutral`, `info`, `ok` (or `success`), `warn` (or `warning`), `err` (or `error`).
5509/// @param format Unused.
5510/// @return The tone; `Neutral` for anything else.
5511[[nodiscard]] inline Tone toneOf(Value const& value, FormatContext const& format) {
5512 std::string const text = textOf(value, format);
5513 if (text == "info") {
5514 return Tone::Info;
5515 }
5516 if (text == "ok" || text == "success") {
5517 return Tone::Ok;
5518 }
5519 if (text == "warn" || text == "warning") {
5520 return Tone::Warn;
5521 }
5522 if (text == "err" || text == "error") {
5523 return Tone::Err;
5524 }
5525 return Tone::Neutral;
5526}
5527
5528/// @brief A sizing by its document form: `"content"`, `{"fixed": n}` or `{"stretch": w}`.
5529/// @param value The value.
5530/// @return The sizing.
5531[[nodiscard]] inline Sizing sizingOf(Value const& value) {
5532 if (Value const* const fixed = value.field("fixed")) {
5533 return Sizing::fixed(static_cast<int>(intOf(*fixed, 0)));
5534 }
5535 if (Value const* const stretch = value.field("stretch")) {
5536 return Sizing::stretch(static_cast<int>(intOf(*stretch, 1)));
5537 }
5538 return Sizing::content();
5539}
5540
5541/// @brief Whether a value is a sizing of one dimension: `"content"`, `{"fixed": n}` or `{"stretch": w}`.
5542/// @param value The value.
5543/// @return Whether `sizingOf` reads it as written rather than as content by default.
5544[[nodiscard]] inline bool isSizing(Value const& value) {
5545 if (std::string const* const text = value.asString()) {
5546 return *text == "content";
5547 }
5548 ValueRecord const* const record = value.asRecord();
5549 return record != nullptr && record->size() == 1 && (record->contains("fixed") || record->contains("stretch")) &&
5550 record->begin()->second.asInt() != nullptr;
5551}
5552
5553/// @brief An alignment by name, as the loader checked it: `start`, `center`, `end`, or stretch for none.
5554/// @param name The name; empty for none.
5555/// @return The alignment.
5556[[nodiscard]] inline Align alignOf(std::string_view name) {
5557 if (name == "start") {
5558 return Align::Start;
5559 }
5560 if (name == "center") {
5561 return Align::Center;
5562 }
5563 if (name == "end") {
5564 return Align::End;
5565 }
5566 return Align::Stretch;
5567}
5568
5569/// @brief A justification by name, as the loader checked it: `center`, `end`, `between`, or start for none.
5570/// @param name The name; empty for none.
5571/// @return The justification.
5572[[nodiscard]] inline Justify justifyOf(std::string_view name) {
5573 if (name == "center") {
5574 return Justify::Center;
5575 }
5576 if (name == "end") {
5577 return Justify::End;
5578 }
5579 if (name == "between") {
5580 return Justify::Between;
5581 }
5582 return Justify::Start;
5583}
5584
5585/// @brief An axis by name: `horizontal`, or vertical for anything else.
5586/// @param value The value.
5587/// @return The axis.
5588[[nodiscard]] inline Axis axisOf(Value const& value) {
5589 std::string const* const text = value.asString();
5590 return text != nullptr && *text == "horizontal" ? Axis::Horizontal : Axis::Vertical;
5591}
5592
5593/// @brief A step's state by name: `active`, `done`, `failed`, or pending for anything else.
5594/// @param name The name.
5595/// @return The state.
5596[[nodiscard]] inline StepState stepStateOf(std::string_view name) {
5597 if (name == "active") {
5598 return StepState::Active;
5599 }
5600 if (name == "done") {
5601 return StepState::Done;
5602 }
5603 return name == "failed" ? StepState::Failed : StepState::Pending;
5604}
5605
5606/// @brief The options of a select, from a list of scalars or of records with a key and a `label`.
5607/// @param options The list.
5608/// @param format The formatting facts.
5609/// @return The options.
5610[[nodiscard]] inline std::vector<SelectOption> selectOptions(Value const& options, FormatContext const& format) {
5611 std::vector<SelectOption> out;
5612 if (ValueList const* const items = options.asList()) {
5613 for (Value const& option : *items) {
5614 Value const key = optionKey(option);
5615 Value const* const label = option.field("label");
5616 out.push_back(SelectOption{.key = keyOf(key), .label = textOf(label != nullptr ? *label : key, format)});
5617 }
5618 }
5619 return out;
5620}
5621
5622/// @brief Content whose scope is made when it mounts and released when it unmounts: a one-row `forEach` whose
5623/// row view builds it.
5624/// @param build Builds the content, its scope included.
5625/// @return The node.
5626[[nodiscard]] inline Node lazy(std::function<Node()> build) {
5627 return ui::forEach<int>([] { return std::vector<int>{0}; }, [](int const&) { return Key{std::int64_t{0}}; },
5628 [build = std::move(build)](reactive::Signal<int> const&) { return build(); });
5629}
5630
5631/// @brief A column of content that holds its scope for as long as it is mounted: its `visible` is a binding
5632/// that keeps the scope alive and reads nothing.
5633/// @param children The content.
5634/// @param scope The scope.
5635/// @param keys The chords of the content.
5636/// @return The node.
5637[[nodiscard]] inline Node holding(std::vector<Node> children, std::shared_ptr<RtScope> scope,
5638 std::vector<KeyBinding> keys = {}) {
5639 Column column{.children = std::move(children)};
5640 column.common.visible = Prop<bool>{[held = std::move(scope)] { return held != nullptr; }};
5641 column.common.keys = std::move(keys);
5642 return ui::column(std::move(column));
5643}

5645// NOLINTBEGIN(misc-no-recursion): a menu nests, and lowering descends the document.
5646inline Node ScreenCore::lower(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx) {
5647 if (recording) {
5648 if (loweredNodes.size() >= kPruneLoweredAt && loweredNodes.size() % kPruneLoweredAt == 0) {
5649 std::erase_if(loweredNodes, [](LoweredNode const& entry) { return entry.scope.expired(); });
5650 }
5651 loweredNodes.push_back(LoweredNode{.node = &node, .scope = ctx.scope, .bindings = ctx.bindings});
5652 }
5653 return lowerKind(node, ctx, elementFor(*ctx.scope, node));
5654}

5656inline Prop<TextRole> ScreenCore::roleProp(LowerCtx const& ctx, ExprPtr const& expr) {
5657 if (!expr || expr->kind == ExprKind::Literal) {
5658 return bindProp<TextRole>(ctx, expr, TextRole::Normal, roleOf);
5659 }
5660 return slotProp<TextRole>([this, scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, expr] {
5661 Value const value = evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), expr);
5662 std::optional<TextRole> const role = roleNamed(textOf(value, session.formatting()));
5663 if (!role) {
5664 report(expr->path, "role is " + canonicalJson(value) +
5665 "; a role is normal, muted, heading, section, error or success");
5666 }
5667 return role.value_or(TextRole::Normal);
5668 });
5669}
5670
5671// The size request: `sizing` (the width, or both dimensions), `alignSelf`, and the bounds.
5672inline void ScreenCore::layoutOf(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, LayoutHints& layout) {
5673 if (ExprPtr const sizing = node.prop("sizing")) {
5674 // The width, or both dimensions from a `{width, height}` record, one left out being content. The loader
5675 // refuses a literal of another form; a computed one that is none is reported and lowers to content.
5676 Value const value = once(ctx, sizing);
5677 Value const* const width = value.field("width");
5678 Value const* const height = value.field("height");
5679 bool const record = width != nullptr || height != nullptr;
5680 bool const valid = record ? (width == nullptr || isSizing(*width)) && (height == nullptr || isSizing(*height))
5681 : isSizing(value);
5682 if (!valid) {
5683 report(sizing->path, "sizing is " + canonicalJson(value) +
5684 "; a sizing is \"content\", {\"fixed\": n}, {\"stretch\": w}, or a record of "
5685 "width and height of them");
5686 } else if (record) {
5687 layout.width = width != nullptr ? sizingOf(*width) : Sizing::content();
5688 layout.height = height != nullptr ? sizingOf(*height) : Sizing::content();
5689 } else {
5690 layout.width = sizingOf(value);
5691 }
5692 }
5693 if (std::string_view const placed = node.name("alignSelf"); !placed.empty()) {
5694 layout.alignSelf = alignOf(placed);
5695 }
5696 // Literal integers, checked at load.
5697 for (auto const& [key, bound] :
5698 {std::pair{"minWidth", &LayoutHints::minWidth}, std::pair{"maxWidth", &LayoutHints::maxWidth},
5699 std::pair{"minHeight", &LayoutHints::minHeight}, std::pair{"maxHeight", &LayoutHints::maxHeight}}) {
5700 if (ExprPtr const expr = node.prop(key); expr != nullptr && expr->literal.asInt() != nullptr) {
5701 layout.*bound = static_cast<int>(*expr->literal.asInt());
5702 }
5703 }
5704}
5705
5706inline void ScreenCore::commonOf(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element, Common& common) {
5707 static_cast<void>(element);
5708 common.visible = bindProp<bool>(ctx, node.prop("visible"), true, boolOf);
5709 common.enabled = bindProp<bool>(ctx, node.prop("enabled"), true, boolOf);
5710 common.tooltip = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, node.prop("tooltip"), std::string{}, stringOf);
5711 layoutOf(node, ctx, common.layout);
5712 common.testId = std::string{node.name("testId")};
5713 common.focusId = node.id;
5714 common.surface = std::string{node.name("surface")};
5715 if (ExprPtr const autofocus = node.prop("autofocus")) {
5716 common.autofocus = boolOf(once(ctx, autofocus), session.formatting());
5717 }
5718 for (DocNodePtr const& a11y : node.partList("a11y")) {
5719 common.a11y.name = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, a11y->prop("name"), std::string{}, stringOf);
5720 common.a11y.role = std::string{a11y->name("role")};
5721 }
5722 for (DocNodePtr const& drag : node.partList("drag")) {
5723 ExprPtr const payload = drag->prop("payload");
5724 common.dragKey = slotProp<std::optional<Key>>(
5725 [scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, payload]() -> std::optional<Key> {
5726 Value const value = evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), payload);
5727 return value.isNull() ? std::nullopt : std::optional<Key>{keyOf(value)};
5728 });
5729 }
5730 for (DocNodePtr const& drop : node.partList("drop")) {
5731 ExprPtr const accepts = drop->prop("accepts");
5732 common.accepts = [this, scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, accepts](Key const& key) {
5733 if (!accepts) {
5734 return true;
5735 }
5736 Value const accepted = runtime().untracked([&] { return evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), accepts); });
5737 if (ValueList const* const items = accepted.asList()) {
5738 return std::ranges::any_of(*items, [&](Value const& item) { return keyOf(item) == key; });
5739 }
5740 return accepted.isNull() || keyOf(accepted) == key;
5741 };
5742 common.onDrop = [this, ctx, commands = drop->event("onDrop")](Key const& key) {
5743 runEvent(commands, ctx, valueOfKey(key));
5744 };
5745 }
5746 for (auto const& [chord, commands] : node.keys) {
5747 common.keys.push_back(
5748 KeyBinding{.chord = chord, .onPress = [this, ctx, list = &commands] { runEvent(list, ctx, Value{}); }});
5749 }
5750}

5752inline void ScreenCore::fieldOf(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element, FieldState& field) {
5753 field.readonly = bindProp<bool>(ctx, node.prop("readonly"), false, boolOf);
5754 field.required = bindProp<bool>(ctx, node.prop("required"), false, boolOf);
5755 field.stale = bindProp<bool>(ctx, node.prop("stale"), false, boolOf);
5756 if (element != nullptr) {
5757 field.errors = slotProp<std::vector<std::string>>(
5758 [this, scope = ctx.scope, element] { return stringsOf(elementValue(*element, "shownErrors")); });
5759 } else if (ExprPtr const errors = node.prop("errors")) {
5760 field.errors = slotProp<std::vector<std::string>>([scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, errors] {
5761 return stringsOf(evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), errors));
5762 });
5763 }
5764}

5766inline std::vector<MenuItem> ScreenCore::menuItems(std::span<DocNodePtr const> parts, LowerCtx const& ctx) {
5767 std::vector<MenuItem> items;
5768 for (DocNodePtr const& part : parts) {
5769 MenuItem item;
5770 item.label = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, part->prop("label"), std::string{}, stringOf);
5771 if (Commands const* const commands = part->event("onClick")) {
5772 item.onSelect = [this, ctx, commands] { runEvent(commands, ctx, Value{}); };
5773 }
5774 if (ExprPtr const icon = part->prop("icon")) {
5775 item.icon = textOf(once(ctx, icon), session.formatting());
5776 }
5777 item.keys = std::string{part->name("keys")};
5778 if (ExprPtr const checked = part->prop("checked")) {
5779 item.checked = slotProp<std::optional<bool>>(
5780 [scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, checked]() -> std::optional<bool> {
5781 Value const value = evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), checked);
5782 bool const* const flag = value.asBool();
5783 return flag == nullptr ? std::nullopt : std::optional<bool>{*flag};
5784 });
5785 }
5786 item.enabled = bindProp<bool>(ctx, part->prop("enabled"), true, boolOf);
5787 item.items = menuItems(part->partList("items"), ctx);
5788 items.push_back(std::move(item));
5789 }
5790 return items;
5791}

5793inline ActionModels ScreenCore::lowerActionParts(std::span<DocNodePtr const> parts, LowerCtx const& ctx) {
5794 ActionModels models;
5795 models.reserve(parts.size());
5796 for (DocNodePtr const& part : parts) {
5797 ActionModel model{.id = part->id,
5798 .path = part->path,
5799 .label = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, part->prop("label"), std::string{}, stringOf),
5800 .icon = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, part->prop("icon"), std::string{}, stringOf),
5801 .emphasis = ButtonEmphasis::Normal,
5802 .enabled = bindProp<bool>(ctx, part->prop("enabled"), true, boolOf),
5803 .visible = bindProp<bool>(ctx, part->prop("visible"), true, boolOf),
5804 .run = {}};
5805 if (part->name("emphasis") == "primary") {
5806 model.emphasis = ButtonEmphasis::Primary;
5807 } else if (part->name("emphasis") == "danger") {
5808 model.emphasis = ButtonEmphasis::Danger;
5809 }
5810 if (Commands const* const commands = part->event("onClick")) {
5811 model.run = [this, ctx, commands] { runEvent(commands, ctx, Value{}); };
5812 }
5813 models.push_back(std::move(model));
5814 }
5815 return models;
5816}

5845// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): one case per kind of ui/1.
5846inline Node ScreenCore::lowerKind(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element) {
5847 std::string_view const kind = node.kind;
5848 FormatContext const& format = session.formatting();
5849 auto children = [&](std::string_view key) {
5850 std::vector<Node> out;
5851 for (DocNodePtr const& child : node.nodes(key)) {
5852 out.push_back(lower(*child, ctx));
5853 }
5854 return out;
5855 };
5856 auto child = [&](std::string_view key) -> Node {
5857 auto const nodes = node.nodes(key);
5858 return nodes.empty() ? Node{} : lowerAll(nodes, ctx);
5859 };
5860 auto onceInt = [&](std::string_view key, std::int64_t fallback) {
5861 ExprPtr const expr = node.prop(key);
5862 return expr ? intOf(once(ctx, expr), fallback) : fallback;
5863 };
5864 auto onceBool = [&](std::string_view key, bool fallback) {
5865 ExprPtr const expr = node.prop(key);
5866 return expr ? boolOf(once(ctx, expr), format) : fallback;
5867 };
5868 auto onceText = [&](std::string_view key) {
5869 ExprPtr const expr = node.prop(key);
5870 return expr ? textOf(once(ctx, expr), format) : std::string{};
5871 };
5872 auto textProp = [&](std::string_view key) {
5873 return bindProp<std::string>(ctx, node.prop(key), std::string{}, stringOf);
5874 };
5875 // A field shows no caption of its own, so its label is what names it to assistive technology. An `a11y` part
5876 // that gives a name was written for that purpose and wins; one that gives only a role leaves the label.
5877 auto nameByLabel = [&](Common& common) {
5878 bool const named = std::ranges::any_of(node.partList("a11y"),
5879 [](DocNodePtr const& a11y) { return a11y->prop("name") != nullptr; });
5880 if (node.prop("label") && !named) {
5881 common.a11y.name = textProp("label");
5882 }
5883 };
5884 // A standalone input draws its label as a caption only when the document asks for it (`showLabel`).
5885 auto captionOf = [&](auto& spec) {
5886 if (node.prop("label")) {
5887 spec.label = textProp("label");
5888 }
5889 spec.showLabel = node.flag("showLabel");
5890 };
5891 auto action = [&](std::string_view key) -> Action {
5892 Commands const* const commands = node.event(key);
5893 if (commands == nullptr) {
5894 return {};
5895 }
5896 return [this, ctx, commands] { runEvent(commands, ctx, Value{}); };
5897 };
5898 auto actionPart = [&]() {
5899 ActionButton button;
5900 for (DocNodePtr const& part : node.partList("action")) {
5901 button.label = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, part->prop("label"), std::string{}, stringOf);
5902 if (Commands const* const commands = part->event("onClick")) {
5903 button.onClick = [this, ctx, commands] { runEvent(commands, ctx, Value{}); };
5904 }
5905 }
5906 return button;
5907 };
5908 auto read = [element, this](std::string_view name) {
5909 return [element, this, name = std::string{name}] { return elementValue(*element, name); };
5910 };
5911
5912 if (kind == "text") {
5913 Text spec{.text = textProp("text"), .role = roleProp(ctx, node.prop("role"))};
5914 fieldOf(node, ctx, element, spec.field);
5915 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
5916 return ui::text(std::move(spec));
5917 }
5918 if (kind == "button") {
5919 Button spec{.label = textProp("label")};
5920 spec.icon = onceText("icon");
5921 if (node.name("emphasis") == "primary") {
5922 spec.emphasis = ButtonEmphasis::Primary;
5923 } else if (node.name("emphasis") == "danger") {
5924 spec.emphasis = ButtonEmphasis::Danger;
5925 }
5926 if (node.name("style") == "item") {
5927 spec.style = ButtonStyle::Item;
5928 spec.selected = bindProp<bool>(ctx, node.prop("selected"), false, boolOf);
5929 }
5930 Commands const* const onClick = node.event("onClick");
5931 Commands const* const onActivate = node.event("onActivate");
5932 if (onClick != nullptr || onActivate != nullptr) {
5933 spec.onClick = [this, ctx, onClick, onActivate] {
5934 runEvent(onClick, ctx, Value{});
5935 runEvent(onActivate, ctx, Value{});
5936 };
5937 }
5938 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
5939 return ui::button(std::move(spec));
5940 }
5941 if (kind == "textInput") {
5942 std::string const commitOn = node.name("commitOn").empty() ? "change" : std::string{node.name("commitOn")};
5943 auto commit = [this, ctx, element, commitOn, onChange = node.event("onChange")](std::string const& when,
5944 std::string const& text) {
5945 if (commitOn != when) {
5946 return;
5947 }
5948 if (element->bound == nullptr) {
5949 session.noteWrite();
5950 element->committed.set(Value{text});
5951 }
5952 runEvent(onChange, ctx, Value{text});
5953 };
5954 TextInput spec;
5955 spec.value =
5956 slotProp<std::string>([this, element] { return textOf(element->draft.get(), session.formatting()); });
5957 spec.onChange = [this, element, commit](std::string text) {
5958 session.asUser([&] {
5959 session.noteWrite();
5960 element->draft.set(Value{text});
5961 element->edited.set(true);
5962 });
5963 commit("change", text);
5964 };
5965 spec.onCommit = [this, ctx, element, commit, onCommit = node.event("onCommit")](std::string const& text) {
5966 element->touched.set(true);
5967 commit("blur", text);
5968 runEvent(onCommit, ctx, Value{text});
5969 };
5970 spec.onSubmit = [this, ctx, commit, onSubmit = node.event("onSubmit")](std::string const& text) {
5971 commit("enter", text);
5972 runEvent(onSubmit, ctx, Value{text});
5973 };
5974 spec.placeholder = textProp("placeholder");
5975 std::string const mode = onceText("mode");
5976 spec.mode = TextInputMode::SingleLine;
5977 if (mode == "multiline") {
5978 spec.mode = TextInputMode::Multiline;
5979 } else if (mode == "password") {
5980 spec.mode = TextInputMode::Password;
5981 }
5982 spec.icon = onceText("icon");
5983 fieldOf(node, ctx, element, spec.field);
5984 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
5985 nameByLabel(spec.common);
5986 captionOf(spec);
5987 return ui::textInput(std::move(spec));
5988 }
5989 if (kind == "checkbox") {
5990 Checkbox spec{.label = textProp("label"), .checked = slotProp<bool>([read = read("checked")] {
5991 Value const value = read();
5992 bool const* const flag = value.asBool();
5993 return flag != nullptr && *flag;
5994 })};
5995 spec.onToggle = [this, ctx, element, onToggle = node.event("onToggle"),
5996 onChange = node.event("onChange")](bool checked) {
5997 if (element->bound == nullptr) {
5998 session.asUser([&] {
5999 session.noteWrite();
6000 element->draft.set(checked);
6001 });
6002 }
6003 runEvent(onToggle, ctx, Value{checked});
6004 runEvent(onChange, ctx, Value{checked});
6005 };
6006 fieldOf(node, ctx, element, spec.field);

6010 if (kind == "select") {

6015 Value const selected = read();

6017 });
6018 spec.onSelect = [this, ctx, element, onChoose = node.event("onChoose"),
6019 onChange = node.event("onChange")](Key const& key) {

6045 spec.onChange = [this, ctx, element, onChange = node.event("onChange")](std::int64_t value) {
6046 session.asUser([&] {
6047 session.noteWrite();
6048 element->draft.set(value);
6049 element->edited.set(true);
6050 if (element->bound == nullptr) {
6051 element->committed.set(value);
6052 }
6053 });
6054 runEvent(onChange, ctx, Value{value});
6055 };

6213 [scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, expr = node.prop("value")]() -> std::optional<double> {
6214 Value const value = evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), expr);

6226 }

6228 Steps spec;

6230 slotProp<std::vector<Step>>([this, scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, expr = node.prop("items")] {

6232 Value const items = evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), expr);
6233 if (ValueList const* const list = items.asList()) {
6234 for (Value const& item : *list) {
6235 Value const* const label = item.field("label");

6238 steps.push_back(

6259 if (ValueList const* const list = items.asList()) {
6260 for (Value const& item : *list) {

6262 Value const* const value = item.field("value");
6263 out.push_back(KeyValueItem{
6264 .label = label == nullptr ? std::string{} : textOf(*label, session.formatting()),

6273 if (kind == "emptyState") {

6293 }

6299 if (kind == "dropZone") {
6300 DropZone spec;

6302 spec.multiple = onceBool("multiple", false);

6312 if (kind == "boundary") {

6321 if (kind == "form") {
