6331/// @brief A document field overlay's expressions, evaluated once, as the engine's overlay.
6332/// @param scope The scope the form is declared in.
6333/// @param part The `fields` entry.
6334/// @param format How values read as text and numbers.
6335/// @return The overlay.
6336[[nodiscard]] inline forms::FieldOverlay overlayOf(RtScope const& scope, DocNode const& part,
6337 FormatContext const& format) {
6338 auto const read = [&](std::string_view key) -> std::optional<Value> {
6339 ExprPtr const expr = part.prop(key);
6340 if (!expr) {
6341 return std::nullopt;
6342 }
6343 return scope.core.runtime().untracked([&] { return evalIn(scope, nullptr, expr); });
6344 };
6345 auto const text = [&](std::string_view key) -> std::optional<std::string> {
6346 auto const value = read(key);
6347 return value.has_value() && !value->isNull() ? std::optional<std::string>{textOf(*value, format)}
6348 : std::nullopt;
6349 };
6350 auto const flag = [&](std::string_view key) {
6351 auto const value = read(key);
6352 bool const* const set = value.has_value() ? value->asBool() : nullptr;
6353 return set != nullptr && *set;
6354 };
6355 forms::FieldOverlay overlay{.omit = flag("omit"), .hidden = flag("hidden")};
6356 overlay.label = text("label");
6357 overlay.unit = text("unit");
6358 overlay.widget = text("widget");
6359 if (auto const decimals = read("decimals");
6360 decimals.has_value() && decimals->asInt() != nullptr && *decimals->asInt() >= 0) {
6361 overlay.decimals = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::min<std::int64_t>(*decimals->asInt(), 18));
6362 }
6363 if (auto const blankAs = text("blankAs")) {
6364 overlay.blankAs = *blankAs == "empty" ? forms::BlankAs::Empty : forms::BlankAs::Omit;
6365 }
6366 return overlay;
6367}
6368
6369/// @brief A lowering context whose scope is held weakly: what an Effect the scope itself owns may keep, so the scope
6370/// does not keep itself alive.
6371struct DetachedLower {
6372 /// @brief The scope, weakly.
6373 std::weak_ptr<RtScope> scope;
6374 /// @brief The names bound there.
6375 std::shared_ptr<Bindings const> bindings;
6376 /// @brief The innermost boundary.
6377 std::shared_ptr<BoundaryRuntime> boundary;
6378};
6379
6380/// @brief Detaches a lowering context's scope.
6381/// @param ctx The context.
6382/// @return The context, its scope held weakly.
6383[[nodiscard]] inline DetachedLower detachedLower(LowerCtx const& ctx) {
6384 return DetachedLower{.scope = ctx.scope, .bindings = ctx.bindings, .boundary = ctx.boundary};
6385}
6386
6387/// @brief Puts a detached context's scope back.
6388/// @param held The detached context.
6389/// @return The context; its scope is null once the scope is gone.
6390[[nodiscard]] inline LowerCtx attached(DetachedLower const& held) {
6391 return LowerCtx{.scope = held.scope.lock(), .bindings = held.bindings, .boundary = held.boundary};
6392}
6393
6394// Builds the form's session when its element is declared, so its values can be read before the form is drawn.
6395inline void ScreenCore::wireForm(ElementState& element) {
6396 DocNode const& node = *element.node;
6397 RtScope& scope = *element.scope;
6398 std::string const action{node.name("action")};
6399 Catalog const& catalog = session.options().catalog;
6400 std::optional<std::string> const schema = catalog.schema ? catalog.schema(action) : std::nullopt;
6401 if (!schema.has_value()) {
6402 report(node.path, "no schema for `" + action + "`: the catalog has none for a `form` to build from");
6403 return;
6404 }
6405 NameRef const* const alias = scope.find(node.name("model"));
6406 if (alias == nullptr || alias->model == nullptr) {
6407 report(node.path, "`" + std::string{node.name("model")} + "` is not a model alias");
6408 return;
6409 }
6410 forms::FieldOverlays overlays;
6411 // `fields` is one record part holding a `field` part per overlaid member.
6412 for (DocNodePtr const& record : node.partList("fields")) {
6413 for (DocNodePtr const& part : record->partList("fields")) {
6414 overlays.insert_or_assign(part->id, overlayOf(scope, *part, session.formatting()));
6415 }
6416 }
6417 auto model = forms::FormModel::fromSchema(action, *schema, overlays);
6418 if (!model) {
6419 report(node.path,
6420 "the form of `" + action + "` does not build: " + model.error().path + ": " + model.error().message);
6421 return;
6422 }
6423 if (node.name("submit") == "explicit") {
6424 model = model->withSubmitMode(forms::SubmitMode::Explicit);
6425 } else if (node.name("submit") == "auto") {
6426 model = model->withSubmitMode(forms::SubmitMode::Automatic);
6427 }
6428 element.form = std::make_unique<forms::FormSession>(runtime(), *std::move(model), aliasSubmits(alias->model),
6429 aliasCalls(alias->model), engineOptions());
6430 if (ExprPtr const prefill = node.prop("prefill")) {
6431 // A prefill follows its expression. A value of the record being edited (the first value, or one under the
6432 // same `key`) keeps the fields the user changed; another record, a new `key`, or any later value of a form
6433 // without one, loads every field.
6434 forms::FormSession* const form = element.form.get();
6435 struct Followed {
6436 bool loaded = false;
6437 Value key;
6438 };
6439 auto const followed = std::make_shared<Followed>();
6440 scope.nodes.effect([this, &scope, prefill, key = node.prop("key"), form, followed] {
6441 Value const value = evalIn(scope, nullptr, prefill);
6442 if (value.isNull()) {
6443 return;
6444 }
6445 runtime().untracked([&] {
6446 Value const current = key ? evalIn(scope, nullptr, key) : Value{};
6447 bool const same = !followed->loaded || (key && current == followed->key);
6448 followed->loaded = true;
6449 followed->key = current;
6450 std::string const json = glz::write_json(valueToJson(value)).value_or(std::string{});
6451 if (same) {
6452 form->refill(json);
6453 } else {
6454 form->prefill(json);
6455 }
6456 });
6457 });
6458 }
6459}
6460
6461inline Node ScreenCore::lowerForm(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element) {
6462 forms::FormSession* const form = element == nullptr ? nullptr : element->form.get();
6463 if (form == nullptr) {
6464 return ui::text(Text{.text = std::string{node.name("action")}, .role = TextRole::Muted});
6465 }
6466 // The form's events, each run once per change of the count it watches.
6467 auto const watch = [this, &ctx](Commands const* commands, auto count, auto payload) {
6468 if (commands == nullptr || commands->empty()) {
6469 return;
6470 }
6471 auto const seen = std::make_shared<std::uint64_t>(runtime().untracked(count));
6472 ctx.scope->nodes.effect([this, held = detachedLower(ctx), commands, count, payload, seen] {
6473 std::uint64_t const now = count();
6474 if (now == *seen) {
6475 return;
6476 }
6477 *seen = now;
6478 runtime().untracked([&] { runEvent(commands, attached(held), payload()); });
6479 });
6480 };
6481 watch(
6482 node.event("onSubmit"), [form] { return form->submitAttempts(); },
6483 [form] {
6484 std::optional<std::string> const body = form->body();
6485 return body.has_value() ? jsonTextValue(*body) : Value{};
6486 });
6487 watch(
6488 node.event("onSuccess"), [form] { return form->successCount(); },
6489 [form] {
6490 std::optional<std::string> const& reply = form->lastReply();
6491 return reply.has_value() ? jsonTextValue(*reply) : Value{};
6492 });
6493 if (Commands const* const onError = node.event("onError"); onError != nullptr && !onError->empty()) {
6494 // Each failure is a new exception: run once per failure, with its text.
6495 auto const seen =
6496 std::make_shared<std::exception_ptr>(runtime().untracked([form] { return form->lastError(); }));
6497 ctx.scope->nodes.effect([this, held = detachedLower(ctx), onError, form, seen] {
6498 std::exception_ptr const error = form->lastError();
6499 if (error == nullptr || error == *seen) {
6500 return;
6501 }
6502 *seen = error;
6503 runtime().untracked([&] { runEvent(onError, attached(held), Value{failureText(error)}); });
6504 });
6505 }
6506 forms::FormViewOptions options{.showTitle = false};
6507 presentForm(node, ctx, options);
6508 options.title = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, node.prop("title"), std::string{}, stringOf);
6509 // A field whose overlay names a component is drawn by it; only top-level fields take one, as every overlay.
6510 for (DocNodePtr const& record : node.partList("fields")) {
6511 for (DocNodePtr const& overlay : record->partList("fields")) {
6512 if (!overlay->name("component").empty()) {
6513 options.overrides.byField(overlay->id,
6514 [this, ctx, field = overlay.get()](forms::FieldView const& view) {
6515 return fieldComponent(view, *field, ctx);
6516 });
6517 }
6518 }
6519 }
6520 Column column{.children = {forms::formView(*form, std::move(options))}};
6521 commonOf(node, ctx, element, column.common);
6522 return ui::column(std::move(column));
6523}
6524
6525/// @brief A component's `change` payload as the wire value of the field it draws, read as the `value` prop's
6526/// declared type.
6527/// @param payload The payload, as the backend reports it.
6528/// @param type The `value` prop's type.
6529/// @return The wire value, or why the payload is not one.
6530[[nodiscard]] inline std::expected<forms::detail::engine::Json, std::string> changeWire(std::string const& payload,
6531 std::string_view type) {
6532 std::string_view text{payload};
6533 if (type == "string") {
6534 if (text.starts_with("s:")) {
6535 text.remove_prefix(2);
6536 }
6537 return forms::detail::engine::Json{std::string{text}};
6538 }
6539 if (text.starts_with("i:")) {
6540 text.remove_prefix(2);
6541 }
6542 std::optional<forms::detail::engine::Json> json = forms::detail::engine::parseJson(text);
6543 if (!json) {
6544 return std::unexpected(std::string{"it is not JSON"});
6545 }
6546 bool const fits = type == "json" || json->is_null() || (type == "bool" && json->is_boolean()) ||
6547 ((type == "int" || type == "number") && json->is_number()) ||
6548 (type == "exact" && (json->is_number() || json->is_string()));
6549 if (!fits) {
6550 return std::unexpected("it is not " + std::string{type == "int" ? "an " : "a "} + std::string{type});
6551 }
6552 return *std::move(json);
6553}
6554
6555/// @brief What a form fills of a field component's props: the field's value, errors, read-only and required state,
6556/// and label, each a tracked read of the field.
6557/// @param prop The prop's name.
6558/// @param state The field.
6559/// @return The read, or empty for a prop the form does not fill.
6560[[nodiscard]] inline std::function<Value()> formFilled(std::string const& prop, forms::FieldState* state) {
6561 if (prop == "value") {
6562 return [state] {
6563 forms::Encoding const& encoding = state->encoded().get();
6564 if (!encoding.has_value() || !encoding->has_value()) {
6565 return Value{};
6566 }
6567 return (*encoding)->value.isNull() ? jsonTextValue((*encoding)->json) : (*encoding)->value;
6568 };
6569 }
6570 if (prop == "errors") {
6571 return [state] {
6572 std::optional<forms::FieldError> const& error = state->error().get();
6573 return error.has_value() ? Value{ValueList{Value{error->message}}} : Value{ValueList{}};
6574 };
6575 }
6576 if (prop == "readonly") {
6577 return [state] { return Value{state->readonly().get()}; };
6578 }
6579 if (prop == "required") {
6580 return [state] { return Value{state->required().get()}; };
6581 }
6582 if (prop == "label") {
6583 return [state] { return Value{state->label()}; };
6584 }
6585 return {};
6586}
6587
6588// NOLINTNEXTLINE(bugprone-easily-swappable-parameters): a prop's name, then its declared type.
6589inline CustomProp ScreenCore::componentProp(std::string const& prop, std::string const& type,
6590 std::function<Value()> read) {
6591 if (type == "bool") {
6592 return CustomProp{.name = prop, .value = slotProp<bool>([this, read = std::move(read)] {
6593 return boolOf(read(), session.formatting());
6594 })};
6595 }
6596 if (type == "number") {
6597 return CustomProp{.name = prop,
6598 .value = slotProp<double>([read = std::move(read)] { return componentNumber(read()); })};
6599 }
6600 return CustomProp{.name = prop, .value = slotProp<std::string>([this, read = std::move(read), type] {
6601 return componentText(read(), type, session.formatting());
6602 })};
6603}
6604
6605inline void ScreenCore::changeField(forms::FieldState& state, forms::FieldSpec const& spec, std::string const& path,
6606 std::string_view valueType, std::string const& payload) {
6607 auto wire = changeWire(payload, valueType);
6608 // A base64 member holds a file's bytes, which a document moves inline only under the session's cap.
6609 if (std::size_t const cap = session.options().maxInlineFileBytes;
6610 wire && spec.bytes && wire->is_string() && base64Size(wire->get_string()) > cap) {
6611 report(path, "field " + spec.name + ": " + std::to_string(base64Size(wire->get_string())) +
6612 " bytes is over the " + std::to_string(cap) + " inline cap");
6613 return;
6614 }
6615 if (wire) {
6616 if (auto edited = state.edit(*wire); !edited) {
6617 wire = std::unexpected(edited.error());
6618 }
6619 }
6620 if (!wire) {
6621 report(path, "field " + spec.name + ": the component's change does not decode: " + wire.error());
6622 }
6623}
6624
6625inline Node ScreenCore::fieldComponent(forms::FieldView const& view, DocNode const& overlay, LowerCtx const& ctx) {
6626 std::string const name{overlay.name("component")};
6627 // A loaded document's field component is declared, with a `value` prop and a `change` event.
6628 Component const& component = _doc->components.at(name);
6629 forms::FieldState* const state = &view.state();
6630 Custom spec{.name = name,
6631 .fallback = view.defaultControl(),
6632 .props = {},
6633 .minVersion =
6634 static_cast<int>(std::clamp<std::int64_t>(component.version, 0, std::numeric_limits<int>::max())),
6635 .onEvent = {}};
6636 for (auto const& [prop, type] : component.props) {
6637 if (prop == "value" && type == "json") {
6638 // The wire JSON itself, so an object's or a collection's every digit reaches the component.
6639 spec.props.push_back(CustomProp{.name = prop, .value = slotProp<std::string>([state] {
6640 forms::Encoding const& encoding = state->encoded().get();
6641 return encoding.has_value() && encoding->has_value()
6642 ? (*encoding)->json
6643 : std::string{"null"};
6644 })});
6645 continue;
6646 }
6647 std::function<Value()> read = formFilled(prop, state);
6648 if (!read) {
6649 ExprPtr given;
6650 for (DocNodePtr const& record : overlay.partList("props")) {
6651 if (ExprPtr const expr = record->prop(prop)) {
6652 given = expr;
6653 }
6654 }
6655 read = [scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, given] {
6656 return given ? evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), given) : Value{};
6657 };
6658 }
6659 spec.props.push_back(componentProp(prop, type, std::move(read)));
6660 }
6661 spec.onEvent = [this, state, path = overlay.path, fieldSpec = &view.spec(),
6662 valueType = component.props.at("value")](std::string const& event, std::string const& payload) {
6663 if (event == "change") {
6664 changeField(*state, *fieldSpec, path, valueType, payload);
6665 }
6666 };
6667 return ui::custom(std::move(spec));
6668}

6670// Every call goes through the alias's channel, bound for its current instance when the call is made.
6671inline forms::Submitter ScreenCore::aliasCalls(ModelAlias* alias) {
6672 return [this, alias](std::string_view actionId, std::string const& body) -> async::Completion<std::string> {
6673 std::shared_ptr<ModelChannel> const channel = channelOf(*alias, *this);
6674 if (channel == nullptr) {
6675 auto [failed, promise] = async::Completion<std::string>::makeSettleable(&runtime().owner());
6676 promise.reject(std::make_exception_ptr(std::runtime_error{"the node's model alias is not bound"}));
6677 return std::move(failed);
6678 }
6679 return channel->execute(std::string{actionId}, body, CallOptions{});
6680 };
6681}
6682
6683// The calls of a form, collection or wizard: a success other than of @p read, the collection's own query, tells the
6684// session, which applies the action's effects, as a mutation's success does.
6685inline forms::Submitter ScreenCore::aliasSubmits(ModelAlias* alias, std::string read) {
6686 return [this, alias, call = aliasCalls(alias), read = std::move(read)](
6687 std::string_view actionId, std::string body) -> async::Completion<std::string> {
6688 async::Completion<std::string> completion = call(actionId, std::move(body));
6689 if (actionId != read) {
6690 completion.then([this, alive = std::weak_ptr<bool>{_alive}, alias, typeId = alias->decl->type,
6691 action = std::string{actionId}](std::string const& reply) {
6692 if (alive.expired()) {
6693 return;
6694 }
6695 auto json = parseJson(reply);
6696 auto value = json ? valueFromJson(*json) : std::unexpected(json.error());
6697 std::string const token = runtime().untracked([&] { return alias->token->get(); });
6698 session.actionSucceeded(typeId, action, value ? *value : Value{}, ReplyUse::Applied, token);
6699 });
6700 }
6701 return completion;
6702 };
6703}

6705// The session's locale, translations and display zone, as every form the engine builds here reads them.
6706inline forms::FormSessionOptions ScreenCore::engineOptions() const {
6707 FormatContext const& format = session.formatting();
6708 forms::FormSessionOptions options{};
6709 options.locale = format.numeric;
6710 options.bcp47 = format.locale;
6711 options.translations = format.translations;
6712 options.displayOffsetMinutes = format.utcOffsetMinutes;
6713 return options;
6714}
6715
6716// Builds a collection's or wizard's session when its element is declared. The node's `action` is the collection's
6717// query or the wizard's first step; the catalog answers the document for it, and every call (the query, the actions,
6718// every step's submission) goes through the node's model alias.
6719inline void ScreenCore::wireComposite(ElementState& element) {
6720 DocNode const& node = *element.node;
6721 RtScope const& scope = *element.scope;
6722 bool const collection = node.kind == "collection";
6723 std::string const action{node.name("action")};
6724 Catalog const& catalog = session.options().catalog;
6725 auto const& lookup = collection ? catalog.view : catalog.wizard;
6726 std::optional<std::string> const document = lookup ? lookup(action) : std::nullopt;
6727 if (!document.has_value()) {
6728 report(node.path, std::string{"no "} + (collection ? "view" : "wizard") + " document for `" + action +
6729 "`: the catalog has none for a `" + node.kind + "` to build from");
6730 return;
6731 }
6732 NameRef const* const alias = scope.find(node.name("model"));
6733 if (alias == nullptr || alias->model == nullptr) {
6734 report(node.path, "`" + std::string{node.name("model")} + "` is not a model alias");
6735 return;
6736 }
6737 forms::SchemaLookup const schemas = catalog.schema ? forms::SchemaLookup{catalog.schema} : forms::SchemaLookup{};
6738 forms::Submitter const call = aliasCalls(alias->model);
6739 if (collection) {
6740 auto model = forms::CollectionModel::fromSchema(*document);
6741 if (!model) {
6742 report(node.path, "the collection of `" + action + "` does not build: " + model.error().path + ": " +
6743 model.error().message);
6744 return;
6745 }
6746 if (model->query() != action) {
6747 report(node.path, "the view document of `" + action + "` lists `" + std::string{model->query()} + "`");
6748 return;
6749 }
6750 std::string query{model->query()};
6751 element.collection = std::make_unique<forms::CollectionSession>(runtime(), *std::move(model), schemas,
6752 aliasSubmits(alias->model, std::move(query)),
6753 call, engineOptions());
6754 return;
6755 }
6756 // The wizard's id, the stem of its translation keys, is the action it starts with.
6757 auto model = forms::WizardModel::fromSchema(action, *document);
6758 if (!model) {
6759 report(node.path,
6760 "the wizard of `" + action + "` does not build: " + model.error().path + ": " + model.error().message);
6761 return;
6762 }
6763 if (model->steps().front().action != action) {
6764 report(node.path,
6765 "the wizard document of `" + action + "` starts with `" + model->steps().front().action + "`");
6766 return;
6767 }
6768 try {
6769 element.wizard = std::make_unique<forms::WizardSession>(runtime(), *std::move(model), schemas,
6770 aliasSubmits(alias->model), call, engineOptions());
6771 } catch (std::invalid_argument const& error) {
6772 report(node.path, error.what());
6773 }
6774}
6775
6776// The presentation keys a form, a collection and a wizard share, but the title: the label of the explicit-mode button
6777// and the status line naming it, bound in the node's scope; whether the status line shows, the grid's columns and the
6778// field layout, as read at load.
6779inline void ScreenCore::presentForm(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, forms::FormViewOptions& options) {
6780 if (ExprPtr const label = node.prop("submitLabel")) {
6781 options.submitLabel = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, label, std::string{}, stringOf);
6782 }
6783 if (auto const shown = node.flags.find("showStatus"); shown != node.flags.end()) {
6784 options.showStatus = shown->second;
6785 }
6786 if (ExprPtr const columns = node.prop("columns"); columns != nullptr && columns->literal.asInt() != nullptr) {
6787 options.gridColumns = static_cast<int>(*columns->literal.asInt());
6788 options.flatGridColumns = options.gridColumns;
6789 }
6790 if (node.name("fieldLayout") == "inline") {
6791 options.fieldLayout = forms::FieldLayout::Inline;
6792 }
6793}
6794
6795inline Node ScreenCore::lowerComposite(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element) {
6796 // The editor's and the steps' titles are the dialog's and the header's; the forms do not repeat them. A `title`
6797 // replaces the view's own heading.
6798 forms::FormViewOptions form{};
6799 form.showTitle = false;
6800 presentForm(node, ctx, form);
6801 Prop<std::string> title = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, node.prop("title"), std::string{}, stringOf);
6802 Node view;
6803 if (element != nullptr && element->collection != nullptr) {
6804 forms::CollectionViewOptions options{};
6805 options.form = std::move(form);
6806 options.title = std::move(title);
6807 view = forms::collectionView(*element->collection, std::move(options));
6808 } else if (element != nullptr && element->wizard != nullptr) {
6809 forms::WizardViewOptions options{};
6810 options.form = std::move(form);
6811 options.title = std::move(title);
6812 view = forms::wizardView(*element->wizard, options);
6813 } else {
6814 return ui::text(Text{.text = std::string{node.name("action")}, .role = TextRole::Muted});
6815 }
6816 Column column{.children = {std::move(view)}};
6817 commonOf(node, ctx, element, column.common);
6818 return ui::column(std::move(column));
6819}
6820
6821// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): an overlay's scope, content, actions and keys are one lowering.
6822// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): an overlay's scope, content, actions and keys are one lowering.
6823inline Node ScreenCore::lowerDialog(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element) {
6824 Prop<bool> open = node.prop("open") ? bindProp<bool>(ctx, node.prop("open"), false, boolOf)
6825 : slotProp<bool>([element] { return element->open.get(); });
6826 Node body = lazy([this, ctx, &node, element]() -> Node {
6827 auto inner = std::make_shared<RtScope>(*this, ctx.scope, nullptr, ctx.scope->nodes.depth() + 2);
6828 inner->owner = element;
6829 addPending(1);
6830 inner->submitted = &element->submitted;
6831 inner->showErrors = std::string{node.name("showErrors")};
6832 std::vector<DocNode const*> content;
6833 for (DocNodePtr const& child : node.nodes("children")) {
6834 content.push_back(child.get());
6835 }
6836 std::vector<Commands const*> lists;
6837 for (std::string_view const key : {"default", "cancel"}) {
6838 if (Commands const* const commands = node.event(key)) {
6839 lists.push_back(commands);
6840 }
6841 }
6842 for (DocNodePtr const& action : node.partList("actions")) {
6843 if (Commands const* const commands = action->event("onClick")) {
6844 lists.push_back(commands);
6845 }
6846 }
6847 declare(*inner, node.scope ? &*node.scope : nullptr, content, lists);
6848 element->inner.set(inner.get());
6849 LowerCtx const innerCtx{.scope = inner, .bindings = ctx.bindings, .boundary = ctx.boundary};
6850 std::vector<Node> children;
6851 children.reserve(content.size());
6852 for (DocNode const* const child : content) {
6853 children.push_back(lower(*child, innerCtx));
6854 }
6855 // The overlay's actions end its scoped content, so they bind in its scope; the mount puts them in its footer.
6856 if (ActionModels actions = lowerActionParts(node.partList("actions"), innerCtx); !actions.empty()) {
6857 children.push_back(actionBarOf(std::move(actions)));
6858 }
6859 std::vector<KeyBinding> keys;
6860 if (Commands const* const commands = node.event("default")) {
6861 keys.push_back(KeyBinding{
6862 .chord = "Enter", .onPress = [this, innerCtx, commands] { runEvent(commands, innerCtx, Value{}); }});
6863 }
6864 if (Commands const* const commands = node.event("cancel")) {
6865 keys.push_back(KeyBinding{
6866 .chord = "Esc", .onPress = [this, innerCtx, commands] { runEvent(commands, innerCtx, Value{}); }});
6867 }
6868 return holding(std::move(children), inner, std::move(keys));
6869 });
6870 Action onDismiss = [this, ctx, element, commands = node.event("onDismiss")] {
6871 session.asUser([&] {
6872 session.noteWrite();
6873 element->open.set(false);
6874 });
6875 runEvent(commands, ctx, Value{});
6876 };
6877 if (node.kind == "drawer") {
6878 ExprPtr const side = node.prop("side");
6879 Drawer spec{
6880 .open = std::move(open),
6881 .title = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, node.prop("title"), std::string{}, stringOf),
6882 .child = std::move(body),
6883 .onDismiss = std::move(onDismiss),
6884 .side = side && textOf(once(ctx, side), session.formatting()) == "start" ? Side::Start : Side::End};
6885 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
6886 return ui::drawer(std::move(spec));
6887 }
6888 Dialog spec{.open = std::move(open),
6889 .title = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, node.prop("title"), std::string{}, stringOf),
6890 .child = std::move(body),
6891 .onDismiss = std::move(onDismiss)};
6892 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
6893 return ui::dialog(std::move(spec));
6894}
6895
6896inline Node ScreenCore::lowerSwitch(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx) {
6897 std::vector<ExprPtr> whens;
6898 Switch spec;
6899 std::int64_t index = 0;
6900 for (DocNodePtr const& part : node.partList("cases")) {
6901 whens.push_back(part->prop("when"));
6902 DocNode const* const casePart = part.get();
6903 spec.cases.push_back(SwitchCase{
6904 .key = Key{index++},
6905 .node = lazy([this, ctx, casePart]() -> Node {
6906 auto inner = std::make_shared<RtScope>(*this, ctx.scope, nullptr, ctx.scope->nodes.depth() + 2);
6907 std::vector<DocNode const*> content;
6908 for (DocNodePtr const& child : casePart->nodes("children")) {
6909 content.push_back(child.get());
6910 }
6911 declare(*inner, casePart->scope ? &*casePart->scope : nullptr, content, {});
6912 LowerCtx const innerCtx{.scope = inner, .bindings = ctx.bindings, .boundary = ctx.boundary};
6913 std::vector<Node> children;
6914 children.reserve(content.size());
6915 for (DocNode const* const child : content) {
6916 children.push_back(lower(*child, innerCtx));
6917 }
6918 return holding(std::move(children), inner);
6919 })});
6920 }
6921 spec.selector = slotProp<Key>(
6922 [scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, selected = node.prop("on"), whens = std::move(whens)] {
6923 Value const value = evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), selected);
6924 for (std::size_t at = 0; at < whens.size(); ++at) {
6925 if (evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), whens.at(at)) == value) {
6926 return Key{static_cast<std::int64_t>(at)};
6927 }
6928 }
6929 return Key{std::int64_t{-1}};
6930 });
6931 auto const fallback = node.nodes("default");
6932 spec.fallback = fallback.empty() ? Node{} : lowerAll(fallback, ctx);
6933 commonOf(node, ctx, nullptr, spec.common);
6934 return ui::switchOf(std::move(spec));
6935}
6936
6937inline std::shared_ptr<RtScope> ScreenCore::rowScope(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx,
6938 reactive::Signal<Value> const& row,
6939 std::vector<DocNode const*> const& content) {
6940 auto scope = std::make_shared<RtScope>(*this, ctx.scope, &row, ctx.scope->nodes.depth() + 2);
6941 declare(*scope, node.scope ? &*node.scope : nullptr, content, {});
6942 return scope;
6943}
6944
6945// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): a list of rows and a table.
6946inline Node ScreenCore::lowerRows(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element) {
6947 ExprPtr const rowsExpr = node.prop("rows");
6948 if (!rowsExpr) {
6949 report(node.path, "a model-backed `table` needs the table engine, which this interpreter does not lower yet");
6950 return ui::text(Text{.text = std::string{"table"}, .role = TextRole::Muted});
6951 }
6952 auto rows = [scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, rowsExpr] {
6953 Value const value = evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), rowsExpr);
6954 ValueList const* const items = value.asList();
6955 return items == nullptr ? std::vector<Value>{} : std::vector<Value>{items->begin(), items->end()};
6956 };
6957 auto keyFn = [scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, keyExpr = node.prop("key")](Value const& row) -> Key {
6958 if (!keyExpr) {
6959 Value const rowKey = rowId(row);
6960 return keyOf(rowKey.isNull() ? row : rowKey);
6961 }
6962 ScopeEnv const env{*scope, bindings.get(), &row};
6963 return keyOf(evaluate(*keyExpr, env));
6964 };
6965 if (node.kind == "forEach") {
6966 std::vector<DocNode const*> content;
6967 for (DocNodePtr const& child : node.nodes("children")) {
6968 content.push_back(child.get());
6969 }
6970 auto rowView = [this, ctx, &node, content](reactive::Signal<Value> const& row) -> Node {
6971 auto scope = rowScope(node, ctx, row, content);
6972 LowerCtx const rowCtx{.scope = scope, .bindings = ctx.bindings, .boundary = ctx.boundary};
6973 std::vector<Node> children;
6974 children.reserve(content.size());
6975 for (DocNode const* const child : content) {
6976 children.push_back(lower(*child, rowCtx));
6977 }
6978 return holding(std::move(children), scope);
6979 };
6980 ExprPtr const axis = node.prop("axis");
6981 ExprPtr const gap = node.prop("gap");
6982 return ui::forEach<Value>(std::move(rows), std::move(keyFn), std::move(rowView),
6983 axis ? axisOf(once(ctx, axis)) : Axis::Vertical,
6984 gap ? static_cast<int>(intOf(once(ctx, gap), 0)) : 0);
6985 }
6986 std::vector<TableColumn> columns;
6987 std::vector<DocNode const*> cells;
6988 std::vector<std::string> fields;
6989 // One entry per column, in the same order as `cells`/`fields`. Captured by `cellsOf` below (not `columns`
6990 // itself, which is moved into `ui::table<Value>(...)` further down and so cannot be read from inside a lambda
6991 // that outlives this function) so the default-cell closure can apply each column's role to its generated cell.
6992 std::vector<TextRole> roles;
6993 FormatContext const& format = session.formatting();
6994 if (ExprPtr const derived = node.prop("columns")) {
6995 Value const list = once(ctx, derived);
6996 if (ValueList const* const items = list.asList()) {
6997 for (Value const& item : *items) {
6998 Value const* const field = item.field("id");
6999 Value const* const label = item.field("label");
7000 fields.push_back(field == nullptr ? std::string{} : textOf(*field, format));
7001 columns.push_back(
7002 TableColumn{.label = textOf(label != nullptr ? *label : Value{fields.back()}, format)});
7003 cells.push_back(nullptr);
7004 roles.push_back(TextRole::Normal);
7005 }
7006 }
7007 }
7008 for (DocNodePtr const& part : node.partList("columns")) {
7009 ExprPtr const label = part->prop("label");
7010 ExprPtr const width = part->prop("width");
7011 ExprPtr const role = part->prop("role");
7012 TextRole const columnRole = role ? roleOf(once(ctx, role), format) : TextRole::Normal;
7013 columns.push_back(TableColumn{.label = label ? textOf(once(ctx, label), format) : std::string{},
7014 .width = width ? sizingOf(once(ctx, width)) : Sizing::content(),
7015 .role = columnRole});
7016 cells.push_back(part.get());
7017 fields.emplace_back(part->id);
7018 roles.push_back(columnRole);
7019 }
7020 auto registry = std::make_shared<std::map<std::string, std::weak_ptr<RtScope>, std::less<>>>();
7021 // A value that names no tone is reported once for the table, whichever row and value it was.
7022 auto toneReported = std::make_shared<bool>(false);
7023 auto cellsOf = [this, ctx, &node, cells, fields, roles, registry, keyFn,
7024 toneReported](reactive::Signal<Value> const& row) {
7025 std::vector<DocNode const*> content;
7026 for (DocNode const* const column : cells) {
7027 if (column != nullptr) {
7028 for (DocNodePtr const& cell : column->nodes("cell")) {
7029 content.push_back(cell.get());
7030 }
7031 }
7032 }
7033 auto scope = rowScope(node, ctx, row, content);
7034 (*registry)[canonicalJson(valueOfKey(keyFn(row.peek())))] = scope;
7035 LowerCtx const rowCtx{.scope = scope, .bindings = ctx.bindings, .boundary = ctx.boundary};
7036 std::vector<Node> out;
7037 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < cells.size(); ++index) {
7038 DocNode const* const column = cells.at(index);
7039 auto const nodes = column == nullptr ? std::span<DocNodePtr const>{} : column->nodes("cell");
7040 if (!nodes.empty()) {
7041 out.push_back(lowerAll(nodes, rowCtx));
7042 continue;
7043 }
7044 out.push_back(ui::text(Text{.text = slotProp<std::string>([this, &row, field = fields.at(index)] {
7045 Value const* const value = row.get().field(field);
7046 return value == nullptr ? std::string{}
7047 : textOf(*value, session.formatting());
7048 }),
7049 .role = roles.at(index)}));
7050 }
7051 if (!out.empty()) {
7052 out.front() = holding({out.front()}, scope);
7053 }
7054 TableRowView view{.cells = std::move(out), .tone = std::nullopt};
7055 if (ExprPtr const toneExpr = node.prop("rowTone")) {
7056 view.tone = slotProp<std::optional<Tone>>(
7057 [this, scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, toneExpr, toneReported]() -> std::optional<Tone> {
7058 return rowToneOf(evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), toneExpr), toneExpr->path, *toneReported);
7059 });
7060 }
7061 return view;
7062 };
7063 TableOptions options;
7064 options.showHeader = node.prop("showHeader") ? boolOf(once(ctx, node.prop("showHeader")), format) : true;
7065 if (ExprPtr const threshold = node.prop("virtualizeThreshold")) {
7066 options.virtualize.threshold =
7067 static_cast<std::size_t>(std::max<std::int64_t>(0, intOf(once(ctx, threshold), 2000)));
7068 }
7069 if (ExprPtr const overscan = node.prop("virtualizeOverscan")) {
7070 options.virtualize.overscan =
7071 static_cast<std::size_t>(std::max<std::int64_t>(0, intOf(once(ctx, overscan), 10)));
7072 }
7073 std::string const mode =
7074 node.prop("selectionMode") ? textOf(once(ctx, node.prop("selectionMode")), format) : std::string{};
7075 options.selectionMode = SelectionMode::None;
7076 if (mode == "single") {
7077 options.selectionMode = SelectionMode::Single;
7078 } else if (mode == "multiple") {
7079 options.selectionMode = SelectionMode::Multiple;
7080 }
7081 options.selection = slotProp<std::vector<Key>>([element] {
7082 std::vector<Key> keys;
7083 if (ValueList const* const items = element->selection.get().asList()) {
7084 for (Value const& item : *items) {
7085 keys.push_back(keyOf(item));
7086 }
7087 }
7088 return keys;
7089 });
7090 options.onSelectionChange = [this, element](std::vector<Key> const& keys) {
7091 ValueList items;
7092 for (Key const& key : keys) {
7093 items.push_back(valueOfKey(key));
7094 }
7095 session.asUser([&] {
7096 session.noteWrite();
7097 element->selection.set(Value{std::move(items)});
7098 });
7099 };
7100 options.onActivate = [this, ctx, element, registry, commands = node.event("onActivate")](Key const& key) {
7101 Value const activated = valueOfKey(key);
7102 session.asUser([&] {
7103 session.noteWrite();
7104 element->activeKey.set(activated);
7105 });
7106 auto const found = registry->find(canonicalJson(activated));
7107 std::shared_ptr<RtScope> const scope = found == registry->end() ? nullptr : found->second.lock();
7108 LowerCtx const rowCtx{.scope = scope ? scope : ctx.scope, .bindings = ctx.bindings, .boundary = ctx.boundary};
7109 runEvent(commands, rowCtx, activated);
7110 };
7111 commonOf(node, ctx, element, options.common);
7112 std::span<DocNodePtr const> const empty = node.nodes("empty");
7113 if (empty.empty()) {
7114 return ui::table<Value>(std::move(columns), std::move(rows), std::move(keyFn), std::move(cellsOf),
7115 std::move(options));
7116 }
7117 // With `empty`, a column holds the table and the content shown in its place while `rows` is an empty list; a
7118 // `null` (a query not answered yet) shows the table. The column is placed as the table would be: it takes the
7119 // node's visibility and layout, and every other common property stays on the table, so its test id and the
7120 // element id `focus` finds name the table.
7121 auto const listed = [scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, rowsExpr] {
7122 ValueList const* const items = evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), rowsExpr).asList();
7123 return items == nullptr || !items->empty();
7124 };
7125 Column wrapper;
7126 wrapper.common.visible = std::move(options.common.visible);
7127 wrapper.common.layout = options.common.layout;
7128 options.common.visible = slotProp<bool>(listed);
7129 Column content{.children = {lowerAll(empty, ctx)}};
7130 content.common.visible = slotProp<bool>([listed] { return !listed(); });
7131 wrapper.children.push_back(ui::table<Value>(std::move(columns), std::move(rows), std::move(keyFn),
7132 std::move(cellsOf), std::move(options)));
7133 wrapper.children.push_back(ui::column(std::move(content)));
7134 return ui::column(std::move(wrapper));
7135}
7136
7137inline std::optional<Tone> ScreenCore::rowToneOf(Value const& value, std::string const& path, bool& noted) {
7138 if (value.isNull()) {
7139 return std::nullopt;
7140 }
7141 static constexpr std::array<std::pair<std::string_view, Tone>, 5> kTones = {{
7142 {"neutral", Tone::Neutral},
7143 {"info", Tone::Info},
7144 {"ok", Tone::Ok},
7145 {"warn", Tone::Warn},
7146 {"err", Tone::Err},
7147 }};
7148 if (std::string const* const text = value.asString()) {
7149 // A loop, not std::ranges::find: an array's iterator is a pointer on some standard libraries and not on
7150 // others, so `auto` there reads differently to each.
7151 for (auto const& [name, tone] : kTones) {
7152 if (name == *text) {
7153 return tone;
7154 }
7155 }
7156 }
7157 if (!noted) {
7158 noted = true;
7159 report(path, "rowTone is " + canonicalJson(value) + "; a tone is neutral, info, ok, warn or err");
7160 }
7161 return std::nullopt;
7162}
7163
7164inline void ScreenCore::ownQueriesOf(ExprPtr const& expr, RtScope const& scope, BoundaryRuntime& boundary,
7165 std::set<std::string, std::less<>>& seen) {
7166 if (!expr) {
7167 return;
7168 }
7169 bool const control = expr->kind == ExprKind::Query || expr->kind == ExprKind::Pending ||
7170 expr->kind == ExprKind::Error || expr->kind == ExprKind::ErrorKind;
7171 if (control || expr->kind == ExprKind::Ref) {
7172 NameRef const* const found = scope.find(expr->name);
7173 if (found != nullptr && found->category == NameCategory::Query && seen.insert(expr->name).second) {
7174 boundary.queries.push_back(found->query);
7175 }
7176 if (expr->kind == ExprKind::Ref && found != nullptr && found->category == NameCategory::Let &&
7177 seen.insert("let:" + expr->name).second) {
7178 ownQueriesOf(found->letExpr, scope, boundary, seen);
7179 }
7180 }
7181 for (ExprPtr const& arg : expr->args) {
7182 ownQueriesOf(arg, scope, boundary, seen);
7183 }
7184 for (auto const& [name, field] : expr->fields) {
7185 static_cast<void>(name);
7186 ownQueriesOf(field, scope, boundary, seen);
7187 }
7188}
7189
7190inline void ScreenCore::ownQueries(DocNode const& node, RtScope const& scope, BoundaryRuntime& boundary,
7191 std::set<std::string, std::less<>>& seen) {
7192 if (node.kind == "boundary") {
7193 return;
7194 }
7195 for (auto const& [key, expr] : node.props) {
7196 static_cast<void>(key);
7197 ownQueriesOf(expr, scope, boundary, seen);
7198 }
7199 for (auto const& [key, nodes] : node.children) {
7200 static_cast<void>(key);
7201 for (DocNodePtr const& child : nodes) {
7202 ownQueries(*child, scope, boundary, seen);
7203 }
7204 }
7205 for (auto const& [key, parts] : node.parts) {
7206 static_cast<void>(key);
7207 for (DocNodePtr const& part : parts) {
7208 ownQueries(*part, scope, boundary, seen);
7209 }
7210 }
7211}
7212
7213inline Node ScreenCore::lowerBoundary(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx) {
7214 auto boundary = std::make_shared<BoundaryRuntime>();
7215 std::set<std::string, std::less<>> seen;
7216 for (DocNodePtr const& child : node.nodes("children")) {
7217 ownQueries(*child, *ctx.scope, *boundary, seen);
7218 }
7219 auto bindings = std::make_shared<Bindings>(*ctx.bindings);
7220 bindings->push_back(Binding{.name = "boundary", .read = [boundary] {
7221 for (QueryRuntime const* const query : boundary->queries) {
7222 Value const error = query->error();
7223 if (!error.isNull() && query->value().isNull()) {
7224 return Value{ValueRecord{{"error", error}}};
7225 }
7226 }
7227 return Value{ValueRecord{{"error", Value{}}}};
7228 }});
7229 LowerCtx const errorCtx{.scope = ctx.scope, .bindings = bindings, .boundary = boundary};
7230 LowerCtx const childCtx{.scope = ctx.scope, .bindings = ctx.bindings, .boundary = boundary};
7231 auto group = [this](std::span<DocNodePtr const> nodes, LowerCtx const& where) -> Node {
7232 return nodes.empty() ? ui::spacer() : lowerAll(nodes, where);
7233 };
7234 Switch spec;
7235 spec.cases.push_back(SwitchCase{.key = Key{std::int64_t{0}}, .node = group(node.nodes("loading"), childCtx)});
7236 spec.cases.push_back(SwitchCase{.key = Key{std::int64_t{1}}, .node = group(node.nodes("error"), errorCtx)});
7237 spec.cases.push_back(SwitchCase{.key = Key{std::int64_t{2}}, .node = group(node.nodes("children"), childCtx)});
7238 spec.selector = slotProp<Key>([boundary] {
7239 bool loading = false;
7240 for (QueryRuntime const* const query : boundary->queries) {
7241 if (!query->settled()) {
7242 loading = true;
7243 } else if (query->value().isNull() && !query->error().isNull()) {
7244 return Key{std::int64_t{1}};
7245 }
7246 }
7247 return Key{std::int64_t{loading ? 0 : 2}};
7248 });
7249 commonOf(node, ctx, nullptr, spec.common);
7250 return ui::switchOf(std::move(spec));
7251}
7252
7253inline Node ScreenCore::lowerCustom(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx) {
7254 std::string const name{node.name("name")};
7255 // A loaded document's custom node names a declared component, and every component has a fallback.
7256 Component const& component = _doc->components.at(name);
7257 std::vector<std::pair<std::string, ExprPtr>> props;
7258 for (DocNodePtr const& record : node.partList("props")) {
7259 for (auto const& [key, expr] : record->props) {
7260 props.emplace_back(key, expr);
7261 }
7262 }
7263 auto bindings = std::make_shared<Bindings>();
7264 bindings->push_back(
7265 Binding{.name = "props", .read = [scope = ctx.scope, outer = ctx.bindings, props = std::move(props)] {
7266 ValueRecord record;
7267 for (auto const& [key, expr] : props) {
7268 record.insert_or_assign(key, evalIn(*scope, outer.get(), expr));
7269 }
7270 return Value{std::move(record)};
7271 }});
7272 auto scope = std::make_shared<RtScope>(*this, nullptr, nullptr, ctx.scope->nodes.depth() + 1);
7273 DocNode const& fallback = *component.fallback;
7274 declare(*scope, nullptr, {&fallback}, {});
7275 Node lowered = lower(fallback, LowerCtx{.scope = scope, .bindings = bindings, .boundary = nullptr});
7276 Custom spec{.name = name,
7277 .fallback = std::move(lowered),
7278 .props = {},
7279 .minVersion =
7280 static_cast<int>(std::clamp<std::int64_t>(component.version, 0, std::numeric_limits<int>::max())),
7281 .onEvent = {}};
7282 // Every declared prop is given, a missing one as its type's empty value: a component lacking one is refused.
7283 for (auto const& [prop, type] : component.props) {
7284 ExprPtr expr;
7285 for (DocNodePtr const& record : node.partList("props")) {
7286 if (ExprPtr const given = record->prop(prop)) {
7287 expr = given;
7288 }
7289 }
7290 if (type == "bool") {
7291 spec.props.push_back(CustomProp{.name = prop, .value = bindProp<bool>(ctx, expr, false, boolOf)});
7292 } else if (type == "number") {
7293 spec.props.push_back(CustomProp{
7294 .name = prop, .value = bindProp<double>(ctx, expr, 0.0, [](Value const& value, FormatContext const&) {
7295 return componentNumber(value);
7296 })});
7297 } else {
7298 spec.props.push_back(
7299 CustomProp{.name = prop,
7300 .value = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, expr, std::string{},
7301 [type](Value const& value, FormatContext const& format) {
7302 return componentText(value, type, format);
7303 })});
7304 }
7305 }
7306 spec.onEvent = [this, ctx, site = &node, declared = &component](std::string const& event,
7307 std::string const& payload) {
7308 Commands const* const commands = site->event("on." + event);
7309 if (commands == nullptr) {
7310 return;
7311 }
7312 auto const type = declared->events.find(event);
7313 runEvent(commands, ctx, componentPayload(payload, type == declared->events.end() ? nullptr : &type->second));
7314 };
7315 return ui::custom(std::move(spec));
7316}
7317
7318/// @brief One child of an arranged container, as the user's choice places it.
7319struct ArrangedChild {
7320 /// @brief The child's id.
7321 std::string id;
7322 /// @brief Whether the choice hides it.
7323 bool hidden = false;
7324};
7325
7326/// @brief A container's children in the order a stored `arrange` choice gives, each marked shown or hidden.
7327///
7328/// A child the choice does not name keeps its declared place after the named ones, shown, and an entry that names no
7329/// child, names one twice or is not a `{"id", "hidden"}` record is skipped, so a new document version survives an old
7330/// choice (spec 5 §12b). A choice that is not a list leaves the declared order. Only `"hidden": true` hides.
7331/// @param stored The point's current choice.
7332/// @param declared The container's children, in document order.
7333/// @return Every child, in order.
7334[[nodiscard]] inline std::vector<ArrangedChild> arrangedChildren(Value const& stored,
7335 std::span<DocNode const* const> declared) {
7336 auto const isDeclared = [declared](std::string const& childId) {
7337 return std::ranges::find(declared, childId, &DocNode::id) != declared.end();
7338 };
7339 std::vector<ArrangedChild> out;
7340 std::set<std::string, std::less<>> placed;
7341 if (ValueList const* const entries = stored.asList()) {
7342 for (Value const& entry : *entries) {
7343 Value const* const named = entry.field("id");
7344 std::string const* const name = named == nullptr ? nullptr : named->asString();
7345 if (name == nullptr || !isDeclared(*name) || !placed.insert(*name).second) {
7346 continue;
7347 }
7348 Value const* const hidden = entry.field("hidden");
7349 bool const* const flag = hidden == nullptr ? nullptr : hidden->asBool();
7350 out.push_back(ArrangedChild{.id = *name, .hidden = flag != nullptr && *flag});
7351 }
7352 }
7353 for (DocNode const* const child : declared) {
7354 if (!placed.contains(child->id)) {
7355 out.push_back(ArrangedChild{.id = child->id});
7356 }
7357 }
7358 return out;
7359}
7360
7361/// @brief The ids of the children an `arrange` choice shows, in its order (`arrangedChildren`, without the hidden).
7362/// @param stored The point's current choice.
7363/// @param declared The container's children, in document order.
7364/// @return The ids to show, in order.
7365[[nodiscard]] inline std::vector<Value> arrangedOrder(Value const& stored, std::span<DocNode const* const> declared) {
7366 std::vector<Value> order;
7367 for (ArrangedChild const& child : arrangedChildren(stored, declared)) {
7368 if (!child.hidden) {
7369 order.emplace_back(child.id);
7370 }
7371 }
7372 return order;
7373}
7374
7375/// @brief An arrangement as the choice an `arrange` point stores.
7376/// @param children Every child, in order.
7377/// @return `[{"id", "hidden"}, …]`.
7378[[nodiscard]] inline Value arrangementValue(std::vector<ArrangedChild> const& children) {
7379 ValueList entries;
7380 entries.reserve(children.size());
7381 for (ArrangedChild const& child : children) {
7382 entries.emplace_back(ValueRecord{{"id", Value{child.id}}, {"hidden", Value{child.hidden}}});
7383 }
7384 return Value{std::move(entries)};
7385}
7386
7387/// @brief The element of a document tree with @p elementId.
7388/// @param node The subtree.
7389/// @param elementId The element's id.
7390/// @return The element, or `nullptr` when the subtree has none with that id.
7391// NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-no-recursion): one level per level of the document tree.
7392[[nodiscard]] inline DocNode const* elementNode(DocNode const& node, std::string_view elementId) {
7393 if (node.id == elementId) {
7394 return &node;
7395 }
7396 for (auto const* const groups : {&node.children, &node.parts}) {
7397 for (auto const& [slot, nodes] : *groups) {
7398 static_cast<void>(slot);
7399 for (DocNodePtr const& child : nodes) {
7400 if (DocNode const* const found = elementNode(*child, elementId)) {
7401 return found;
7402 }
7403 }
7404 }
7405 }
7406 return nullptr;
7407}
7408
7409inline std::string ScreenCore::arrangedBy(std::string const& elementId) const {
7410 if (elementId.empty()) {
7411 return {};
7412 }
7413 for (auto const& [name, point] : _doc->customize) {
7414 if (point.kind == "arrange" && point.of == elementId) {
7415 return name;
7416 }
7417 }
7418 return {};
7419}
7420
7421// A keyed list over the children's ids rather than a stack, so a new choice moves the shown widgets, keeping their
7422// state and focus, and mounts or unmounts only what it shows or hides. A child is lowered in the container's own
7423// scope: arranging changes where it is, not what it reads.
7424inline Node ScreenCore::lowerArranged(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element,
7425 std::string const& point, Axis axis, int gap) {
7426 std::vector<DocNode const*> declared;
7427 for (DocNodePtr const& child : node.nodes("children")) {
7428 declared.push_back(child.get());
7429 }
7430 auto order = [this, point, declared] { return arrangedOrder(prefs.get().at(point), declared); };
7431 auto key = [](Value const& childId) { return keyOf(childId); };
7432 auto view = [this, ctx, declared](reactive::Signal<Value> const& row) -> Node {
7433 // The order lists only declared ids, so the lookup always finds the child.
7434 auto const found = std::ranges::find(declared, textOf(row.peek(), session.formatting()), &DocNode::id);
7435 return lower(**found, ctx);
7436 };
7437 ForEach spec{
7438 .model = std::make_shared<TypedForEach<Value> const>(std::move(order), std::move(key), std::move(view)),
7439 .axis = axis,
7440 .gap = gap};
7441 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
7442 return makeNode(std::move(spec));
7443}
7444
7445// One row per child of the arranged container, hidden ones included: a checkbox shows or hides it, and two buttons
7446// move it a place. Each edit stores the whole arrangement, so the stored list always names every child.
7447inline Node ScreenCore::lowerArrangeEditor(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, std::string const& point,
7448 CustomizePoint const& spec, std::function<void(Value)> const& choose) {
7449 // The loader checked that `of` names a column or row of this screen.
7450 DocNode const* const container = elementNode(*_doc->view, spec.of);
7451 std::vector<DocNode const*> declared;
7452 for (DocNodePtr const& child : container->nodes("children")) {
7453 declared.push_back(child.get());
7454 }
7455 auto const current = [this, point, declared] { return arrangedChildren(prefs.get().at(point), declared); };
7456 auto const place = [current](std::string const& childId) {
7457 auto const children = current();
7458 return static_cast<std::size_t>(std::ranges::find(children, childId, &ArrangedChild::id) - children.begin());
7459 };
7460 // Applies an edit to the arrangement as it stands, read untracked: the edit is a transition, not a binding.
7461 auto const edit = [this, current, choose](std::string const& childId, auto const& change) {
7462 auto children = runtime().untracked(current);
7463 auto const found = std::ranges::find(children, childId, &ArrangedChild::id);
7464 change(children, static_cast<std::size_t>(found - children.begin()));
7465 choose(arrangementValue(children));
7466 };
7467 auto rows = [current] {
7468 std::vector<Value> ids;
7469 for (ArrangedChild const& child : current()) {
7470 ids.emplace_back(child.id);
7471 }
7472 return ids;
7473 };
7474 auto key = [](Value const& childId) { return keyOf(childId); };
7475 auto view = [this, current, place, edit](reactive::Signal<Value> const& row) -> Node {
7476 std::string const childId = textOf(row.peek(), session.formatting());
7477 Checkbox shown{.label = childId};
7478 shown.checked = slotProp<bool>([current, childId] {
7479 auto const children = current();
7480 return !std::ranges::find(children, childId, &ArrangedChild::id)->hidden;
7481 });
7482 shown.onToggle = [edit, childId](bool checked) {
7483 edit(childId, [checked](std::vector<ArrangedChild>& children, std::size_t index) {
7484 children.at(index).hidden = !checked;
7485 });
7486 };
7487 Button moveUp{.label = std::string{"\xE2\x86\x91"}};
7488 moveUp.onClick = [edit, childId] {
7489 // Clamped rather than refused: at the edge the child swaps with itself, which stores the same order.
7490 edit(childId, [](std::vector<ArrangedChild>& children, std::size_t index) {
7491 std::swap(children.at(index), children.at(std::max(index, std::size_t{1}) - 1));
7492 });
7493 };
7494 moveUp.common.enabled = slotProp<bool>([place, childId] { return place(childId) > 0; });
7495 moveUp.common.a11y.name = "Move " + childId + " up";
7496 moveUp.common.testId = "arrange-up-" + childId;
7497 Button moveDown{.label = std::string{"\xE2\x86\x93"}};
7498 moveDown.onClick = [edit, childId] {
7499 edit(childId, [](std::vector<ArrangedChild>& children, std::size_t index) {
7500 std::swap(children.at(index), children.at(std::min(index + 1, children.size() - 1)));
7501 });
7502 };
7503 moveDown.common.enabled =
7504 slotProp<bool>([current, place, childId] { return place(childId) + 1 < current().size(); });
7505 moveDown.common.a11y.name = "Move " + childId + " down";
7506 moveDown.common.testId = "arrange-down-" + childId;
7507 shown.common.testId = "arrange-shown-" + childId;
7508 return ui::row(Row{.children = {ui::checkbox(std::move(shown)), ui::button(std::move(moveUp)),
7509 ui::button(std::move(moveDown))},
7510 .gap = 1});
7511 };
7512 ForEach editor{.model =
7513 std::make_shared<TypedForEach<Value> const>(std::move(rows), std::move(key), std::move(view))};
7514 commonOf(node, ctx, nullptr, editor.common);
7515 return makeNode(std::move(editor));
7516}
7517
7518inline Node ScreenCore::lowerCustomize(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx) {
7519 std::string const point{node.name("point")};
7520 // A loaded document's customize node names a declared point, and every point has a choice in `prefs`.
7521 CustomizePoint const& spec = _doc->customize.at(point);
7522 auto choose = [this, point](Value value) {
7523 session.asUser([&] {
7524 ValueRecord next = prefs.peek();
7525 next.insert_or_assign(point, value);
7526 prefs.set(std::move(next));
7527 });
7528 if (host != nullptr) {
7529 host->preferenceChanged(_doc->id, point, value);
7530 }
7531 };
7532 if (spec.kind == "arrange") {
7533 return lowerArrangeEditor(node, ctx, point, spec, choose);
7534 }
7535 if (spec.kind == "choice") {
7536 Select select;
7537 std::vector<SelectOption> options;
7538 options.reserve(spec.options.size());
7539 for (std::string const& option : spec.options) {
7540 options.push_back(SelectOption{.key = Key{option}, .label = option});
7541 }
7542 select.options = std::move(options);
7543 select.selected = slotProp<std::optional<Key>>([this, point]() -> std::optional<Key> {
7544 Value const& chosen = prefs.get().at(point);
7545 return chosen.isNull() ? std::nullopt : std::optional<Key>{keyOf(chosen)};
7546 });
7547 select.onSelect = [choose](Key const& key) { choose(valueOfKey(key)); };
7548 commonOf(node, ctx, nullptr, select.common);
7549 return ui::select(std::move(select));
7550 }
7551 if (spec.kind == "value" && (spec.type.kind == TypeKind::String || spec.type.isAny())) {
7552 TextInput input;
7553 input.value =
7554 slotProp<std::string>([this, point] { return textOf(prefs.get().at(point), session.formatting()); });
7555 input.onChange = [choose](std::string text) { choose(Value{std::move(text)}); };
7556 commonOf(node, ctx, nullptr, input.common);
7557 return ui::textInput(std::move(input));
7558 }
7559 Text placeholder{.text = point, .role = TextRole::Muted};
7560 commonOf(node, ctx, nullptr, placeholder.common);
7561 return ui::text(std::move(placeholder));
7562}

7577inline std::expected<std::unique_ptr<Screen>, Refusal> Interpreter::mount(std::shared_ptr<Document const> doc,
7578 ValueRecord const& params,
7579 IViewBackend& backend,
7580 MountOptions const& options) {
7581 auto refuse = [&](std::string path, std::string reason) {
7582 return std::unexpected(Refusal{.document = doc->id, .path = std::move(path), .reason = std::move(reason)});
7583 };
7584 if (!doc->view) {
7585 return refuse("", "the document has no view");
7586 }
7587 ValueRecord given;
7588 for (auto const& [name, type] : doc->params) {
7589 auto const found = params.find(name);
7590 Value value = found == params.end() ? Value{} : found->second;
7591 if (!type.admits(value)) {
7592 return refuse(pointerAppend("/params", name), value.isNull()
7593 ? "param `" + name + "` is missing"
7594 : "param `" + name + "` is not a " + type.name());
7595 }
7596 given.insert_or_assign(name, std::move(value));
7597 }
7598 for (ModelDecl const& model : doc->scope.models) {
7599 if (model.instance == InstanceMode::Borrowed && !options.borrowed.contains(model.name)) {
7600 return refuse(model.path, "alias `" + model.name + "` borrows a model its opener did not lend");
7601 }
7602 }
7603 reactive::Runtime& runtime = _session->runtime();
7604 std::unique_ptr<Screen> screen{new Screen{}};
7605 screen->_core = std::make_unique<detail::ScreenCore>(doc, *_session, *_dispatcher, _options, options);
7606 detail::ScreenCore& core = *screen->_core;
7607 if (options.keepStateOf != nullptr) {
7608 core.keptStates = options.keepStateOf->ownState();
7609 }
7610 screen->_scope = std::make_shared<detail::RtScope>(core, nullptr, nullptr, options.depth);
7611 core.rootScope = screen->_scope;
7612 detail::RtScope& scope = *screen->_scope;
7613 scope.submitted = &core.submitted;
7614 scope.showErrors = doc->showErrors;
7615 for (auto const& [name, value] : given) {
7616 detail::NameRef ref;
7617 ref.category = detail::NameCategory::Param;
7618 ref.param = value;
7619 scope.names.insert_or_assign(name, std::move(ref));
7620 }
7621 std::vector<Commands const*> lists;
7622 for (auto const& [key, commands] : doc->lifecycle) {
7623 static_cast<void>(key);
7624 lists.push_back(&commands);
7625 }
7626 for (auto const& [chord, commands] : doc->keys) {
7627 static_cast<void>(chord);
7628 lists.push_back(&commands);
7629 }
7630 for (DocNodePtr const& action : doc->actions) {
7631 if (Commands const* const commands = action->event("onClick")) {
7632 lists.push_back(commands);
7633 }
7634 }
7635 Node root = runtime.untracked([&] {
7636 core.declare(scope, &doc->scope, {doc->view.get()}, lists);
7637 detail::LowerCtx const ctx{
7638 .scope = screen->_scope, .bindings = std::make_shared<detail::Bindings const>(), .boundary = nullptr};
7639 Node lowered = core.lower(*doc->view, ctx);
7640 screen->_headStatus = core.lowerBadgeParts(doc->status, ctx);
7641 screen->_headActions = core.lowerActionParts(doc->actions, ctx);
7642 if (!doc->keys.empty()) {
7643 std::vector<KeyBinding> keys;
7644 for (auto const& [chord, commands] : doc->keys) {
7645 keys.push_back(KeyBinding{
7646 .chord = chord, .onPress = [&core, ctx, list = &commands] { core.runEvent(list, ctx, Value{}); }});
7647 }
7648 Column column{.children = {std::move(lowered)}};
7649 column.common.keys = std::move(keys);
7650 lowered = ui::column(std::move(column));
7651 }
7652 return lowered;
7653 });
7654 screen->_mounted.emplace(runtime, backend, std::move(root), options.parent, options.depth + 1);
7655 screen->_core->focusElement = [mounted = &*screen->_mounted](std::string_view element) {
7656 return mounted->focus(element);
7657 };
7658 screen->runLifecycle("onMount");
7659 return screen;
7660}
7661
7662inline std::expected<std::unique_ptr<AppRoot>, Refusal> Interpreter::mountApp(std::shared_ptr<Document const> doc) {
7663 if (doc->id != "app") {
7664 return std::unexpected(
7665 Refusal{.document = doc->id, .path = "/id", .reason = "the app document's id is `app`"});
7666 }
7667 if (_session->appScope() != nullptr) {
7668 return std::unexpected(
7669 Refusal{.document = doc->id, .path = {}, .reason = "an app document is already mounted on the session"});
7670 }
7671 std::unique_ptr<AppRoot> root{new AppRoot{}};
7672 root->_core = std::make_unique<detail::ScreenCore>(doc, *_session, *_dispatcher, _options, MountOptions{});
7673 detail::ScreenCore& core = *root->_core;
7674 root->_scope = std::make_shared<detail::RtScope>(core, nullptr, nullptr, 0);
7675 core.rootScope = root->_scope;
7676 std::vector<Commands const*> lists;
7677 for (auto const& [key, commands] : doc->lifecycle) {
7678 static_cast<void>(key);
7679 lists.push_back(&commands);
7680 }
7681 _session->runtime().untracked([&] { core.declare(*root->_scope, &doc->scope, {}, lists); });
7682 _session->setAppScope(root->_scope.get());
7683 if (auto const found = doc->lifecycle.find("onMount"); found != doc->lifecycle.end()) {
7684 root->runCommands(found->second);
7685 }
7686 return root;
7687}
